title: Extracting ODRL Policies from Business Process Models: A Graph Traversal Approach to Compliance-by-Extraction
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, ODRL and beyond: practical applications and challenges for policy-base access and usage control. OPAL 2026, 2nd edition Co-located with the Extended Semantic Web Conference Dubrovnik , Croatia, 10th-11th MAY (half-day), 2026
summary: Organisations maintain large corpora of process models expressed in the Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN), yet the normative content encoded in those models, the obligations, permissions, and prohibitions that govern participant behaviour, remains inaccessible to policy infrastructure. The Open Digital Rights Language (ODRL) is the emerging lingua franca of machine-readable policy, but authoring ODRL at scale is slow, expert-intensive work, and generation by large language models introduces well-documented risks of structural invalidity. We present a pipeline that resolves this gap by extracting ODRL policies automatically from BPMN XML, grounded in the observation that BPMN control flow encodes deontic modalities by construction. The pipeline traverses the BPMN process graph, classifies each task as an odrl:Duty or odrl:Permission via a reachability check, and introduces a novel treatment of intermediate catch events as odrl:Prohibition rules with lifting constraints, capturing waiting semantics that prior approaches have dropped. The result is a compliance-by-extraction approach in which auditable, interoperable ODRL policies are derived directly from the process models organisations already maintain. The implementation and a live demonstration are available at this https URL and this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出一条七阶段图遍历管道,自动从 BPMN 流程模型 XML 中抽取 ODRL 策略(JSON-LD),无需人工编写策略或依赖 LLM。其核心观察是 BPMN 控制流在结构上即编码了义务、权限与禁止(Natschläger 形式化结果),因此 ODRL 三种基本原语(Duty/Permission/Prohibition)可通过可达性检查等图算法直接从流程图中提取。论文的创新点在于:修正了并行网关的处理(应为 Duty 而非 Permission),并首次将中间捕获事件(intermediate catch event)映射为带解除约束的 odrl:Prohibition,从而保留了之前被丢弃的"等待"语义。
AI.motivation: 组织维护了大量 BPMN 流程模型,但其中编码的规范性内容(义务、权限、禁止)对策略基础设施不可见。ODRL 作为 W3C 推荐的机器可读策略语言,已被 GDPR、欧盟 AI Act、Gaia-X、IDS 数据空间等规范采用,但其大规模编写存在两大瓶颈:1) 专家耗时巨大;2) LLM 生成会引入结构无效性(如将 odrl:spatial 误写为 odrl:location,导致策略无法被任何符合规范的 ODRL 处理器解释)。同时,Governatori 等人基于 defeasible deontic logic 的合规检查工作假设规范集与流程集是分离的两套制品,而 Natschläger 已形式化证明 BPMN 控制流在结构上即内含义务/权限/禁止——这一规范性内容尚未被映射到标准化的策略语言中。本文正是要填补"BPMN ↔ ODRL"这一三角缺口。
AI.method: 方法是一条七阶段图遍历管道,基于 BPMN 控制流的道义语义进行结构化映射:① 解析 BPMN XML 为有向图(任务、网关、事件),以泳道/池(pool)作为参与方分配单元;② Tarjan SCC 算法将环路折叠为元节点,得到 DAG;③ 通过不动点迭代构建支配树,建立任务间的先决链;④ 通过可达性检查进行去/权限分类——若移除某任务后无终止状态可达,则为 odrl:Duty,否则为 odrl:Permission;在排他网关/事件网关分支内进行二次精化,分支入口任务作为带网关约束的 Permission,后续任务作为带约束的 Duty;⑤ 将中间捕获事件映射为 odrl:Prohibition(带解除约束),捕获等待语义;⑥ 按池进行路径感知的 DFS,累积网关条件,处理出向消息流为通知义务;⑦ 装配为 odrl:Set 的 JSON-LD 输出。关键映射规则:任务出现在每条路径上 → Duty;任务仅在 XOR 分支出现 → Permission;AND 并行分支 → Duty(对 Natschläger 的修正);跨角色任务 → 闭世界下的 Prohibition;消息流 → 通知型 Duty。
AI.result: 在 Camunda bpmn-for-research 基准上的五个模型(Dispatch of Goods、Recourse、Credit Scoring 同步/异步、Self-Service Restaurant,共覆盖单方/多方、XOR/AND/事件网关、中间捕获事件、消息流与循环)上,管道均无错误地输出有效的 odrl:Set 策略:参与者归属正确、所有网关条件被正确限定、所有中间捕获事件生成具有正确解除条件的等待禁止。Self-Service Restaurant 含一个环路,经 SCC 折叠后被安全地以无条件 Duty 形式输出(语义上有所损失)。明确的局限性包括:① 环路折叠丢失迭代语义;② 未命名池回退为原始 XML 标识符,可读性下降;③ 当前实现仅对 XOR/事件网关进行分支局部精化,AND/OR 分支仅依赖全局可达性检查;④ 核心 ODRL 缺乏时序与并发原语,支配树与 AND 分裂的部分信息因此无法表达,需 ODRL profile 扩展。
AI.conclusion: 本文以"合规即抽取"(compliance-by-extraction)的范式,将 BPMN 流程图直接转化为可审计、可互操作的 ODRL 策略,绕过了手动编写与 LLM 生成两类瓶颈。三个核心贡献分别是:基于可达性的 Duty/Permission 分类及对并行网关的修正、对中间捕获事件作为带解除约束 Prohibition 的新型映射,以及"策略由实际执行的流程算法派生"的可追溯性。未来工作方向:形式化证明映射的健全性、面向循环与时序的 ODRL profile 扩展、按流程规模的系统性性能刻画,以及在 Camunda 仓库 3,700 余份参与者提交变体上的大规模评估。

title: Scalable Exact Densest P-Partite Subgraph Search in Heterogeneous Information Networks
summary: Heterogeneous information networks (HINs) model typed entities and typed relations, where dense cross-type structures can reveal cohesive semantic patterns such as prolific author-paper-venue groups. Given a query meta-path, the densest P-partite subgraph search (DPpS) problem jointly selects a nonempty vertex set at each typed position and maximizes the number of induced meta-path instances normalized by the geometric mean of the selected set sizes. Existing exact methods solve DPpS by searching over iRM-sets and reducing each fixed-M problem to minimum-cut computations. However, their scalability is limited by the large number of candidate iRM-sets and the high cost of repeatedly solving large auxiliary networks. In this paper, we propose BoxDPpS, an efficient exact approach that reduces both sources of cost. It performs box-level search with safe region pruning, eliminates redundant representations of the same iRM-set, improves early pruning through bounded warm-up, and compresses each fixed-M auxiliary network for exact parametric pseudoflow solving. Experiments on seven real-world datasets show that BoxDPpS preserves the exact DPpS optimum while achieving an average speedup of 27.04x over the state-of-the-art method.

AI.tldr: BoxDPpS是一种针对异构信息网络(HIN)中稠密P-部子图搜索(DPpS)问题的高效精确算法,通过箱级搜索安全剪枝、原始计数向量规范化、有界预热以及基于参数化伪流(Hochbaum伪流)的紧凑固定-M求解,平均比现有最优方法AdvExactGVIt快27.04倍,同时保持DPpS最优解不变。
AI.motivation: DPpS问题旨在通过几何均值归一化元路径实例数来联合选择各类型位置上的非空顶点集,用于发现HIN中具有凝聚语义的跨类型群体(如高产作者-论文-场所群组)。现有精确方法AdvExactGVIt存在两大可扩展性瓶颈:(1)需要枚举大量候选取整模集合(iRM-sets),其数量随顶点规模乘积增长;(2)每个幸存的iRM-set需反复求解大规模辅助网络(每条元路径实例对应一个节点),导致每求解代价高达O(|V(D)|^3)。这两个乘性因子严重限制了在大型异构网络上的可扩展性。
AI.method: BoxDPpS从两个维度同时降本:(1)**搜索空间缩减**——将计数域组织为整数箱并提出多种安全上界(总实例界、度数界、投影感知界、配对投影界)对整个箱进行剪枝;利用gcd归一化将等价iRM-set映射到唯一原始代表以消除冗余;通过有界预热和种子调度早期获得优质下界并启用精确证书;将精确iRM证书通过Jensen不等式提升至箱级别。(2)**单次求解加速**——通过终位孪生压缩和投影分组闭包网络压缩固定-M辅助网络,证明压缩保持原始目标,再利用单调线性顶点代价满足Hochbaum参数化伪流(HPF)条件,将单iRM-set求解复杂度从O(|V(D)|^3)降至O(n_M² log n_M)。算法严格保持精确性,通过定理5.1、6.5、7.1、8.1-8.3保证。
AI.result: 在MovieLens、DBLP、Douban、DBpedia、Freebase、Cisco g21、g22七个真实HIN数据集上的实验表明:在双方都能完成的查询上,BoxDPpS相比AdvExactGVIt获得平均27.04倍加速,具体范围为k=3时3.59x–40.74x,k=4时22.61x–131.77x;在Douban和Cisco g22(k=4)等AdvExactGVIt超时或内存溢出的工作负载上BoxDPpS成功完成;消融实验证实四种技术互补,组合效应远超单独贡献;归一化密度增益略优于AdvExactGVIt(后者因浮点精度问题漏掉部分最优解);在DBpedia和Freebase上对5–9位置元路径以及20%–100%数据规模均保持良好可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: BoxDPpS通过箱级精确搜索、原始iRM-set去重、有界预热种子调度、以及基于终位孪生压缩和投影分组的紧凑参数化伪流求解,在保持DPpS精确最优性的前提下显著提升了异构信息网络上稠密P-部子图搜索的可扩展性,为探索性跨类型群体发现提供了一种既严格又高效的算法框架。

title: SieveIVF: Threshold-Aware IVF Execution for Large-Scale Training Data Deduplication
summary: Embedding-based training data deduplication retrieves candidate duplicate edges above an application similarity threshold, but fixed-probe inverted-file (IVF) search ignores this predicate when giving every query the same partition budget. Across four Hunyuan workloads, qualifying neighbors appear early despite sharply varying search depths. We present SieveIVF, a threshold-aware IVF executor that stops after $W$ consecutive searches find no qualifying candidate. The systems challenge is to preserve partition-major batching when each query's remaining work depends on prior results. Continuous batching groups ready queries by partition. A lookahead scheduler layers on top, exposing only work committed by the stopping rule to increase concurrency without changing stopping decisions or returned results. We implement SieveIVF in Lance. At $W=8$, SieveIVF is $4.1$--$7.6\times$ faster than fixed-probe IVF on four 10M Hunyuan workloads and $6.1$--$8.4\times$ faster on two public 100M workloads under the same index and search parameters, with pooled filtered top-10 recall losses of $0.03$--$1.13$ percentage points on Hunyuan and $1.43$--$2.29$ percentage points on the public workloads. These results show how an application predicate can guide IVF work allocation without changing the index or bounded top-$k$ interface.

AI.tldr: SieveIVF 是一种阈值感知的 IVF（倒排文件）执行器，专为大规模训练数据去重中的相似性阈值检索设计。它通过连续空分区窗口 W 触发每查询早停机制，并结合连续批处理（continuous batching）与前瞻调度（lookahead scheduling），在不改索引格式、不改 top-k 接口的前提下，显著加速候选检索。
AI.motivation: 在嵌入式训练数据去重中，候选检索需要满足应用相似性阈值 τ 的近邻作为重复边。传统固定探测数（fixed-probe）IVF 对所有查询分配相同的分区预算，无法兼顾简单查询（合格邻居出现早）和困难查询（需深入探测）。文章通过对四个腾讯混元 10M 工作负载的表征发现：阈值选择性在不同查询和工作负载间差异巨大，但合格邻居普遍集中在分区顺序的前端。这一语义化机会（而非物理空分区）构成本文的核心动机。

title: Getting to the Root: A Combined Complexity Perspective on Consistent Query Answering
summary: The data complexity of consistent query answering has been extensively studied over the past two decades. In this paper, we study its combined complexity, which has gained less attention. The input is a triple consisting of a set of integrity constraints, a (potentially inconsistent) database, and a query, and the question is to determine whether all repairs of the database with respect to the constraints satisfy the query. Our aim is to isolate query-specific structural features that make this problem computationally tractable. We focus on Boolean self-join-free conjunctive queries over primary-key constraints, as in this context the corresponding data complexity problem has been completely classified. Moreover, we restrict attention to queries with an acyclic attack graph, which are precisely those queries that admit a first-order rewriting. As an additional simplifying assumption, we focus on unary primary keys. Each conjunctive query with unary primary keys naturally gives rise to a directed graph, which we call the key-nonkey graph, where each atom contributes an edge from its key variable to each of its non-key variables. Our main result is that, under the stated assumptions, the combined complexity of consistent query answering is in polynomial time whenever the number of source strongly connected components (SCCs) in the key-nonkey graph is bounded by a constant. To prove this result, we develop novel concepts, such as variable guarding and attack-propagation graphs, and techniques, such as database and query saturation and query normalization. In addition, without the boundedness restriction, the combined complexity of this problem is shown to be Pi_2^P-complete.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一致性查询应答(CQA)的组合复杂度(combined complexity),针对布尔无自连接合取查询在主键约束下、攻击图无环且主键为一元的情况,证明了当key-nonkey图中的源强连通分量(SCC)数量被常数界定时,CQA问题可在多项式时间内求解;否则该问题为Π₂ᴾ完全。核心贡献是提出了变量守卫(variable guarding)、攻击传播图(attack-propagation graphs)、数据库/查询饱和(saturation)及查询归一化(normalization)等新技术。
AI.motivation: 一致性查询应答(CQA)的数据复杂度在过去二十年已被广泛研究并取得完整分类,但其组合复杂度(combinatorial complexity,即输入包含约束集合、数据库和查询三部分)关注较少。本文旨在填补这一空白,识别出使该问题在组合复杂度下仍可多项式时间求解的查询结构特征。
AI.result: 主要结果:在上述假设下,当key-nonkey图中源强连通分量的数量被常数界定时,一致性查询应答的组合复杂度属于多项式时间(PTIME);若去掉该有界性限制,则该问题的组合复杂度为Π₂ᴾ完全(Π₂ᴾ-complete)。这给出了无环攻击图查询下CQA组合复杂度的完整分类。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过key-nonkey图的结构参数(源SCC数量)精确刻画了无环攻击图、一元主键设定下一致性查询应答组合复杂度的可处理边界,扩展了CQA复杂性的理论理解,并为相关查询优化提供了结构判据。

title: RAG-Stack: Co-Optimizing RAG Serving Performance and Quality
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which augments large language model (LLM) generation with information retrieved from databases, has become a widely used approach for knowledge-intensive applications. Modern RAG systems, however, expose many configuration choices, such as retrieval indexes, model selections, and how models invoke retrieval. Each configuration yields a different trade-off between answer quality and serving performance, making it challenging to choose the optimal setting for a specific application deployment. We present RAG-Stack, a framework for efficiently discovering quality-performance Pareto frontiers across diverse RAG applications and serving systems. RAG-Stack consists of RAG-PE, an iterative design-space exploration algorithm that selects the next RAG configuration to evaluate; RAG-IR, a workload abstraction for diverse RAG algorithms; and RAG-CM, a performance model that predicts the optimal deployment and serving performance on the given hardware. Together, these components allow RAG-Stack to search the joint algorithm-system configuration space without deploying every candidate and to transfer an existing Pareto frontier to a new serving system. Given the same number of optimization iterations across diverse datasets, the Pareto frontiers found by RAG-Stack cover 52.5% to 153.2% more of the normalized quality-performance space than those found by state-of-the-art configuration-search methods evaluated over the same RAG design space.

AI.tldr: RAG-Stack是一个端到端框架，用于高效发现RAG（检索增强生成）系统中答案质量与服务性能之间的Pareto前沿。它由三个核心组件组成：RAG-PE（多目标贝叶斯优化器）、RAG-IR（工作负载抽象层）和RAG-CM（性能预测成本模型），能够在不实际部署每个候选配置的情况下搜索联合算法-系统配置空间，并支持将已有Pareto前沿迁移到新硬件平台。
AI.motivation: 现代RAG系统暴露了大量配置选择（检索索引、模型选择、检索调用方式等），每个配置在答案质量和服务性能之间存在不同权衡。现有RAG配置优化方法存在三个关键问题：(P1) 跨阶段交互与阶段级信号难以兼顾——按阶段优化会破坏跨阶段交互，而全局优化缺乏定向探索信号；(P2) 现有RAG优化器忽视了系统设计空间，仅在固定部署下测量性能；(P3) 基于部署的服务性能测量成本高昂且无法跨系统迁移。这些问题使得用户难以选择适合特定应用的最佳配置，因此需要一个能联合优化算法与系统配置空间的高效框架。
AI.method: RAG-Stack将完整配置空间划分为算法设计空间（影响质量）和系统设计空间（仅影响性能）。三个核心组件协同工作：(1) RAG-PE是基于LogNEHVI的多目标贝叶斯优化器，通过子指标感知（利用上下文召回率、忠实度等阶段级诊断信号）、异构候选生成池（Sobol覆盖、阶段引导、离散局部搜索、Pareto张力交叉）和仲裁机制进行有向探索，同时保持跨阶段交互；(2) RAG-IR提供系统无关的工作负载抽象，包括无序工作流模式和每请求执行DAG，解耦逻辑计算与物理部署；(3) RAG-CM是ML与分析融合的四层性能模型（算法层、性能层、通信层、组装层），支持IVF和HNSW索引、连续/动态批处理、自动前缀缓存、解耦批处理限制等机制，可预测吞吐量与延迟而无需实际部署。该框架支持从零开始发现Pareto前沿和系统迁移两种运行模式。
AI.result: 在RAGEval和MS MARCO数据集上，使用4×H100 (SysA) 和 8×A100 (SysB) 两套系统配置进行评估：(1) 端到端优化方面，在相同评估预算下，RAG-Stack找到的Pareto前沿覆盖的归一化质量-性能空间比最强基线（GP+LogNEHVI）多52.5%（RAGEval）和153.2%（MS MARCO），且运行时间（3.60-4.59小时）也优于多数基线；(2) 优化器消融实验中，RAG-PE在80个预算点中的77个取得最高平均超体积；(3) RAG-CM性能预测的Spearman相关系数达0.968-0.978，整体MAPE为11.2-15.3%，有效保持配置排序；(4) 系统迁移实验中，从SysA迁移到SysB时，校准后的RAG-Stack在20次评估预算下比从零开始优化提升归一化HV达182.2%。
AI.conclusion: RAG-Stack通过解耦算法与系统设计空间、利用子指标感知的多目标优化以及无需部署的性能预测模型，有效解决了RAG系统中质量与性能联合优化的难题。其核心贡献在于：(1) 端到端联合优化算法-系统配置空间的高效框架；(2) 子指标感知的贝叶斯优化器RAG-PE；(3) 混合ML-分析的性能模型RAG-CM。该框架在显著提升Pareto前沿质量的同时降低了优化成本，并支持跨硬件迁移，为RAG服务的实际部署提供了实用工具。未来工作方向包括将trace-free静态预测扩展到智能体（agentic）RAG流程。

title: Evaluating LLMs in Database Scenarios: A Lifecycle Benchmark for Assessing Their Potential in Core Database Tasks
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming database interaction paradigms, evolving from simple query translators to autonomous database administrators (DBAs). However, current evaluation benchmarks remain disproportionately fixated on Text-to-SQL tasks, neglecting the holistic Database Lifecycle-from initial schema design to post-deployment maintenance. This narrow focus fails to capture the diverse capabilities required for real-world database management. To bridge this gap, we introduce DBLifeBench, the first benchmark to evaluate LLMs across five critical lifecycle phases: Design, Implementation, Operation, Debugging, and Maintenance. Furthermore, addressing the cognitive mismatch between ambiguous natural language and complex SQL logic, we propose Progressive-Text2SQL, a novel task utilizing structured reasoning graphs to mimic human iterative problem-solving. Our extensive evaluation reveals a critical insight: while general-purpose models demonstrate balanced performance, specialized Text-to-SQL models suffer from ``catastrophic forgetting'' in non-coding phases like design and maintenance. DBLifeBench serves as a foundational step toward evaluating and building true full-stack database intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了DBLifeBench，这是首个覆盖数据库全生命周期（设计、实现、运营、调试、维护）的LLM评估基准，并提出了基于推理图的Progressive-Text2SQL新任务。通过对11个LLM的广泛评估，发现通用模型表现均衡，而专用Text-to-SQL模型在非编码阶段存在"灾难性遗忘"现象。
AI.motivation: 现有数据库LLM评估基准过度聚焦于Text-to-SQL任务（如Spider、BIRD），存在"管窥效应"，无法全面衡量LLM在真实DBA工作流中所需的多维能力，包括模式设计、调试、维护等。需要在整个数据库生命周期中进行系统性评估以推动真正的全栈数据库智能发展。
AI.method: 1) 提出DBLifeBench基准，覆盖5个生命周期阶段：P1设计（实体/数据类型/外键准确率）、P2实现（表级和字段级准确率）、P3运营（包含标准Text2SQL和新型Progressive-Text2SQL，使用EX和G-EX指标）、P4调试（执行验证）、P5维护（Assigner分配+Expert工具调用）。2) 设计Progressive-Text2SQL任务，使用动态推理图分解复杂SQL，采用多LLM（GPT-4o/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek-R1）协同构建，通过两阶段验证（SQLite执行+人工标注Jaccard相似度>80%）。3) 在13个数据库（平均7.8表）上评估11个LLM，分通用模型和专用模型两类。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) GPT-4o全面领先，GPT-4o-mini次之；(2) 专用模型呈现"灾难性遗忘"现象——SQLCoder在实现和维护阶段几乎完全失败（AVG仅8.68和0.00），其SQL能力无法迁移到其他任务；(3) Progressive-Text2SQL相比标准Text2SQL显著提升EX，尤其在困难任务上（如Qwen2.5提升显著）；(4) 即使在Level-5扰动下，P-Text2SQL仍优于基线Text2SQL，表现出强鲁棒性；(5) 不同规范化级别的schema对模型有显著影响，v3（更高语义对齐）优于v2；(6) 多轮调试中Llama3、Mistral有明显提升，但DeepSeek无改善；(7) 通用模型在不同表数量下表现稳定，专用模型则波动明显。
AI.conclusion: DBLifeBench代表了从孤立SQL生成评估向完整数据库生命周期管理评估的范式转变，揭示了当前专用模型以牺牲通用推理能力换取语法熟练度的局限性。Progressive-Text2SQL证明结构化、循序渐进的推理是解决复杂数据库问题的关键。该基准为构建真正的自主数据库代理提供了严格标准。未来工作将扩展到多模态输入场景。

title: Uplifting the Superpowers of Worst-Case-Optimal Join Algorithms
summary: Worst-case-optimal (wco) join algorithms have demonstrated their power -- in both theory and practice -- to efficiently solve complex Basic Graph Patterns (BGPs). Modern graph query languages, such as SPARQL and GQL, have BGPs at their core, but also have a wide range of other features, including filters (aka.\ selections). Such conditions are typically handled via pre- or post-filtering, before or after processing the BGPs. In this paper we show how to uplift wco join algorithms so as to incorporate such filtering natively, improving efficiency. We demonstrate the superiority of this approach by extending the \textit{Ring} -- a compact index that provides wco resolution of BGPs within almost no extra space on top of the graph -- so as to handle property graphs using our new techniques while retaining compactness. We implement this extension and experimentally show that it outperforms various baseline systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将过滤器（filter/selection）原生集成到最坏情况最优（wco）连接算法中的新技术——"leaptors"，并将其扩展到属性图（property graph）领域，构建了 PG-Ring 索引。该系统将过滤操作下推到 wco 连接处理过程中，避免了传统预先过滤或后过滤的低效性，同时保持了简洁的数据结构空间开销。
AI.motivation: 现代图查询语言（如 SPARQL 和 GQL）虽然以基本图模式（BGP）为核心，但普遍包含过滤器条件（研究显示真实查询中约 40% 使用 FILTER）。传统做法是在 BGP 处理前后进行过滤，这会引入大量不必要的中间结果。此外，现有的紧凑数据结构支持的 wco 连接算法主要针对 RDF 模型，未能应用于属性图模型，且均不支持过滤器的原生集成。
AI.method:
1. 提出 "leaptor"（leap iterator）抽象：将迭代器扩展为支持 leap(c) 操作的有序集合，能够在 O(log N) 时间内找到 ≥c 的最小元素，保留交替复杂度（alternation complexity）保证。
2. 对于属性值范围过滤：使用离散网格 M_π 存储（节点, 属性值）点，通过小波树支持正交范围后继查询。
3. 对于标签过滤：使用稀疏位向量 D_ℓ 和后继查询结构，支持 O(log log N) 时间的 leap。
4. 扩展 Ring 索引：基于小波树添加属性网格和标签位向量的简洁表示，保持数据规模 + 次线性额外空间。
5. 构建 PG-Ring：处理属性图的边标识、布尔标签表达式、WHERE 子句等特性，通过语法树机制支持一般布尔表达式的过滤下推。
6. 基于自适应变量消元顺序（VEO），按非孤立节点变量→非孤立边变量→孤立变量的优先级消除，并估计选择性进行优化。
AI.result: 在 LSQB 基准（3550 万节点、2.19 亿边）上：PG-Ring 在 Q2、Q3、Q6 等循环查询上表现最优，空间仅为 MillDB 的 1/5.4；在 Wikidata 基准（1.09 亿节点、7.20 亿边）上：PG-Ring 达到最佳时空权衡，仅用 MillDB 32% 的空间，平均比 MillDB 仅慢 32%；相比后过滤基线平均快 16%，相比预过滤基线快 15 倍；对于"查找 1554 年出生人类性别"的特定查询，相比后过滤基线实现超过 5000 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了将过滤器原生集成到 wco 连接算法中（即"过滤下推"）能够显著提升图查询性能，同时保持简洁空间开销。PG-Ring 在属性图上的 LSQB 和 Wikidata 基准测试中实现了优越的时空权衡，为知识图谱查询提供了高效的解决方案。未来工作包括扩展至 RDF/SPARQL、支持动态更新以及将更多 GQL 算子下推到简洁数据结构层面。

title: PULSE: An Executable Contract Language for Spatiotemporal Knowledge Graph Engineering
comment: 6 pages, 5 tables, 1 code listing; submitted to KGSWC 2026. Research artifact available under the Apache-2.0 license
summary: Knowledge graph engineering often distributes accepted state, observations, constraints, processes, and hypothetical scenarios across artifacts whose combined execution contract remains external. We present PULSE, an Object-Process-Methodology-inspired language that localizes four operational roles and their write effects in one typed runtime. Here, modes denote operational roles rather than modal or deontic logic. The implemented contract fixes evidence non-overwrite, branch isolation, grounded multi-subject timers, guarded state change, and declaration-ranked event ordering over time and space; an external runner still decides whether evidence becomes an authoritative move. GeoSPARQL, SOSA, and SHACL remain generated views. A core calculus gives an effect-confinement lemma and six safety properties. Lean 4 checks kernel analogues for positions, evidence, clocks, monitors, atomicity, and branch source retention; 88 tests, 3,534 bounded checks, and 32 Lean/Python runtime-kernel cases bound the implementation claim to the checked cases. First-author implementations of a standards composition and a separate Sismic statechart reproduce the tested cold-chain trace. Across 37,440 generated temporal traces, PULSE matches a separate workflow and distinguishes ten single-field mutants. On the complete NOAA IBTrACS since1980 subset it agrees with GEOS and an event sweep on 1,476,290 transition-zone pairs, including 4,800 sampled and 12,831 duration-qualified events. Project-specific GeoSPARQL probes measure interface coverage. Overall, the results support contract localization, safety arguments, and trace parity for the tested fragment; language superiority and usability remain outside the evaluation.

AI.tldr: PULSE是一种面向时空知识图谱工程的可执行契约语言，基于对象-过程方法论(OPM)思想，将已接受状态、观测证据、约束、过程与反事实分支四种操作角色及其写入效应统一在单一类型化运行时中。其核心贡献是契约的本地化——将证据非覆盖、分支隔离、接地多主体计时器、守卫状态变更和声明排序的事件顺序等约束集中于一处检查，而GeoSPARQL、SOSA、SHACL等标准仍作为派生视图存在。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱工程通常将已接受状态、观测、约束、过程和假设场景分散到不同的工件(本体、观测图、形状图、过程模型、空间存储和模拟器)中，其组合执行契约外部化。这导致关键语义边界模糊：观测不构成已接受更新、策略声明的是义务而非事实、场景不得变更已断言状态、持续时长限定的事件既非OWL公理也非静态SHACL违规。现有标准(OWL、SHACL、GeoSPARQL、SOSA/SSN)各自规定了局部契约，但跨工件的组合契约仍由外部引擎决定。OPM虽整合对象/过程/状态，但其可执行版本不针对KG角色划分。PULSE旨在通过单一类型化运行时本地化这些操作角色与写入效应，避免将契约分散到多个适配器中。
AI.method: PULSE定义了四种操作模式(mode仅指操作角色，非模态/规范逻辑)：①断言(asserted state)；②观测(append-only、源限定的证据，𝗋𝖾𝖼𝗈𝗋𝖽仅扩展证据集O)；③约束(只读义务Γ⊢X⇓ₙV)；④场景(反事实分支，克隆后不可影响源)。模型M=⟨n,v,R,E,I,O,C,P,S⟩，配置X=⟨A,O,q,Q,t⟩分别承载断言值、追加证据、对象状态、有限部分定时器映射与事件时间。语言核心给出写入效应判断Γ⊢a▷W：record↦{O}，move↦{A,q,Q,t}，advance↦{q,Q,t}，验证/问题W=∅。核心演算给出大步求值关系Γ⊢⟨X,a⟩⇓u，并证明六条性质：①效应收敛辅助引理；②保持性定理；③确定性定理；④记录隔离定理(不会覆盖A、q、Q、t)；⑤场景外延隔离定理；⑥有限推进定理；⑦原子失败定理。位置采用sample-and-hold语义，事件发出由(deadline, ρ(k))总序确定；流程对多主体接地。Python原型包含EBNF解析器、不可变类型记录、语义编译器、Point/Polygon内核、角色感知运行时、时序事件队列与投影层，并通过Lean 4检查位置/证据/时钟/监视器/原子性/分支源码保留的内核模拟量。
AI.result: ①RQ1(契约与策略检查)：88个测试、3,534次有界检查、32个Lean/Python运行时-内核桥接用例全部通过；6个策略敏感性用例均改变状态/事件轨迹(6/6)。②RQ2(空间与投影一致性)：89例GEOS语料全部匹配；86例CRS84在Apache Jena与PostGIS外部引擎上7,396对全部无差异；GeoSPARQL 1.1 Annex A的55个标识符映射185个自定义探针，本地Jena通过112/185，PULSE Geometry与H3配置组合通过185/185。③RQ3(真实轨迹)：NOAA IBTrACS v04r01 since1980子集含4,775条轨迹、300,033点、295,258次跨区事件；五区回放1,476,290对与GEOS及独立事件扫描完全一致，4,800个采样事件与12,831个时长限定事件无差异。④RQ4(端到端执行与组合)：长度2-5的笛卡尔积产生4∑ₙ₌₂⁵2ⁿ·4ⁿ⁻¹=37,440条轨迹，PULSE与参考工作流逐条匹配；10个单字段突变体全部被杀死(1,680-11,024条区分轨迹)；六处契约点位故障在PULSE中可在编译时拒绝2处、运行时/记录/场景边界预防4处，而RDF+Sismic未配置组合只能在完整结果/源预言机处发现6/6。⑤RQ5-7(辅助工程)：10⁵次移动后计数保留；PostGIS GiST索引在容器替换后保留；50,000对象读/更新/事件工作负载在崩溃/重启后存活。
AI.conclusion: PULSE为知识图谱工程的已接受状态、证据、义务、反事实与时空过程提供了类型化可执行契约，在受检片段上得到演算、Lean子集、IBTrACS回放与外部空间引擎的支持，安全性与轨迹等价性得到论证。标准/Sismic基线虽能通过显式跨工件契约复现被测保护，但其契约散布于RDF/SHACL、状态图与绑定/排序/克隆适配器等多处。PULSE将契约本地化于单一类型化模型与运行时，使故障定位前移：编译期拒绝2/6契约站点故障、运行时/记录/场景边界预防4/6，而未配置基线需依赖完整预言机。贡献严格限定在被检片段：几何限于点与简单多边形、含平面谓词与显式CRS；官方OGC一致性未测；H3为近似；IBTrACS为回顾性数据；合同定位案例仅一条轨迹；Lean从解析后开始并抽象几何/浮点谓词/约束验证/场景问题；32例桥接提供的是用例对应而非通用Python精化关系；语言优越性与可用性评价留待未来独立复现、插值、复制部署与预注册建模研究。

title: Stateful Governance for Concurrent Agentic Systems
summary: AI agents are moving from advisory interfaces into systems that execute consequential operations: issuing refunds, reserving scarce inventory, provisioning cloud resources, and initiating financial transfers. These workflows require governance over effects, not only over model outputs. Existing safeguards often decide whether an action is allowed from the information available when the action is requested. For stateful policies, that request-time view may be incomplete: budgets, inventory, approval status, and risk signals can change before the effect occurs, making an earlier authorization or approval stale. This paper studies stateful governance for concurrent agentic systems. We identify stale authorization as the core failure mode and define policy-state serializability, a correctness condition requiring committed effects to be explainable as authorized against the policy state immediately before they occur. We present Provenact, a runtime architecture that keeps policies as reviewable programs while coordinating the state and effects needed to preserve their decisions. In experiments with a PostgreSQL-backed prototype of Provenact, the system prevents stale authorizations missed by baselines that pass policy state as ordinary request context, preserves delayed approvals while unrelated work proceeds, keeps policy evolution mostly in policy text rather than trusted provider code, and avoids policy violations in a scripted, LLM-free procurement workflow where agent-governance baselines produce stale authorizations over shared budgets and inventory. More broadly, Provenact suggests a path for integrating stateful governance boundaries into agent frameworks and provider-backed domains where agents act on shared resources.

AI.tldr: 本文研究并发代理系统中的有状态治理问题，识别出"陈旧授权"（stale authorization）为核心失效模式，定义了策略状态可串行化（PSS）作为正确性条件，并提出了 Provenact 运行时架构，通过将策略编写为可审查程序、结合提供者契约（provider contracts）和作用域强制执行（scoped enforcement），在保证正确性的同时支持并发推进、延迟审批保留和策略模块化。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 代理从咨询界面转向执行退款、预留库存、配置云资源、发起金融转账等具有重要影响的操作，治理重点从模型输出转向效应（effects）的治理。现有策略引擎通常仅基于请求时的信息做出允许/拒绝决策，但策略状态（预算、库存、审批状态、风险信号等）在请求与效应实际提交之间可能发生变化，导致"陈旧授权"——即基于过时的策略状态做出的允许决策在执行时已不再合法。这一问题在并发代理场景下尤为突出：不同账户的转账在应用层面无冲突，但因共享同一团队预算而在策略状态层面产生冲突，可能突破预算上限。人类审批的时间间隔进一步拉长了这一缺陷，使"陈旧审批"成为长时段的失败模式。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组成部分：(1) 形式化建模——定义策略状态 S、认证策略状态视图向量 Q、纯函数策略 P 和效应转换 E，并定义策略状态可串行化（PSS）正确性条件，要求每个提交效应都可在某个串行历史中以紧邻操作前的策略状态被授权时得到解释；(2) Provenact 运行时架构——通过提供者契约声明认证策略状态视图（含类型、解析器、作用域解析器）和受治理效应（含读写作用域、幂等性、执行模式），运行时将策略读取作用域与效应作用域合并，通过作用域锁（事务模式和保留模式）保护决策-效应时间窗口，支持升级/审批为分阶段治理操作并通过作用域保留或重新验证保证其策略状态基础；(3) 策略 DSL——受限的、类型化的、无副作用的表达语言，仅允许调用注册的认证视图，使运行时可在编译期和请求时解析策略依赖的作用域集合。定理 2 证明在良类型策略和健全契约下，作用域强制执行可保证终端历史满足 PSS。
AI.result: 基于 PostgreSQL 原型的五项研究问题评估结果：(1) RQ1 正确性——朴素实现和 Cedar 基线在最小冲突场景中均两次提交（30-31 次陈旧允许），而全局序列化、手写事务和 Provenact 两种模式均正确承认一次/拒绝一次，实现 PSS；(2) RQ2 效率——512 次操作、32 客户端、16 逻辑作用域下，服务时间 10 ms 时 Provenact-Tx 达 86.4 ops/s，为 Global 基线 52.7 ops/s 的 1.64 倍，与手写事务基线相当；(3) RQ3 长时治理——Global hold 阻止无关进展，全局重验证和 Provenact-Tx 丢失所有审批基础（100% 失效），而 Provenact-Hold 和 Provenact-Res 均零审批失效并允许无关工作推进；(4) RQ4 策略模块化——五次策略演化中 Provenact 改动 18 行策略文本和 4 行受信提供者代码，手写基线改动 22 行受信代码，新增输入通过注册认证视图实现而效应执行器不变；(5) RQ5 代理工作流——256 次采购工作流基准中 AGT 提交 71.6 次（59.0 有效）、产生最终团队预算和库存违规，Omnigent 提交 107.6 次（66.2 有效）并产生三类违规，Provenact-Tx 和 Provenact-Res 均提交 70.6 次有效工作流且零陈旧授权和零违规。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论：有状态治理本质上是并发控制问题，当策略依赖可变共享状态时，允许决策仅对其评估时刻的策略状态有效。Provenact 通过将策略保持为一类治理工件，同时协调使其决策成立的策略状态事实，在策略可编程性与一致性保证之间提供了一条中间路径。其提出的策略状态可串行化（PSS）作为显式正确性条件，与作用域强制执行的实现边界相结合，代表了将并发代理系统中的治理视为系统问题（而非纯策略工程问题）的方向。局限包括：评估为受控基准而非实际部署追踪；生产部署需要额外的认证视图、提供者适配和硬化；外部 API 参与的隔离需要更复杂的持久化保护执行协议；策略语言的限制虽为安全所必需，但也排除了任意回调和策略路径中的无界计算。

title: On the missing data layer and a potential solution
summary: Latin America is missing two foundational layers of AI infrastructure: the dataset layer and the benchmark layer. This paper targets the dataset layer. The dataset layer faces two compounding problems: discovery and supply. Latin American AI datasets exist but are scattered across platforms with no shared index. Even with perfect indexing, the total volume would remain far below what frontier AI development requires. We propose DataHub: a task-first data infrastructure organized through the ontology /<task?>/<domain?>/<language?>, with mechanisms for dataset discovery, metadata, contribution, licensing, and reuse.

AI.tldr: 拉丁美洲AI发展缺失数据集层和基准层两大基础基础设施。本文聚焦数据集层,提出名为DataHub的"任务优先"数据集基础设施,采用/<任务>/<领域>/<语言>三级本体组织,旨在同时破解数据集"发现难"与"供给不足"的复合困境,为构建多极化AI世界中拉美的独立能力奠基。
AI.motivation: 拉美当前AI处于"消费"状态:使用他处训练的模型、基于他处收集的数据、针对他处定义的任务进行评估。这带来双重代价——工业层面,通用任务因区域数据特殊性而性能下降(如农业害虫分类、医疗转录);公共机构层面,外来模型编码了外国价值体系、语言与历史叙事,影响公民的被代表、被服务和被治理方式,构成"主权能力损失"。数据集层面临发现(分散于Hugging Face、Mozilla、论文附录,无共享索引)与供给(总量远落后于前沿需求)两个相互强化的负面循环。
AI.method: 提出DataHub,核心设计包括:(1)任务优先的三级本体/<task?>/<domain?>/<language?>,以"任务"为首轴(转录、分类、抽取、翻译、预测、分割等),"领域"为次轴(如医疗、法律),"语言及区域变体"为第三轴(如里奥普拉滕塞西班牙语);(2)设计层面开放(open by design),因非前沿地区最需要协作;(3)建设层面激励驱动(incentive-driven by construction),通过可见性、署名权、机构品牌认可等机制让贡献获得回报;(4)低摩擦贡献路径,研究者几分钟内可发布数据集;(5)许可证与司法管辖元数据透明呈现。
AI.result: DataHub作为可工作的原型已上线(datahub.lat),由SURUS团队构建并发布。基准层问题由姊妹项目LatamBoard处理。论文明确将DataHub定位为"起点(kickstart)而非成品",承认未解决问题包括:各国数据保护与版权法规差异、区域元数据与质量共享标准缺失、署名与版本管理等协作规范未定、企业/大学/政府内部数据释放的制度激励不足。
AI.conclusion: 拉美AI的数据集层必须由该地区为该地区建设,否则将永远不会被建设。DataHub是该方向的第一步,也是面向企业、研究者、机构与更广泛社区的邀请——通过发布数据、使用数据集、参与标准制定来共同塑造拉美AI的基础设施,助力实现拉美作为多极化AI世界中独立一极的地位。

title: GPTKB 2.0: Direct Construction of Disambiguated Knowledge Bases from Large Language Models
summary: Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC) is a core NLP task, and recent work proposes generating knowledge bases directly from large language models (LLMs), treating the model itself as the knowledge source. However, LLMs natively possess no representation of entities, leading to duplicate entries as well as conflations. We propose GPTKB 2.0, a methodology for constructing disambiguated KBs directly from LLMs. GPTKB 2.0 incorporates on-the-fly disambiguation of entities, relations and classes, and is meticulously designed to satisfy both scalability and disambiguation accuracy. We analyze the central design decisions and characterize the trade-offs between accuracy, scale, and cost. We execute GPTKB 2.0 at scale, obtaining a materialized KB containing over 1M disambiguated entities and 38.4M triples. This represents the first million-scale LLM-native KB with explicit internal canonicalization of entities, relations, and classes, a significant departure from prior Wikimedia-centric works. GPTKB 2.0 is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GPTKB 2.0，一种直接从大语言模型参数化知识构建大规模、显式消歧知识库（KB）的方法论，包含超过 100 万个消歧实体和 3840 万条三元组，是首个百万级、脱离 Wikimedia 体系的 LLM 原生消歧知识库。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动化知识库构建（AKBC）方法主要依赖 Wikipedia/Wikidata 进行实体规范化，而新兴的从 LLM 直接构建知识库的工作因采用字符串作为实体标识符，面临同义词（synonymy）和多义词（homonymy）两大根本性挑战——前者导致重复条目，后者导致实体混淆。LLM 本身以字符串而非实体为训练单元，结构性缺乏实体表示能力。
AI.method: 提出三阶段、上下文引导的递归流水线：(1) 知识诱发（Elicitation）——在提示中附带实体描述以确保诱发事实指向正确实体；(2) 命名实体识别（NER）——在提示中附带源三元组以消歧对象是字面量还是实体；(3) 消歧（Disambiguation）——采用两轮命名实体消歧（NED）：第一轮基于标签嵌入相似性检索 top-5 候选并结合源三元组上下文；第二轮专门处理高密度多义词（如某个标签对应 300+ 实体），使用描述嵌入相似性在同标签实体中检索。配合"守护式并行化"策略（按标签聚类，优先处理可能已有候选的实体，延后处理可能产生重复的实体）以及缓存机制（高频标签-关系对跳过 NED）。数据模型采用 Wikidata 风格的四元组：实体/关系/类各有唯一 ID、标签、描述和别名集。
AI.result: 构建的 GPTKB 2.0 包含 1,592,185 个消歧实体、207,633 个关系、66,523 个类和 38,450,135 条三元组；将 2,316,275 个表面标签归并为 1,592,185 个规范实体，正确区分了共享 41,275 个表面标签的 131,990 个多义实体；36.8% 的实体为 Wikidata 所未有（验证于 1000 个随机样本）。人工评估：多义合并 98%、同义合并 91%、多义拆分 100%、同义拆分 95% 准确；三元组真实率 94.5%（人工）/92.8%（LLM）；实体可验证率 96%（人工）/92.3%（LLM）。整体构建耗时 70 天，4770 万次 API 调用，成本 6992 美元，平均每实体成本随规模从 $0.015 降至约 $0.008。消融实验证实第二轮 description-context NED 对减少漏合并至关重要。
AI.conclusion: GPTKB 2.0 首次实现了在 Wikimedia 体系之外大规模构建消歧通用领域实体库的可能性，证明了 LLM 原生 KB 构建可以兼具开放性和规范化精度，展示了在 Wikidata 覆盖薄弱的长尾区域补充知识的潜力；提供了 SPARQL 端点和在线浏览界面以支持偏见、一致性等大规模统计分析。局限包括：无引用/溯源信息；规模仍远小于 Wikidata；知识为时间静态，反映训练截止时的事实。

title: ISEE: Interactive Semantic Enrichment for Database Fields
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly being deployed for data-related tasks, including data sense-making, exploration, and retrieval. However, their performance heavily depends on the clarity and completeness of data semantics. In practice, many field descriptions remain ambiguous or incomplete, as much of the essential context (e.g., the meaning of a customized field) originates from users' domain knowledge and is rarely documented publicly. This gap restricts the agents' task performance in downstream tasks, such as entity-linking. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel and comprehensive Interactive SEmantic Enrichment system (ISEE). Given a data field description, ISEE measures its quality through a scoring system, gathers domain knowledge, and collaboratively enriches the semantics with users. Through a user study, automated user simulation, quantitative evaluation, and case study, we demonstrate that ISEE significantly reduces cognitive load, improves description quality, and enhances downstream task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 ISEE 系统，一种交互式数据库字段语义增强工具，通过五维评分系统、基于澄清分类法的提问生成器和条件式查询填充三大模块，让领域专家参与字段描述的迭代式丰富与完善，从而降低认知负荷、提升描述质量，并显著改善实体链接和 text-to-SQL 等下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体被广泛用于数据理解、探索与检索等任务，但表现高度依赖字段描述的清晰度与完整性。企业场景中存在大量由用户自定义、含义仅存于个人领域知识中的字段，导致描述常常模糊或缺失。这使得 LLM 在实体链接等下游任务中表现受限，而现有自动语义增强方法仅依赖 LLM 的通用知识，无法弥补缺失的领域上下文，因此必须将领域专家纳入循环、主动收集其私有知识。
AI.method: ISEE 由三大核心模块构成：(1) 下游任务感知的评分系统，沿可用性（基于实体链接 MRR）、信息量（基于成分对余弦相似度倒数）、清晰度（基于多解释对相似度均值）、简洁度（基于句法+语义冗余检测）和可读性（Flesch-Kincaid）五个维度（0–100）设计独立算法进行评估；(2) 基于澄清分类法（包含 Paraphrase、Narrow-down、Attributes、Wh-clarification、Relationship、Logic 六类）的提问生成器，采用"LLM-as-a-Judge"先选类型再生成针对性问题；(3) 条件式查询填充组件，由 LLM 自动生成候选自然语言查询供用户验证而非从头编写。系统通过三阶段迭代流水线（评估→澄清→增强）配合图形界面，让用户持续优化描述直至满意。
AI.result: 用户研究（8 名参与者）显示，ISEE 在盲评中获得了 6.2/7 的评分，显著高于手工编辑（3.2）、候选选择（4.0）和 ChatGPT（4.5），描述增强准确率分别提升 119%、32% 和 92%，NASA TLX 评估表明其认知负荷显著降低。在 BIRD 基准的自动化用户模拟中，ISEE 将实体链接 MRR 从原始 42.31、Auto-enrich 55.25 提升至 64.72，text-to-SQL 执行准确率从 52.22、54.95 提升至 61.40。100 题样本的定量评估同样验证了其一致优势。案例研究中 purchases.value 字段的描述分值从 18 提升至 82，使原本错误的实体链接和 SQL 生成得到纠正。
AI.conclusion: ISEE 验证了交互式语义增强在捕获私有领域知识方面的有效性，能在降低认知负荷的同时显著提升字段描述质量，并直接惠及实体链接和 text-to-SQL 等下游任务，为解决企业数据库中定制字段语义缺失问题提供了有前景的方向。其局限在于假设用户具备相应领域知识、用户研究样本规模较小，以及自动化用户模拟难以完全模拟真实人类的部分模糊或含糊应答。

title: Self-Organising Digital Circuits
summary: Fault tolerance in classical computing has traditionally relied on static strategies like hardware redundancy and error-correcting codes. Biological systems, in contrast, exhibit adaptive plasticity, maintaining function through dynamic re-organisation around damage. Inspired by this principle, we introduce Self-Organising Digital Circuits, framing functional logic generation and maintenance as a meta-learning problem on graphs. Our architecture employs a topology-masked Transformer that configures the Lookup Tables (LUT) of a circuit's Boolean gates. Extending the pattern-generation paradigm of Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), it navigates the degenerate Boolean search space to satisfy a computational task, rather than regenerating a fixed target state. We demonstrate that it can self-assemble functional circuits from scratch and rapidly re-route logic around permanent, previously unseen hardware faults. For soft errors, the policy achieves near-perfect recovery (>99.99\% accuracy) from damage sizes far exceeding training conditions. We further observe generalisation across circuit scales: accuracy improves on graphs substantially wider than those seen during training. This work bridges the principles of biological self-organisation with the practical domain of digital hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自组织数字电路"框架，将功能性逻辑的生成与维护建模为图上的元学习问题。通过使用拓扑掩码Transformer（TMT）配置布尔门的查找表（LUT），将神经细胞自动机（NCA）范式从模式生成扩展到逻辑合成。系统可从零自组装功能电路并自适应绕过硬/软故障，显著优于传统静态冗余容错策略。
AI.motivation: 传统硬件容错依赖静态冗余和纠错码，需预先规划资源并建模故障模式，遇到超出冗余预算或未知故障时会脆性失效。相比之下，生物系统（如哺乳动物皮层）通过适应性可塑性（皮层重映射）和网络简并性动态重组存活组件来维持功能。本文受此启发，借鉴冯·诺依曼"跨越错误运行"思想，旨在为数字硬件（特别是FPGA）提供类似生物的自愈能力，克服全局重配置开销带来的"重配置惩罚"，实现远程部署（如深空任务）所需的真正硬件自主性。
AI.method: 核心方法为拓扑掩码Transformer（Topology-Masked Transformer, TMT）：1）将数字电路建模为可编程LUT组成的有向无环图（DAG），每个门节点携带状态向量（包含LUT对数、潜在记忆、正弦位置编码、误差反馈）；2）通过单一共享权重Transformer块在拓扑掩码限制的局部邻域上进行消息传递，迭代T步形成权重绑定的深度残差网络；3）训练采用池化元学习+时间反向传播（BPTT），结合连续LUT松弛实现可微电路执行；4）每节点接收标量误差反馈实现去中心化信用分配；5）架构具有尺度无关性——参数数量与电路规模无关。
AI.result: 在12位布尔任务（位反转、分割加法、分割乘法）上的实验表明：1）固定拓扑下TMT可在无故障时收敛至接近全局反向传播基线，训练时引入损伤后能适应性地在损伤下保持功能；2）软错误恢复方面，TMT在远超训练规模的损伤下（40门射击式损伤）实现>99.99%硬精度恢复，且Hamming编辑距离与扰动规模无关；3）UMAP可视化显示TMT发现离散功能聚类（中性景观），而反向传播产生单一聚类，证明利用了简并解空间；4）随机拓扑训练下策略在位反转任务上泛化良好；5）尺度无关性方面，随机拓扑训练出的策略在比训练规模宽1.7倍（264→450+节点）的电路上准确率反而提升，证明扩展能力是习得特性而非纯架构特征。
AI.conclusion: 本文将NCA范式从网格模式形成扩展至图上功能逻辑生成，证明数字电路可通过去中心化、拓扑掩码Transformer自主自组装、自修复并在结构尺度间泛化路由策略。对软错误可学习通用修复策略而非记忆特定故障模式，驱动电路进入功能等价的新局部最小值（类似生物多尺度能力）。未来方向包括引入随机游走结构编码丰富拓扑上下文、采用Perceiver IO式交叉注意力实现数据感知推理、原生稀疏注意力扩展到千门级电路，以及赋予TMT结构性生长/剪枝/重连能力，最终实现结构与功能解耦的自组织计算基底。

title: Beyond the Hivemind: Escaping LLM Homogeneity via Meta-Persona Anchoring and Sequential Temperature Scaling
summary: Recent studies have identified an ``Artificial Hivemind'' effect in Large Language Models (LLMs) causing models to converge on a narrow, homogenized consensus even for open questions. This semantic collapse limits the diversity of AI, resulting in high inter-response similarity ($\approx 0.80-0.90$) even under high-temperature sampling. In this paper, we propose a novel mitigation framework to increase diversity: Meta-Persona Anchoring combined with Filtered Temperature Scaling (FTS). Our approach utilizes a two-stage generation process: first, the model is prompted to self-select a unique, idiosyncratic persona to anchor its starting point; second, we apply a dual-stage sampling sieve, utilizing Top-$p$ filtering to preserve grammatical validity followed by extreme temperature scaling ($T \ge 4.0$) on the surviving candidates to explore the broadened probability distribution. We evaluate our method using the INFINITY-CHAT dataset on state-of-the-art open weight models under $\sim$20B parameters. Our results demonstrate a significant reduction in semantic convergence, with average pairwise cosine similarity dropping from ($\approx 0.85$) to ($\approx 0.65$). Our scheme achieves a majority of questions below the 0.7 threshold, effectively reducing the gap between artificial mode collapse and human-level typological diversity. We provide our implementation as an open-source framework to enable more diverse and creative AI deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）输出同质化（"人工蜂群思维"效应）问题，提出了一种名为"元人格锚定 + 过滤式温度缩放"的双阶段生成框架。该框架通过让模型自主选择独特人格视角（Meta-Persona Anchoring）并采用先 Top-p 过滤再极端温度缩放（T≥4.0）的解耦采样策略（Filtered Temperature Scaling, FTS），在保持语言连贯性的同时显著降低响应间的语义相似度。
AI.motivation: 经过 RLHF 等对齐训练后，LLM 在开放式问题上的输出趋于高度同质化（Inter-Response Cosine Similarity 达 0.80–0.90），这种现象被称为"人工蜂群思维"（Artificial Hivemind）。已有研究多认为单纯靠采样或提示工程无法破解此问题——采样方法无法区分创造性多样性与随机噪声，人格提示则只是"同一面孔上的不同面具"。本文认为这两类方法失败的根本原因在于它们孤立使用且缺乏概率缩放。
AI.method: 方法分为两个互补组件：(1) **过滤式温度缩放（FTS）**：两阶段 logit 变换——首先在 T=1.0 下应用 Top-p 核采样锁定语义有效候选集 V^(p)，再对该候选集施加 T≥4.0 的极端温度缩放，从而在保留语法有效性的同时探索低概率尾部；(2) **元人格锚定（Meta-Persona Anchoring）**：在生成回答前，通过系统级提示要求模型自主随机选择并描述一个独特的人格角色作为语义锚点 C_persona，使条件概率 P(S|Query, C_persona) ≠ P(S|Query, C_default)。两者协同——FTS 提供统计动能，元人格提供独特视角。
AI.result: 在 5 个 ≤20B 参数的开源模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-14B、Gemma-4-E4B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B）上使用 INFINITY-CHAT 数据集评估：(1) 模型内 IRCS 从约 0.85 降至约 0.65，多数问题低于 0.7 阈值；(2) 蒸馏推理模型 DeepSeek 从基线 0.880 降至 0.625，效果最显著；(3) T=4.0 后提升出现明显多样性收益平台；(4) 模型间共识平均 IRCS 也降至 0.6 以下；(5) GPT-4o-mini 评判的连贯性平均分约 7–7.5，未出现显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明 LLM 中的"人工蜂群思维"并非不可破除的结构性局限，而是采样策略与语义方向脱节造成的副作用。通过将结构自由（FTS）与语义锚定（Meta-Persona）协同结合，可在不牺牲语言连贯性与安全对齐的前提下恢复模型潜在的多样性。该方法计算开销可忽略，已开源。该工作为开发更具多样性和创造性的 AI 部署提供了实用框架。

title: HyperAgent: Planning and Acting over Tool-Schema Hypergraphs for Tool-Use LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external tools to complete complex real-world tasks. However, reliable tool-use planning remains challenging due to the limitations of implicit reasoning and the evolving nature of real-world execution environments. Existing tool-use agents typically rely on LLMs to infer tool compositions from textual descriptions, which can lead to inefficient exploration and unreliable execution in complex tasks. To address these challenges, we model tool relations at the schema level and construct a directed Tool--Schema Hypergraph, in which tools are represented as hyperedges from their required input-schema nodes to their output-schema nodes. Furthermore, we propose HyperAgent, a Tool--Schema Hypergraph-guided framework for dynamic planning and execution. Given a task, HyperAgent first extracts a task-relevant tool context graph and uses it to guide the construction of a schema-aware Task DAG. During execution, HyperAgent dynamically realizes each subtask by constructing a state-conditioned tool support graph through deficit-oriented expansion, which identifies unresolved requirements and retrieves supporting producer tools according to the current agent state. Experiments on AppWorld demonstrate that HyperAgent improves task completion performance while reducing redundant API calls, LLM interactions, and token consumption compared with existing agent baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyperAgent，一种基于工具-模式超图（Tool-Schema Hypergraph）的LLM工具使用代理框架，通过建模工具间细粒度的参数级依赖关系，实现动态规划与执行，在AppWorld基准上显著提升任务完成率并降低API调用、LLM交互和token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的工具使用代理主要依赖文本描述隐式推理工具组合，存在两大局限：（1）让LLM从大量工具文档中推断可执行工具链不可靠，尤其难以识别产生必需输入的上游工具；（2）现有图方法仅建模粗粒度工具依赖，未明确参数级数据流，且将工具路径静态规划，忽略了执行状态的动态变化。
AI.method: 1. **工具-模式超图（TSH）构建**：基于In-N-Out数据集，将每个API工具建模为从输入模式节点到输出模式及效果节点的有向超边，并保留端口级模式依赖链接，通过GPT-4o与人工标注补充环境前提与状态效果节点；2. **任务级规划**：通过操作级语义相似度检索种子超边，结合模式节点锚定和依赖引导的反向扩展构建Tool Context Graph，并序列化为LLM提示以生成Task DAG；3. **子任务执行与验证**：按拓扑顺序选取就绪子任务，根据执行轨迹验证完成状态，未完成则精化Task DAG；4. **工具级规划**：提出Deficit-Oriented Expansion（DOE），从候选终端工具出发，基于当前代理状态S_ℓ迭代扩展生成Tool Support Subgraph，优先选择能解决赤字集（未满足输入需求）的生产工具，采用beam search保留赤字最小的候选。
AI.result: 在AppWorld基准（750个任务）上，HyperAgent（GPT-4o）取得Test-N TGC 67.1%/SGC 55.9%、Test-C TGC 40.2%/SGC 26.1%，超过ReAct、PlanExec、FullCodeRefl等NFT方法及多数SFT/DPO/RL训练的代理（如SFT-GT的TGC仅6.2%/0.8%）；同时显著减少API调用次数、LLM交互轮次和token消耗。消融实验表明Tool Context Graph与Tool Support Subgraph均为关键组件，且在hop=2、K=3时取得最佳平衡。上下文质量评估显示HyperAgent恢复隐式前置工具的能力显著优于In-N-Out图检索与纯语义Top-K检索。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模工具间细粒度的模式级依赖关系能够有效补充LLM的语义推理能力，使工具使用规划在动态变化的代理状态下更加可靠和高效；基于超图的Tool Context Graph与状态条件化的Support Subgraph是提升任务完成率、降低冗余探索的关键机制。

title: Explainable AI for the EU Right to Explanation: A Systematic Review of the Law-XAI Translation Gap
comment: Accepted at the 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics and Society (AIES-26)
summary: When algorithms make or influence consequential decisions---about loan eligibility, hiring, or healthcare---EU law grants affected individuals a Right to Explanation. Yet whether (and how) Explainable AI (XAI) can satisfy this right in practice remains poorly understood, with direct implications for individuals' ability to contest automated decisions that affect their lives. This paper presents a systematic literature review of XAI in the context of the EU Right to Explanation, with particular focus on Art. 15(1)(h) GDPR, Art. 86 AI Act (AIA), and related instruments. We consider papers published from 2024 onwards, as the final version of the AIA was published in July 2024---with Art. 86 being added late. From 2643 initial records identified by a deliberately broad search, we review 57 full texts, of which only 19 papers demonstrate substantive integration of both legal and technical perspectives, showing gaps in the interdisciplinary synthesis of the current regulatory framework. We document three problematic patterns across the corpus: Most misidentify the GDPR legal basis; few engage with the CJEU's Dun & Bradstreet judgment (likely due to publication timing); and the distinction between explanation form (governed by addressee) and content (governed by legal purpose) is often conflated. We conceptualize this as the Addressee/Purpose Framework, propose a four-phase blueprint for operationalization, and identify six concrete open research questions. Without further progress, the Right to Explanation risks remaining a formal obligation without a technically realizable path to compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文是对欧盟"解释权"(Right to Explanation)与可解释人工智能(XAI)交叉领域的系统性文献综述。通过PRISMA方法筛选2643篇文献(2024年后),最终仅19篇同时实质性融合了法律与技术视角。文章识别出三大问题模式:多数文献错误认定GDPR法律依据、忽视CJEU的Dun & Bradstreet判决、混淆"解释形式"(由受众决定)与"解释内容"(由法律目的决定)。作者提出"受众/目的框架"(Addressee/Purpose Framework)和四阶段操作蓝图,并提出六个开放性研究问题,警示若不取得进展,"解释权"将沦为无法技术落地的形式义务。
AI.motivation: 欧盟法律赋予个人对自动化决策(信贷、就业、医疗等)的"解释权",但XAI技术能否真正满足该权利在实践中尚不清晰。若"解释权"缺乏可技术实现路径,将直接影响个人对自动化决策提出异议的能力。文章旨在系统梳理当前学术研究在法律与技术之间的综合(翻译)差距,为从业者提供可操作的设计指引,并指出未来研究方向。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA方法进行系统文献综述(SLR)。检索Web of Science和Scopus两个数据库,使用结合XAI术语与欧盟法律名称的检索式。检索时间为2026年3月23日。初始获得2643条记录(去重并剔除专利后),使用ASReview进行标题/摘要筛选(技术背景评审员),设置40篇连续无关记录的停止准则。60篇进入全文检索,57篇进行全文评估,由法律背景与技术背景两位评审员根据预设纳入排除标准(表1)独立筛选。最终19篇同时实质性融合法律与技术视角的文献被纳入分析。沿四个维度编码:XAI分类方案、解释权法律依据、解释形式处理、解释目的/内容处理。
AI.result: 在19篇纳入文献中发现:1)多数文献错误地将GDPR解释权依据定为Art. 22而非Art. 15(1)(h),或将Recital 71作为唯一依据;2)对CJEU Dun & Bradstreet判决(2025年2月27日)的吸收缓慢——14篇2025/2026年文献中仅5篇引用,反映学术出版时滞;3)文献普遍混淆"解释形式"与"解释内容",未将"受众"(决定形式)与"法律目的"(决定内容)作为独立维度。基于此,作者提出:(a) "受众/目的框架"——Art. 12(1) GDPR规制形式,实质性条款(Art. 15(1)(h) GDPR、Art. 86 AIA、Art. 18(8)(a) CCD)规制内容;(b) 四阶段操作蓝图——识别适用要求→分解可量化子要求→评估XAI方法→论证权衡与(非)履行;(c) 六大开放研究问题,涵盖GDPR与AIA条款互动、"有意义"标准操作化、XAI法律感知评估基准、解释范围与正确性、基础模型可解释性、Art. 86 AIA标准化路径。此外明确指出:若现有XAI方法无法同时满足形式与内容要求,系统不应在高风险领域部署。
AI.conclusion: 该综述证实,欧盟法律虽已确立解释义务,但目前缺乏将法律要求转化为可操作XAI规格的共享参考框架。法律与XAI社区之间形成结构性僵局——从业者等待具体规范指导,法学家与标准化机构等待成熟技术方案。论文警告两个风险极端:(1)接受现成但技术欠佳的XAI方案,形成"虚假合规";(2)在受监管场景中完全回避黑盒AI,后者更易法律辩护但与AIA促进创新的目标相矛盾。若无跨法律、标准化与技术社区的协同进展,"解释权"将沦为无法落地的形式义务,代价或由部署AI的企业或受影响个人承担。论文还讨论了"合规表演"、合规负担不均衡(利好大型企业、损害中小企业)以及学术影响不对称等伦理风险。

title: Predictive Set Theory: A Generative Framework for Cognitive Architecture with Operationalized Core Mechanisms
comment: 103 pages. This preprint establishes the theoretical framework of Predictive Set Theory, providing a generative design specification for cognitive architecture. Comments welcome
summary: Predictive processing theories portray the brain as a hierarchical prediction engine that minimizes prediction error, yet they lack operational definitions for the structure of a "prediction," the standardized response to a prediction error, and the mechanism that maintains consistency across successive updates. Bayesian cognitive science attempts to subsume all uncertainty under probabilistic belief updating, but it presupposes a closed hypothesis space and provides no generative account of how the objects over which probabilities are distributed become discrete, identifiable referents in the first place. This paper introduces Predictive Set Theory (PST), a formal generative framework that reconstructs cognitive architecture from first principles. PST anchors cognition in a minimal set of operations---a sensor formalized as an identity function, set-theoretic state refresh, and three fundamental forms of reference chains (reference, counter-reference, and semi-reference)---and rigorously derives core cognitive functions including state sequences, demand, comparison, efficiency, and finite-horizon probabilistic planning. Rather than modeling neural mechanisms, PST constitutes a design specification for any system that must maintain internal consistency while acting under incomplete information and irreversible risk. The framework offers novel resolutions to classical problems such as Russell's paradox, the cognitive status of Gödelian incompleteness, the grounding of negative feedback, and the comprehension of film editing. The primary purpose of this paper is to establish, through the public academic record, the originality and completeness of the Predictive Set Theory framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出预测集合论（PST），一种从第一性原理重构认知架构的形式生成框架。PST以传感器恒等函数、集合论状态刷新和三种基本参考链（参考、反参考、半参考）为最小操作集，严格推导出状态序列、需求、比较、效率和有限视野概率规划等核心认知功能。该框架为预测处理理论中的"预测"结构、贝叶斯认知科学中的封闭假设空间问题提供了新解决方案，并重新解释了罗素悖论、哥德尔不完备性、负反馈和电影剪辑理解等经典问题。
AI.motivation: 现有认知科学框架存在两个根本缺陷：（1）预测处理理论缺乏对"预测"结构、预测错误的标准化响应以及跨更新一致性维护机制的操作性定义；（2）贝叶斯认知科学预设封闭的假设空间，未能解释概率分布的对象如何首先成为离散的、可识别的指称对象。此外，传统决策理论将"比较"视为基本操作原语，却未解释其生成来源。本文旨在从集合论和参考链操作的第一性原理出发，构建一个涵盖感知、预测、决策、学习的最小认知架构。
AI.method: PST采用公理化生成方法，从一致性需求这一架构先决条件出发，通过以下逻辑链进行严格推导：（1）通过无限参考链的收敛性分析（区分无穷非重复发散和循环发散两种模式），证明参考链必须默认收敛至自指固定点，从而确立"x=x"的生成必然性；（2）将传感器形式化为恒等函数S(i)=i，作为架构中唯一的独立变量；（3）证明动作规划函数f(K_t)=A_t必须为依赖已知状态集的条件依赖变量，建立已知/未知状态的不对称定理；（4）通过标准构造定理证明任何确定性函数必嵌入以自身为最优解的最小需求约束Φ_f(K,A)=-‖A-f(K)‖²；（5）证明纯计算限制在传感器限制信息出现时必然解除，比较操作绕过元语言困境不可避免地出现；（6）通过效率折线f_d(L)参数化和有限视野递归公式V_h(s)=max_a ΣP(s'|s,a)[η(s')+V_{h-1}(s')]实现完整规划模型。
AI.result: PST取得了以下理论成果：（1）将罗素悖论归约为循环发散参考链（类比Grandi级数），系统可识别非收敛性并悬置该构造而不致逻辑崩溃；（2）将哥德尔不完备性重新诠释为反参考链自指时的必然形式边界；（3）从序列距离与源于躯体信号的需求权重的结合中导出负反馈的量化基础；（4）将电影剪辑理解解释为观众主动部署参考链和序列验证过程以维持跨镜头物体同一性；（5）证明跨认知主体的未知状态不可比较，因为各自传感器的输出空间不可互通。框架以最少的原语（传感器、动作规划函数、三种参考链、需求函数、效率折线）和最少的公理完成了从感知到行为的完整推导链。
AI.conclusion: PST确立了认知架构的完整生成推导链：从一致性需求→参考链收敛至自指→传感器恒等操作S(i)=i→传感器与动作规划函数的区分→已知/未知不对称定理→状态刷新的累积扩展→已知状态序列与状态序列的区分→相对未知的集合差定义→需求作为函数最小约束→纯计算限制的解除→需求与过程的分离引入效率维度→选择集的不可避免扩展→比较的生成必然性→有限视野概率规划。每一步均必要且不可逃避。该框架作为设计规范而非神经机制模型，为具有内在安全约束的人工认知系统设计提供了严格的理论基础。本文的主要目的是通过公开学术记录确立PST框架的原创性和完整性。

title: Towards a new paradigm of scientific discovery with socialized artificial intelligence
summary: Scientific discovery has advanced through successive transformations in the organization of knowledge. Observation and experimentation established the empirical foundations of science. Theory made it possible to derive general principles from particular phenomena. Computation extended inquiry into systems beyond direct observation, while data-intensive methods opened new spaces of pattern and prediction. Science now confronts a different frontier. The central challenge is no longer simply to produce more information, but to organize expanding knowledge, reasoning, and evidence into a coherent process of discovery. Here, we introduce Bridging Literature, Agents, and Zero-gap Experimentation (BLAZE), a paradigm of socialized scientific intelligence. BLAZE conceives AI not as an assistant for isolated research tasks, but as an organizational infrastructure for scientific discovery. It connects persistent knowledge, collective reasoning, empirical validation, and human judgment within a continuous research lifecycle, transforming fragmented activities into a cumulative process of inquiry, criticism, and revision. The central premise of BLAZE is that scientific intelligence does not arise from computation alone. It emerges from the sustained interaction among knowledge, hypotheses, experiments, and collective verification. By organizing humans and machines within a shared scientific process, BLAZE makes discovery more traceable, reproducible, and cumulative while preserving human creativity, judgment, and responsibility. Socialized scientific intelligence may provide a foundation for the next era of science. Its purpose is not to replace human discovery, but to extend the scale, depth, and continuity of collective scientific inquiry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BLAZE（桥接文献、智能体与零间隙实验）范式，将AI重新定位为科学发现的组织性基础设施而非孤立任务助手，通过持久知识层、智能体社会层、工具执行层和评估治理层四层架构，将人类与机器组织进共享的、持续的研究生命周期，实现可追溯、可复现、可累积的社会化科学智能。
AI.motivation: 当前AI辅助科研面临四大瓶颈：临时性科学记忆（知识与中间结果无法跨研究周期持续保留）、假设-证据-结论连续性断裂、角色分化与责任归属不足的人机协作、以及关键决策中人类权威边界模糊。尽管已有自动化研究系统整合了文献分析、假设生成、代码执行与写作等流程，但尚未解决科学发现的组织性问题。论文认为科学智能的核心挑战已从"生产更多信息"转向"将不断扩展的知识、推理与证据组织进连贯的发现过程"。
AI.method: BLAZE采用四层架构：（1）知识与记忆层——版本化、溯源感知的文献库（截至2026年7月含158,338篇论文、9.54百万RAG块、3.45百万实体），支持公开/私有材料分离与影子知识图谱验证；（2）智能体社会层——以PI、文献、方法学家、怀疑者、实验、统计、写作、评审与伦理智能体构成的研究社区，通过提出-挑战-修订-裁定协议解决冲突；（3）工具与执行层——将研究计划编译为有向实验图G_exp=(V,E_dep,E_prov,E_claim)，遵循可比性、溯源性与校准性三原则；（4）评估与治理层——通过五个检查点（选题、立项、实验、投稿、伦理/署名）保留人类权威。核心数据结构为Research Object R=⟨q,H,P,G,E,C,V,A,S,Π⟩，通过守卫状态转移T_i:R_t→R_{t+1}驱动。AutoPaper以证据包P=(p,s,t,π,ρ,c,e,σ,κ,f,v,d,h)为写作基底，通过证据来源、引用、蕴含、图表与对冲五类验证器约束每个候选声明；声明处置规则为接受、降级、拒绝或退回积压。预设50名学生的随机对照试验检验AI反馈对主要问题检测的影响。
AI.result: 基于冻结本地包的维度评分：AutoPaper在研究阶段完整性（25/25）、定量验证（29/30）、迭代探索（19/20）三项领先，ARIS在证据治理（24/25）领先。在冰架PINN反演同任务对比中，BLAZE完成2,004次基线运行与36种子PCD实验（AUROC=1.000，Spearman=0.871），11页TIP风格手稿通过124/124交付检查；ARIS通过协议隔离的B1-B5实验（950+60+150+90次运行）展现估计量分离与阴性结果保留。知识库在机构生产力分析任务上提供完整可行性：覆盖12个会议（1978-2026）、73.3万论文-作者链接（机构覆盖率72.16%）、41.22%跨机构协作率，30秒内通过API重现结果，而Sciverse缺乏文档化的聚合工作流。论文明确声明这些结果不构成科学可靠性、效率或质量的普适性提升证据。
AI.conclusion: BLAZE提出科学自主性不属于孤立的"人工智能科学家"，而属于能记忆、质疑、测试、纠正并自我治理的研究组织。论文区分能力扩展与权限扩展——前者是技术问题，后者必须通过额外验证、约束收紧与可问责的人类所有权来实现。当前部署范围限于D0阶段（文献、代码、计算实验、模拟、证据约束写作与评审支持），物理实验D1-D3仍为路线图而非已实现能力。研究计划、合著者身份、投稿与最终声明均保留人类审批权限。BLAZE分配科学工作而不分散科学责任，旨在构建人机共享的探究过程。

title: BAP-SQL: Budget-Aware Observation Planning for Agentic Text-to-SQL
summary: Tool-using agents do not merely consume observations: their actions determine what arrives next. In agentic text-to-SQL, a broad query can spend context and database work before useful evidence appears, while post-hoc compression cannot recover omitted rows or expended work. We present BAP-SQL, which treats observation formation as a budget-control stage: it estimates query risk, rewrites SQL when useful, and delegates hard limits to an independent runtime shield. Across general 4B, specialized FINER-SQL 4B, and 7B backbones, BAP-SQL improves tight-budget success. On the primary BIRD-derived setting, it gains 3.4/3.6 percentage points over matched SFT while using 4.5/5.0% fewer tokens. Matched retraining and task-level transfer associate the gain with policy-visible planning and budget-sensitive rescue. The benefit attenuates as model capability and budget increase, reverses at the loosest setting, and does not reduce database work.

AI.tldr: BAP-SQL将观测形成视为智能体Text-to-SQL任务中的预算控制阶段：通过执行前查询规划（含EXPLAIN、零行探针、目录统计的p50/p95估计）、选择性SQL重写、以及独立运行时屏蔽器（runtime shield）执行硬性限制。在通用4B、专业化FINER-SQL 4B及7B骨干上，紧预算（XS/S）下预算化成功率提升3.4-3.6个百分点，同时token使用减少4.5-5.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有工具调用智能体的工作存在两个缺口：(1) 后置上下文控制（post-hoc context control）无法"退还"数据库已消耗的工作，也无法恢复被原查询遗漏的行；(2) 正确性导向的SQL训练未决定"下一条观测是否负担得起"。作者洞察到：SQL动作本身就是一个预算控制决策——选择性聚合会改变结果基数、结果token以及下游证据（在观测产生之前）。
AI.method: 1) 将问题形式化为联合上下文/查询/结果token/数据库工作量四种预算的多回合决策过程，预算阶梯XS-L四档冻结后比较；2) 策略可在每回合执行Inspect/Estimate/Rewrite/Execute/Manage/Answer/Abstain等类型化动作；3) 执行前规划：estimate_query组合EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN、LIMIT 0探针与目录统计，返回行数、结果token、数据库工作量的p50/p95；4) 运行时屏蔽器配置VM步/行/字节/结果token上限，作为可行性硬保证；5) 可恢复证据：Archive/Compress/Discard三档管理活动上下文与累积计费；6) 训练：8,192条SFT回合对+ LoRA-32适配器；RL阶段采用正确性门控效率整形奖励R=1[correct∧feasible]·(1+0.4e)·r_tool(m,n)，使用GRPO在线难度过滤，每任务-预算采样8次。
AI.result: 主结果（BIRD-衍生验证集）：BAP-SQL RL在XS/S获得最高预算化成功率34.8%/37.6%，相比匹配SFT提升+3.4/+3.6 pp，token减少4.5%/5.0%（约66/84 token/回合），前沿分数37.9 pp（最高）。相对BACM-RL（后置控制）：+1.4/+1.6 pp，95%CI [0.8,2.0]/[0.9,2.3]。FINER-SQL-4B迁移：XS/S提升+3.4/+3.0 pp，CI [2.0,4.8]/[1.6,4.4]，代价是多用约4% token。消融：策略可见规划与奖励整形存在+1.8/+1.4 pp的交互效应。边界：优势随模型能力与预算增大而衰减，L预算下匹配SQL-RL反超1.4 pp；7B模型上XS/S增益降至+2.1/+1.8 pp；未减少数据库工作量（池化后约+0.8%）。
AI.conclusion: 预执行观测规划（pre-execution observation planning）是面向更强任务策略与后置上下文控制的有针对性补充；对于工具调用智能体而言，凡"动作决定下一观测成本与内容"者皆可适用此设计原则。规划效应集中于预算敏感的失败案例上，并与效率奖励呈现互补交互；其优势具有"紧预算+弱骨干"特异性——在更宽松预算或更强生成器下效益递减甚至反转。

title: VeriTrace: Human-Like Temporal Exploration Completes Agentic Action Space
summary: Large language models have shown promise for automated Verilog RTL generation, yet state-of-the-art multi-agent systems plateau at ~95% accuracy on standard benchmarks. We trace this ceiling to an incomplete debugging action space: existing systems restrict which signals the agent can inspect, which time windows it can query, or both, reducing debugging to pattern matching on a narrow, predetermined view of circuit behavior rather than hypothesis-driven root-cause analysis. We present VeriTrace, a multi-agent system whose Inspector agent operates over a complete debugging action space, with independent control over signal selection, time-window bounds, and iteration depth. This capability, which we term Agentic Temporal Exploration, enables the agent to form hypotheses about failure causes, query the waveform for evidence, and refine its understanding iteratively, mirroring the exploratory process of human verification engineers. VeriTrace achieves 100\% Pass@1 on VerilogEval-V2, the first system to attain perfect functional correctness on this benchmark. On a shared Claude Sonnet 4.0 backbone, VeriTrace outperforms the strongest reproduced baseline by +5.1%, demonstrating that debugging agency closes the final accuracy gap.

AI.tldr: VeriTrace 是一个用于 Verilog RTL 生成的多智能体系统，通过引入"代理时序探索"（Agentic Temporal Exploration）机制，让 Inspector 智能体在调试过程中拥有对信号选择、时间窗口和迭代深度的完全控制权。该系统在 VerilogEval-V2 基准上首次实现了 100% Pass@1 的完美功能正确率。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体 RTL 生成系统在标准基准上停滞于约 95% 准确率，其根本原因在于调试动作空间不完整：现有系统限制了智能体能检查的信号种类、可查询的时间窗口或两者皆有，导致调试退化为对狭窄预定义电路行为的模式匹配，而非基于假设的根因分析。论文主张"调试动作空间的完整性"是当前多智能体 RTL 生成的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: VeriTrace 采用确定性控制流的多智能体架构，模拟人类验证工程师的工作流：Testbench Agent 修改黄金测试台以导出所有波形；RTL Agent 从规格生成模块；若仿真失败则进入 Inspector-Debugger 闭环循环。核心创新在于 Inspector 智能体，它基于 ReAct 范式实现"代理时序探索"——独立控制信号选择、时间窗口边界和迭代深度，通过 ω_i = Trace(W, σ_i, [t_start, t_end]) 查询波形快照，形成假设→查询→精化假设的迭代过程，并最终生成 Inspector Report 供 RTL Debugger 进行定向修复。Debugger 采用单调递减错配数的回滚机制以防止回归。
AI.result: 在 VerilogEval-V2（156 个 Verilog 编码问题）上：使用 Claude Sonnet 4.5 时达到 100% Pass@1，是首个在该基准实现完美功能正确率的系统；使用相同的 Claude Sonnet 4.0 骨干网络时达到 97.4%，比复现的 MAGE 基线（92.3%）高出 +5.1%。消融实验表明，Inspector 使总 token 消耗减少约 18%，并且在 FSM 调试密集型问题上表现尤为突出（如 Prob155 的 token 消耗从 619k 降至 110k）。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了调试代理能力（debugging agency）——而非仅仅是更丰富的反馈——是缩小基于 LLM 的 RTL 生成最终准确率差距的关键。VeriTrace 实现了完整的调试动作空间，使假设驱动的诊断成为可能。未来工作将把代理时序探索扩展到多模块设计、动态智能体分配以及工业级规模的场景。

title: Interpreting Black-Box Large Language Models with Sentence-Level Energy Landscapes
summary: The widespread adoption of proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) accessed strictly through closed APIs has created a critical challenge for responsible deployment: a fundamental lack of interpretability. To address this, we propose a model-agnostic, post-hoc attribution interpreter operating at the sentence level. Our approach trains an Energy-Based Model (EBM) as a surrogate to capture the LLM's internal conceptual consistency between prompts and responses. This energy landscape guides the training of a lightweight interpreter network. Uniquely, our interpreter operates as a standalone tool; once trained, it quantifies the influence of prompt sentences on a user-specified target output without requiring further API queries to the LLM. By globally training a local interpreter across diverse inputs, our framework captures broader generation patterns and mitigates instance-specific biases. Experiments demonstrate that our EBM accurately simulates the target LLM, allowing the interpreter to effectively identify the prompt sentences most influential in generating specific target outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ESCI（Energy-Based Concept-Level Surrogate Interpreter），一种面向黑盒大语言模型的、模型无关的句子级事后归因解释器。其核心思想是：先训练一个基于 Transformer 的能量模型（EBM）作为目标 LLM 的可微分代理，在"概念空间"中度量 prompt-响应对的概念一致性；再利用该能量景观指导训练一个轻量级解释网络，输出对目标输出最有影响的 prompt 句子的二值掩码。一旦训练完成，解释器无需再调用 LLM API，即可独立运行。
AI.motivation: 商用黑盒 LLM（仅通过闭源 API 访问）存在严重的可解释性缺失问题，阻碍其在医疗、法律等高风险领域的负责任部署。现有方法各有局限：白盒方法（梯度、注意力）无法用于闭源 API；注意力权重被证不忠实；LIME 等扰动方法在生成任务上计算代价过高；CoT 等自我解释存在循环推理和虚构问题；以往的特征选择方法针对判别式模型设计，不适用于高维交互式文本输出。本文旨在解决黑盒生成模型的事后归因难题，并指出传统 token 级别过于细粒度，应提升到句子级别以获得"完整命题"作为分析单元。
AI.method: 框架分两阶段：（1）**EBM 代理预训练**：使用 spaCy 分句，Sentence-BERT（all-mpnet-base-v2）冻结嵌入，通过自注意力投影到动态"概念空间"，再用交叉注意力建模输入-输出交互，最后由 MLP 输出标量能量。训练采用双目标 InfoNCE 损失——fidelity 项将目标 LLM 输出与人类/其他 LM 响应作全局负样本；local dependency 项通过 partial_response_dep 和 partial_prompt_dep 采样器强制局部因果精度；二者加权 λ=0.9 形成 Hybrid 目标。（2）**解释器训练**：架构与 EBM 类似但仅保留目标输出概念；采用 Gumbel-Softmax 实现可微 top-K 选择；优化目标是最大化所选子集与剔除子集间的能量差；同时采用交替优化定期用掩码 prompt 查询目标 LLM 生成新样本以缓解分布偏移。
AI.result: 在 HC3 数据集上对 GPT-4o-Mini 进行解释：（1）EBM 消融显示 M_Hybrid 在四个维度上综合最优——IR@1=84.77%，SNR=7.15（5× 提升），反事实准确率=92.40%，nDCG@3=0.796；（2）归因合理性方面，~71M 参数的 ESCI 与 GPT-J-6B/Gemini-2.5-Flash 等大模型 oracle 排名对齐度有竞争力，能区分风格驱动（如 "Explain like I'm five"）与语义内容；（3）因果忠实性方面，ESCI 的生成充分性=0.409、综合性=0.214、忠实性 Gap=0.195，接近 LIME（0.245）但避免了每次推理需数十次 API 调用；仅需 ~400 次 prompt 评估即可摊销训练成本。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明将分析单元从 token 提升到句子、并以能量模型构建目标 LLM 的可微代理，是黑盒生成模型可解释性的一种可行且可扩展路径。Hybrid 目标（fidelity + local dependency）平衡了全局分布学习与局部因果精度。ESCI 在 O(1) 推理复杂度下接近扰动方法的精度，确立了基于能量代理的归因框架在高容量、实时部署场景的实用价值。但仍存在预训练开销大、任务特定、缺乏机制层面的真实验证等问题。

title: Hypercubes, Hyperplanes, and Constraint-Induced Complexity Collapse in Atomic Concept Learning
summary: We revisit higher-arity atomic concept learning through the geometry of hypercubes and hyperplanes of ground instances. Our starting point is the observation that the ambient r-dimensional hypercube of ground atoms is not structurally uniform. Its logical complexity is organized by hyperplanes: every hyperplane other than the full diagonal collapses into finitely many elementary-equivalence classes, with a bound independent of the term depth, while the full diagonal is exceptional and its class count grows without bound. This asymmetry is not merely geometric. It reflects the reduction-theoretic structure of the concepts themselves. Building on a higher-dimensional framework developed in the author's earlier work, we reinterpret these results through canonical simple concepts, minimal orderings, and representative reductions. This yields a taxonomy of hyperplane behavior in higher dimensions and shows that complexity is localized rather than spread uniformly through the instance space. The paper includes a fully worked binary case, an explicit treatment of the ternary hypercube, and an unpacked account of the reduction machinery that drives the collapse. The three-dimensional case already exhibits the essential phenomenon of orthogonal families, partial diagonals, and the exceptional full diagonal. This geometric-logical perspective clarifies where complexity is concentrated in atomic concept learning and suggests a modern interpretation in terms of constrained hypothesis spaces and structured classification.

AI.tldr: 本文从超立方体与超平面的几何视角重新审视高元（higher-arity）原子概念学习，证明：除"完全对角线"（full diagonal）外的每个超平面上的概念，在初等等价意义下仅有与项深度n无关的有界多个等价类；而完全对角线上的等价类数量随n增长而无界增长。论文通过二元情形的完整分类（约限、轴射线、对角射线、点）、三元超立方的显式处理以及归约机制，阐明了复杂度是局部化的而非均匀分布，并给出学习论（受限假设空间）解读。
AI.motivation: 逻辑概念类的可学习性不仅取决于实例空间的规模，还取决于其内部结构。已有工作表明结构约束能显著降低学习复杂度，但这种"塌缩"（collapse）在哪里发生、为何发生、程度如何，缺乏清晰的几何刻画。本文旨在通过超立方体与超平面的几何语言，给出高元原子概念学习中复杂度分布的精确结构读法，明确指出完全对角线是唯一例外区域，并联系当代受限假设空间的讨论。
AI.method: 1. 以一个常量a与一个一元函数f生成深度至n的项集T_n；r元谓词P的基原子构成r维离散超立方体H_{r,n}=T_n^r。2. 按坐标相等条件定义超平面：正交代数（钉住坐标）、对角（部分坐标相等）、完全对角线Δ_r（全部坐标相等）。3. 引入归约机制：约化同态→典范概念（附带的超图的极小化约态）→初等等价与典范同构的对应。4. 利用 Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé 论证：沿自由方向，超出φ可检测阈值的深度信息冗余，可被约化丢弃；沿完全对角线，位移（displacement）是不变式，不可丢弃。5. 分别完整处理二元情形（四种形态的穷举）与三元情形（部分对角与完全对角的递归关系）。
AI.result: 主定理（超平面分类定理）：对任意超平面H≠Δ_r，其上由φ诱导的概念落至至多N(r)个初等等价类，N(r)仅依赖于r与φ，与n无关；对完全对角线Δ_r，不存在关于n一致的界，等价类数随n增长无界。推论：逻辑复杂度在超立方体中是局部化的，集中在完全对角线。二元分类显示只有"对角射线"由坐标间关系描述，其余三类（约限、轴射线、点）均用独立坐标数据描述——这正是定理的二元原型。三元情形显示部分对角仍是规则的，其内部的完全对角线才是唯一例外，分类具有递归性。
AI.conclusion: 本文以纯几何-逻辑视角恢复高元原子概念可学习性框架，提出"约束诱导的复杂度塌缩"作为统一解读：在一阶约束下，超立方体的规则区域塌缩为有界类族，唯有完全对角线保留持续复杂度。该结论为受限假设空间与结构化分类提供了精确定位——远离对角线区域，假设空间被有界类数控制，可使用基于代表者的分类器；对角线区域则需更丰富的表示以处理高阶特征交互。开放问题：将该方法推广到多个一元函数（项空间为有限分叉树）或更高阶函数符号情形，验证复杂度局部化是否依然成立。

title: When Compression Scores Cannot Decide: Information Boundaries for Group-Robust LLM Pruning
summary: A reproducible compression statistic can still select the wrong candidate. A dense pruning score with 0.906 split-half reliability predicted a 16.1% gain. Its selected endpoint was 6.0% and 7.7% worse than two controls. We model the gap through information interfaces that delimit which distinctions each statistic supports. For equal-weight groups, a conic law gives the exact pooling price for positive linear fixed-candidate damage, including diagonal and full PSD second moments. Three two-world constructions and an exact observation-fiber radius characterize what pooled moments, group-local moments, and reference-path curvature leave unresolved. A group-resolved diagonal recovers broad damage order (Spearman 0.9239) while fine order remains weak. Relative to balanced uniform allocation, a coarse depth allocation cuts worst-group perplexity inflation by 12.6--20.9% across three dense LLMs. Model-specific complete-mask endpoint selection improves over those references by 2.7--8.0%. In OLMoE, router traces predict singleton direction (114/192 versus 81/192 under the strongest relabeling). Finite-menu decisions on one layer yield held-out worst-group KL reductions of 13.7% and 7.2%. Local measurements construct candidates. Selection is licensed by complete candidate endpoints or a validated uniform guarantee, with uncertainty calibrated to every comparison.

AI.tldr: This paper identifies and formalizes a fundamental limitation of LLM pruning scores: reproducible local statistics can still select wrong candidates for group-robust (worst-group) deployment. It introduces an "information interface" framework with a "proposal–decision boundary," proving impossibility results showing what pooled, group-local, and reference-path interfaces cannot resolve, and demonstrates that only complete-candidate endpoint measurements (or validated uniform transport bounds) license worst-group selection across both dense and MoE pruning.
AI.motivation: Existing one-shot pruning methods (Wanda, SparseGPT) average local reconstruction evidence over a calibration distribution, which can mask group-concentrated damage: a direction may look harmless on average while dominating one group's endpoint. The authors empirically observed that a score with 0.906 split-half reliability predicted a 16.1% gain, yet the selected endpoint was 6.0–7.7% worse than two controls. This gap motivates formalizing what local compression statistics can and cannot decide about worst-group outcomes.
AI.method: The paper develops an "information-interface" theoretical framework with several components: (1) a Conic Interface Law (Theorem 1) giving exact pooling prices of G-fold (unconstrained) or c-fold (capped) for positive linear damage functionals on convex cones, extended to diagonal and full PSD second moments; (2) three two-world impossibility corollaries showing non-identifiability of pooled order, downstream continuation, and off-chord endpoints; (3) an exact observation-fiber radius (Proposition 1) characterizing worst-case error when only an interface is observed; (4) a uniform-error decision-transfer theorem (Theorem 2) and active-face transport (Proposition 2) for threshold and selection transfer. Empirically, it audits a 32-cell Llama-3.2-3B grid (Wanda/SparseGPT × 4 sparsities × 4 calibrations) across four equal-weight sources (general, rare-code, rare-knowledge, safety), tests target-matched complete-mask selection on SmolLM3-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, Mistral-7B, and analyzes OLMoE (top-8-of-64) router traces for expert deletion at 25% budget.
AI.result: Key empirical findings: (i) the group-resolved diagonal ranks broad severity with Spearman 0.9239 across the 32-cell Llama grid, but within-budget SparseGPT correlations remain at 0.4; (ii) coarse depth allocation cuts worst-group PPL inflation by 12.6–20.9% versus balanced uniform across Llama, SmolLM3, and Qwen; (iii) model-specific complete-mask endpoint selection yields 2.7–8.0% additional worst-group improvements with held-out confirmation on SmolLM3 (96 sequences/group, new EntityQuestions source) and Qwen (20 sequences/group); (iv) in OLMoE, router exposure identifies the singleton-direction maximizing group in 114/192 deletions versus 81/192 for the strongest relabeling control; (v) finite-menu endpoint decisions on one OLMoE layer produce held-out worst-group KL reductions of 13.7% and 7.2%, while singleton-derived set rankings and static scores remain inconclusive; (vi) exposure vs. leverage diverge—restoring down/output weights underperforms equal-count high-energy controls at every tested budget despite localizing group contrast. Generator coordinates transfer across models but selected fine directions do not.
AI.conclusion: The proposal–decision boundary recurs across dense and MoE pruning. Local interfaces can expose group concentration and construct tractable candidate menus but cannot determine the order of complete interventions left unresolved by their interface. Selection is licensed only by complete-candidate endpoint measurements or a validated uniform transport guarantee, with uncertainty calibrated to every comparison. Coarse depth allocation transfers across models; fine directions are target-specific and require target-matched complete-endpoint evaluation. The findings imply a discipline: local scores propose, complete endpoints decide, and any cross-target transfer must verify both the response secants and the available slack profile rather than relying on shared generator coordinates alone.

title: Neurosymbolic Reasoning with Incremental Knowledge for Sample Efficient Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: (Flat) Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents face significant challenges in environments with sparse rewards that require long-horizon reasoning. A compelling approach to improve sample efficiency is to incorporate knowledge into learning and decision-making. In standard Hierarchical RL (HRL), knowledge is encoded in a fixed, non-updatable form, such as architectural choices, and remains unchanged throughout learning. With fixed HRL, reasoning with incremental knowledge learned during exploration is impractical before sufficient environmental knowledge is acquired, leading to poor sample efficiency. In this work, we propose neurosymbolic HRL with {\em Incremental Knowledge (InK)}: symbolic high-level components perform {\em symbolic planning} (e.g. using $D^*$) on an updatable representation of current InK, while low-level goal-conditioned neural modules learn motion primitives through experience using reward shaping. Experiments on navigation tasks demonstrate that incorporating InK substantially improves sample efficiency. Additionally, to perform {\em optimal} symbolic planning given {\em prior} knowledge about the world, we develop Belief World Tree Search. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合增量知识(InK)的神经符号分层强化学习(HRL)框架,通过高层符号规划器(如D*)在可更新的抽象世界模型上进行规划,低层使用目标条件神经网络策略。在导航任务上,该方法比非增量方法RGL样本效率提升30-100倍。同时提出Belief World Tree Search (BWTS)算法,能在具有结构先验知识的情况下获得信念世界集合上的最优策略。
AI.motivation: 现有分层强化学习(HRL)存在两大局限:(1)标准HRL使用固定、不可更新的知识(如架构选择),导致在获得足够环境知识前难以进行基于增量知识的推理,样本效率低下;(2)现有非增量神经符号HRL方法(如SoRB、RGL)需要先完全探索环境才能开始目标导向行为,本质上效率低下;而经典增量知识方法(如D*、TAMP)假设高层和低层均为符号组件,无法处理神经低层策略。同时,BAMCP等基于贝叶斯先验的方法假设状态-动作对之间独立,无法处理结构依赖(如"恰好有一面墙在未知位置"这类结构性约束)。因此需要一种能够在神经符号HRL中使用增量知识并处理结构先验的方法。
AI.method: 提出两阶段方法:(1) **InK神经符号HRL框架**:高层使用符号规划器(如D*)在可更新的抽象世界模型M上规划,低层使用目标条件神经网络策略π_l执行子目标并充当传感器(通过监视器mon报告成功/失败),高层根据执行反馈更新M。规划循环为:符号规划→执行子目标→更新知识。(2) **Belief World Tree Search (BWTS)算法**:改编MCTS用于InK设置,树节点包含决策节点(v,W)和机会节点(v,a,W);使用**策略性rollouts**(而非随机rollouts)评估节点值Q——固定k个策略σ_i在每个世界W中执行并取最优;决策节点使用LCB公式(Eq.5)进行探索-利用平衡,机会节点使用基于信念集大小的选择规则(Eq.6);给出了完整的BWTS算法(选择→扩展→回溯)以及完整BWTS树的最优性证明和BWTS收敛到最优策略的证明(Theorem 4.1和4.2)。
AI.result: **InK vs 非InK**:在Point-Maze(Four Rooms、Medium Maze、Hard Maze)和Ant-Maze U-Room(29维)上,InK从零开始所需样本数比RGL少30-100倍(例如Four Rooms:64.90 vs 2080;Hard Maze:208.92 vs 17456);"训练"75个目标后,InK仍比RGL样本少18%、速度快20倍;累积样本差距超过100K且持续扩大。**符号规划器比较**:在10×10网格合成环境中,BWTS相对D*在水平墙信念集W_h上提升15.7%,垂直墙W_v上提升9.3%,混合W_hv上提升2.2%;BAMCP由于随机rollout易陷入循环,表现最差(约D*的2倍)。**InK-BWTS with先验知识**:在物理RL环境中,使用先验知识时InK-BWTS的样本数减半(45.97 vs 87.70),但运行时间显著增加。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了一种基于增量知识(InK)的神经符号HRL框架,结合了纯符号InK方法的样本效率和神经符号框架处理复杂物理环境的能力,适用于稀疏奖励长视野任务。BWTS算法在具有结构先验知识时可获得信念世界上的最优策略,是对D*(次优均值)和BAMCP(无法处理结构依赖)的补充。实验证明InK在样本效率上显著优于非InK方法RGL,样本差距超过10万步。未来工作包括:(1)将InK扩展到基于PDDL的增量规划器以应用于操作任务;(2)结合BWTS的结构先验与BAMCP的概率先验,提出统一的BAWMCP算法。

title: On the missing benchmarks layer and a potential solution
summary: Latin America is missing a foundational layer for native AI development: the benchmark layer. The benchmark layer does two things no other layer can - it audits AI systems against regional social requirements and it directs AI optimization in economically relevant environments. Without it, public institutions cannot independently evaluate foreign AI systems, and companies cannot optimize AI systems to solve local problems with SOTA performance. The cost of the missing layer is dual: a loss of auditability and a loss of optimization direction over a technology that is increasingly critical infrastructure. We propose an EvalsHub, with LatamBoard as its first regional instance - an open, task-first benchmark infrastructure where universities, public institutions, professional communities, and companies can publish, execute, compare, and maintain evaluations across models, workflows, and agents. Built once, measured forever - re-run by institutions as new AI systems ship and by industry teams after every system change. Open by design and incentive-driven by construction.

AI.tldr: 拉丁美洲在原生AI开发中缺失一个基础层——基准层（benchmark layer）。本文提出构建区域性的EvalsHub，并以LatamBoard为首个实例：一个开放的、以任务为先的基准基础设施，使大学、公共机构、专业社区和企业能够发布、执行、比较和维护跨模型、工作流和智能体的评估。
AI.motivation: 拉美地区使用的AI系统几乎全部由外部构建，没有针对本地区语境（语言、领域、任务）进行衡量，导致双重损失：（1）公共机构无法独立审计其采购的AI系统（审计能力丧失）；（2）行业无法为Software 3.0栈的优化器（prompt-program优化、工作流架构搜索）提供优化目标，导致通用模型在区域任务上停留在开箱性能（优化方向丧失）。在AI日益成为关键基础设施的背景下，这一缺失使地区失去审计权与工业生产力，并削弱主权能力。
AI.method: 提出解决方案"EvalsHub + LatamBoard"，采用以下设计原则：（1）任务优先本体论 /<task?>/<domain?>/<language?>，三轴复合精确定义基准；（2）AI系统无关——基准定义测什么，AI目标（模型/节点/工作流/智能体）定义测谁；（3）"构建一次，永久测量"——同一基准可被新模型发布后反复运行，支持机构侧审计与行业侧持续性能追踪；（4）开放设计——开放许可、评分代码开源、结果公开；（5）激励驱动——贡献者获得品牌可见度与互惠回报。此外，文章识别了"访问问题"（Access Problem）：领域专家虽掌握"正确性"判断，但缺乏ML工程、统计与开发运维三类专长，因而被锁定在外，需配套技术降低门槛。
AI.result: 文章为立场与提案性论文，未提供实验结果或量化指标。其"结果"是：（1）诊断出拉美AI生态缺失基准层及其双重成本；（2）阐明基准层的双重功能（审计+优化）与双重消费者（机构+行业）；（3）正式提出EvalsHub/LatamBoard架构与任务优先本体论；（4）识别出区域基准供应的硬约束——"访问问题"，并将其列为待解决开放问题；（5）明确开放的方法论标准、敏感领域治理、重跑频率、算力成本等尚未解决的具体问题。
AI.conclusion: 基准层是拉美发展原生AI、走向多极AI世界的基础设施层。一个基准工件同时服务公共审计与产业优化两条路径，构成共享公共物品。LatamBoard是起点，基准层本身需要大学、公共机构、专业社区与企业持续贡献。文章呼吁各利益相关方参与共建，目标是将LatamBoard建设成为由拉美构建、为拉美服务的AI开发公共基础设施——每增加一个基准都使整个层对其他参与者更有价值，形成正向网络效应。

title: ProPRL: Property-Aware Prerequisite Relation Learning in Educational Knowledge Graphs
summary: Prerequisite relation learning is central to adaptive instruction, yet existing methods often formulate it as conventional link prediction, limiting their ability to adaptively integrate complementary educational evidence for individual candidate pairs and to discourage contradictory reverse predictions. We propose ProPRL, a Property-aware Prerequisite Relation Learning framework. ProPRL first learns complementary concept representations from a concept-resource hypergraph and a directed learning-behavior graph, where direction-preserving personalized propagation aggregates multi-hop behavioral evidence. It then employs a Pair-conditioned Gate to adaptively weight and fuse the two views for each candidate ordered concept pair. Finally, an \textit{Irreversibility Constraint} introduces an anti-symmetry regularizer that penalizes simultaneously high confidence in both directions of the same concept pair. Experiments on multiple real-world educational datasets show that ProPRL achieves state-of-the-art performance on prerequisite relation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ProPRL的属性感知先决关系学习框架，用于教育知识图谱中的概念间先决关系预测。该框架通过融合概念-资源超图和定向学习行为图两种视图，并引入对偶门控机制和不可逆性约束，解决现有方法在方向不对称性、多跳行为证据和概念对特异性方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的先决关系学习方法通常将任务简化为传统的链接预测，存在三个关键问题：(1)方向不对称性建模不足——先决关系具有内在的方向不可逆性，但传统链接预测独立评估有向对，会产生矛盾的双向预测；(2)多跳行为证据利用不足——先决关系常表现为潜在的多跳依赖，但传统行为建模框架局限于局部转移启发式；(3)概念对特异性建模不足——现有方法采用节点中心范式，概念表示在所有配对中固定，无法适应每个候选对的特定关系语境。
AI.method: ProPRL框架包含四个阶段：(a)图构建——组织概念-资源关联和学习者交互为两种互补图视图（概念-资源超图和有向学习行为图）；(b)概念表示学习——通过方向保持的个性化传播在有向行为图上聚合多跳行为证据；(c)对偶门控融合（Pair-conditioned Gate）——为每个候选有序概念对自适应地加权和融合两种视图，生成对特定的嵌入表示；(d)约束感知优化——引入不可逆性约束（Irreversibility Constraint），即反对称正则化器，惩罚同一概念对两个方向同时具有高置信度的预测。
AI.result: 在多个真实教育数据集上的实验表明，ProPRL在先决关系学习任务上达到了最先进的性能（state-of-the-art）。具体来说，通过整合多视图互补证据、对特定相关性建模以及方向不可逆性约束，ProPRL在性能上优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ProPRL是首个在有向学习行为图上引入方向保持的个性化传播进行先决关系学习的工作。它通过属性感知设计，显式地捕捉了多视图互补证据、对特定相关性和方向不可逆性这三个重要特性。该框架为教育知识图谱中的先决关系学习提供了一种更有效的方法，对自适应教学决策和智能导学系统具有重要价值。

title: UrbanAgent: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Cross-System Urban Tasks
summary: Modern cities rely on an increasing number of digital services to operate, but residents' daily needs are still difficult to meet. Services are fragmented and have little interoperability, placing a heavy operational burden on users. Existing digital platforms, urban foundation models, and intelligent assistants each address only isolated aspects of an urban task. But they struggle to reliably convert complex natural-language requests into executable cross-system workflows. We propose Urban-Agent, a tool-augmented agent framework for cross-system urban tasks. It couples the cognitive and reasoning capabilities of a large language model with a tool-set supporting code execution, API calls, and Model Context Protocol. Through one adaptive closed loop, it clarifies missing information before acting, grounds tool use in live observations, and aligns the final response with observed evidence and task constraints. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce Urban-Eval, a benchmark specifically designed for cross-system urban request. Unlike prior benchmarks that assess either general tool use or urban knowledge and reasoning, Urban-Eval evaluates both task results and execution quality, including required tool coverage, dependency validity, and evidence traceability. Experimental results indicate that Urban-Agent reaches a 71% task success rate, 10 points above the strongest baseline. This lead holds across GPT-5-mini, Gemini-2.5-flash, DeepSeek-V4-flash, and Qwen3-235B-A22B.

AI.tldr: 提出UrbanAgent框架与UrbanEval基准,前者是融合LLM推理与工具调用(含代码执行、API、MCP)的城市跨系统任务智能体,通过澄清缺失信息、依据实时观测选择工具、对齐证据生成回答;后者是250条查询的基准,三难度五类别,并从结果/过程/效率三层评估。
AI.motivation: 城市数字服务碎片化、互操作性差,居民复合型自然语言需求难以转化为跨系统工作流;现有数字平台、城市基础模型、GUI/垂直智能体各只覆盖一个片段,直接迁移通用工具智能体又会因静默假设(地点/时间缺失)、依赖乱序、约束未校验而输出"看似合理但不可用"的结果。此外,现有工具基准与城市基准分别评测通用工具调用或城市知识推理,缺乏对跨域协同执行质量的评估。
AI.method: UrbanAgent采用四组件闭环:(1)Cognition将查询映射为结构化任务U=⟨I,E,C_hard,C_soft,M⟩,关键参数缺失则澄清而非行动;(2)推理-执行核心采用ReAct式的reason-act-observe增量选择动作,确保下游调用消费上游观测;(3)工具调用层通过统一注册表执行,进行地理一致性、空结果、连续失败等校验;(4)证据对齐合成(Clean-Align-Verify)以观测和任务约束校验草稿。UrbanEval含250条查询,5类(事实检索、跨服务复杂检索、序列依赖、条件/组合决策、歧义/不完整意图)、3难度(Level 1信息获取;Level 2依赖与约束决策;Level 3识别关键遗漏),三指标层:结果层TSR/MIR、过程层TIC/IOA/VPAR(仅Level 2)、效率层token消耗。
AI.result: 在GPT-5-mini下,UrbanAgent整体TSR达71%,在200条可执行查询中完成64.0%,较最强基线(Native tool-calling/AutoGen)提升约10.5个百分点;优势集中在事实检索(+16)与条件/组合决策(+12)。MIR 0.98,过程指标TIC 0.89、IOA 1.00、VPAR 0.96,均领先或追平基线。跨模型稳定第一:Gemini-2.5-flash +14、Qwen3-235B-A22B +9、DeepSeek-V4-flash +2。单LLM无工具时TSR仅0.22–0.26,且成功几乎全部来自澄清类查询。代价是token消耗较高:每成功任务约118.3k token,约为Native tool-calling的3倍。优势主要来自主动增强(精化、扩展检索、错误恢复、交叉验证)与任务完成度提升。
AI.conclusion: UrbanAgent通过澄清前置、增量推理、工具接地、证据对齐合成,显著提升跨系统城市任务完成度与执行可追溯性;UrbanEval将"答案正确"与"执行合规"解耦,可区分看似合理的回答与真正完成的工作流。局限在于token开销较高、跨任务/骨干增益不一致、依赖LLM裁判且未验证未见城市/领域的泛化。未来工作将拆解各组件贡献并补充用户研究与实地部署。

title: LoCA: Forward-Only LLM Tuning after One-Shot Calibration with Local Credit Assignment
summary: Parameter-efficient post-training reduces the number of trainable parameters, but still requires repeated end-to-end backpropagation through the frozen backbone. Every adaptation step therefore needs backward-capable hardware and must store or recompute activations. We ask whether this repeated backward chain can be replaced by a one-time calibration. We introduce Local Credit Assignment (LoCA), a two-stage method for small-shift adaptation. One probe backward pass fits a low-rank map at each transformer block from the final prediction error to a local hidden-state correction. LoCA then reuses these maps to form blockwise regression targets from forward activations and fits low-rank adapters with closed-form ridge solves. No further backbone backward pass is required. We evaluate LoCA on five discriminative benchmarks with Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 14B. In 16 of 25 reported task--scale comparisons, LoCA yields lower evaluation cross-entropy than the corresponding LoRA run. Its measured full-run GPU peak, including calibration, is 26--29\% lower than LoRA's. After calibration, its CPU steady-state memory is 36--52\% lower and its per-pass time is 43--48\% lower. A shared scale-normalized candidate set is reused across all tested Qwen2.5 sizes and on SmolLM2-1.7B. LoCA thus amortizes global credit assignment into one calibration and enables later forward-only tuning when repeated backpropagation is impractical. The code associated with this paper is available \href{ this https URL }{here}.

AI.tldr: LoCA提出了一种两阶段参数高效后训练方法，通过一次性校准将全局信用分配分摊为一次反向传播，预先为每个Transformer块拟合低秩反馈映射，从而在后续适配阶段实现纯前向计算调优（仅需闭式岭回归求解），无需重复的主干反向传播。
AI.motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）虽减少了可训练参数，但仍需通过冻结主干进行端到端反向传播，每次适配步骤都需要支持反传的硬件并存储/重计算激活，微调内存可达推理的6–12倍。这使资源受限或仅支持推理的设备难以进行持续适配。MeZO等前向方法虽降低了内存，但依赖随机扰动估计，收敛受方差影响且迭代次数庞大。反馈对齐在冻结主干下效果有限，局部学习的目标多面向表征学习而非下游任务优化。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 校准阶段——对冻结模型执行一次探测性反向传播，收集各块的隐藏状态梯度与顶层误差，通过岭回归拟合低秩反馈映射F_ℓ（F_ℓ=U_kΣ_kV_k⊤，k=8），其与真实梯度在探针数据上的余弦对齐达0.3–0.5（随机反馈约为-0.005）；(2) 适配阶段——复用固定映射τ_ℓ=h_ℓ-η̄·F_ℓ·e，将前向激活转化为局部回归目标，对每个块的适配器B_ℓ求解严格凸二次问题，得到闭式解B_ℓ*=C_ℓ(G_ℓ+λI_r)^{-1}，无需梯度优化器或学习率调度。支持Jacobi/Gauss–Seidel调度，最外层迭代至多40次。引入RMS尺度归一化η̄，使无量纲目标系数η可在不同模型规模间复用候选集{0.003, 0.01, 0.03}。
