Under one identical GUI-MCP harness on the OSWorld-MCP benchmark (309 tasks), the same MCP tools improve a reasoning model by +4.0pp and degrade a non-reasoning model by -5.9pp (5 runs each, both beyond 2 SE). What separates the two is tool-decision behavior. The non-reasoning policy ignores, misnames, or falsely terminates around tools. The reasoning model avoids these failures, yet still calls a tool on only 55/309 tasks, 23.9% of the tool-reachable ones. We call this shortfall the adoption gap. Both levels of the problem share one cause: the model already has a cheaper route and is never trained to take it. Multi-turn RL probes that cause. At the action level, a dense tool bonus raises spreadsheet adoption 0.03 -> 0.33 and carries into greedy decoding, but held-out accuracy does not follow. Behavior is steerable; competence is not. The bottleneck lies in tool-call semantics. At the context level, a successful tool call often makes the next screenshot redundant. Dropping it and halving image history cuts input tokens by about a third, at a small accuracy cost. Retraining under the same observation rule removes that cost. The compressed agent then reaches 37.8% against 33.0% for the uncompressed operating point, at 53% of the input cost, and closes the rich-lean gap on a pre-registered degraded subset to zero. Tools help when the model chooses and integrates them, and current hybrid agents leave many such choices unused.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合GUI-MCP计算机使用代理中"截图vs工具"的核心问题，发现工具可用性并不能决定效果方向：在相同OSWorld-MCP基准（309任务）下，MCP工具使推理模型提升+4.0pp，却使非推理模型下降-5.9pp。提出"采用缺口"概念，并通过多轮RL在动作层面（工具决策）和上下文层面（观察规则匹配）进行两项探针实验，揭示了工具调用语义才是真正的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 当前混合计算机使用代理（CUAs）可同时通过截图（GUI）和文本工具（MCP）两种方式执行操作，但学界和业界对"何时使用工具"的决策机制理解不足，且现有工作多关注工具集设计或注入框架本身，而忽略了一个先决问题：当有用工具存在时，模型是否真的会使用它？同时，混合代理的部署成本（主要由视觉token主导）受观察规则影响，但训练与推理间观察分布的不匹配问题未被系统研究。本文旨在诊断工具效果的条件性，识别"采用缺口"的成因，并通过RL探针在两个层面验证机制。
AI.method: 1. 统一混合动作空间：GUI的11种原始动作（computer_use）与检索到的MCP工具共享同一<tool_call>调用表面，由模型自行决策。2. 上下文构建公式：系统消息+窗口化视觉记忆（k张截图）+当前回合，文本痕迹全程保留，视觉按窗口深度k截断（默认k=4）。3. 截图保留规则：MCP调用执行成功后可用文本占位符π替换后续截图（drop-on-success）。4. 多轮GRPO：G=8轨迹/任务、温度1.0、z-score组内归一化、1/T步级广播（Dr.GRPO式长度去偏），配合KL约束（β=0.02）锚定到rollout-time策略。5. 密集工具奖励：λ_mcp=0.1的后归一化步级奖励，作用于执行成功且非只读的MCP调用，每(工具,参数)键仅触发一次。6. 梯度带策划：74任务训练集（经验通过率p∈(0.1,0.9)）+48任务保留集+89任务chrome/multi_apps域OOD桶。7. 匹配训练协议：rollout与推理共享同一观察策略（压缩规则），保证训练-部署一致。
AI.result: 1. 符号反转：推理模型Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking +4.0pp vs 非推理模型Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct -5.9pp（均超2 SE），差异源于工具决策行为——非推理模型忽略/误命名/虚假终止。2. 采用缺口：推理模型仅在55/309任务（17.8%）调用工具，占工具可触达任务的23.9%；VLC域16/17任务工具可触达却零调用。3. 动作层面RL：密集奖励使电子表格工具采用率从0.03升至0.33，并迁移至贪婪解码（0.02→0.29），但保留集准确率不变——决策可引导，能力不可。4. 工具语义瓶颈：执行成功率98-100%，但语义成功率近0（regex查找替换0/23、格式转换0/16），服务端报告success:true实则零效果。5. 上下文层面RL：匹配训练后压缩代理达37.8%（53%输入成本），对比非压缩基线33.0%；预注册退化子集D13上rich-lean差距闭合至0（3.8-5.1pp波动）。6. OOD表现：235非训练任务上压缩检查点+0.8pp（n.s.），实现半成本零准确率损失。
AI.conclusion: 混合GUI-MCP代理面临"截图还是工具"的二阶问题：在动作层面，工具仅在模型决策并整合时才有帮助，相同注入对不同模型产生相反效果，RL可自由引导决策但工具调用语义仍是开放问题；在上下文层面，仅当训练与推理共享观察规则时，丢弃冗余截图才有回报，匹配重训练后以半输入成本无OOD精度损失。两个层面共同揭示一个规律：更廉价路径已存在，但训练从未教会策略采用它。工具可用性本身不够，当前混合代理留下大量可用工具未被利用。未来工作应聚焦于：通过强教师监督注入经验证的工具轨迹以解决能力瓶颈，以及通过学习式上下文策略与跨操作系统扩展进一步释放效率。

title: Long-term Traffic Scene Prediction via Polynomial Representations in Autonomous Driving
summary: This thesis addresses fundamental challenges in traffic scene prediction for autonomous driving by introducing robust and computationally efficient models based on polynomial representations. While conventional sequence-based representations often struggle with noise and generalization, this work demonstrates that polynomial representations offer significant advantages in computational efficiency, generalization, and prediction plausibility. Through theoretical analysis and empirical validation, this thesis demonstrates that moderate-degree polynomials capture real-world motion dynamics with high fidelity without constraining predictive performance. Building on this foundation, a prediction model representing both trajectories and map geometry with polynomial representations achieves near state-of-the-art accuracy on standard benchmarks while substantially improving generalization under distribution shift. Extending this concept, a diffusion- based generative framework enables multi-agent scene generation, producing traffic continuations that are more plausible and kinematically consistent than those generated by conventional baselines. Evaluations on the Argoverse 2 and Waymo Open datasets confirm that polynomial representations reduce computational cost, enhance cross-dataset generalization, and yield smoother trajectories and higher behavioral plausibility. The findings reveal that standard in-distribution evaluation and regression-based metrics may fail to reflect true model generalization and prediction plausibility. By providing theoretical justification and empirical validation, this dissertation estab- lishes polynomial trajectory representations as an efficient, expressive, and generalizable foundation for traffic scene prediction in safety critical autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于自动驾驶中交通场景长期预测的博士论文,核心提出以多项式表示（特别是Bernstein多项式）作为轨迹和地图几何的统一表征,构建高效、可泛化、物理一致的预测框架。研究通过三大贡献模块:（1）基于经验贝叶斯的多项式表示理论分析、（2）面向边际预测的EP模型、（3）面向联合预测的扩散模型EP-Diffuser,在Argoverse 2和Waymo Open数据集上验证了多项式表示在计算效率、分布外泛化能力和预测合理性方面的显著优势。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶预测系统面临四大核心挑战:(1)数据表示——序列表示易受噪声影响且缺乏物理一致性;(2)跨环境泛化——模型常过拟合于特定数据集;(3)多模态——长时域交互预测存在多解;(4)计算效率——实时性需求严格。现有研究普遍采用序列表示和回归框架,但存在ID/OoD性能脱节、回归指标无法反映预测合理性等问题。亟需一种既能保证物理一致性、又能跨数据集泛化、同时具备高计算效率的统一表征方法。
AI.method: 论文采用"分析-建模-生成"三阶段递进方法:(1)理论基础——在Argoverse 1/2和Waymo Open数据集上,使用经验贝叶斯框架估计多项式参数先验和观测噪声协方差,通过AIC/BIC确定最优多项式次数,量化拟合误差与位移误差的关系;(2)边际预测模型EP——以5次Bernstein多项式表示智能体历史,3次多项式表示地图,通过改进Kalman滤波器跟踪控制点,采用Transformer编码器-解码器架构并融合FMAE/QCNet的异构/同构数据增强策略;(3)联合生成模型EP-Diffuser——将EP-Q扩展至扩散框架,采用图结构场景表征,DDIM采样（10步）,对多项式参数进行去噪,通过"Sim Agents"指标评估合理性。
AI.result: 三大实验均验证了多项式表示的优势:(1)经验贝叶斯分析显示,5-7次Bernstein多项式即可高保真拟合真实轨迹（5秒车辆拟合误差约0.02m）,远低于SotA预测器的位移误差;(2)EP-Q在A2*→WO*设置下以3.9%参数（0.3M vs 7.6M）和4.7%推理时间超越QCNet的OoD鲁棒性,ΔminADE₁仅+1.9%;(3)EP-Diffuser在A2 C500子集上以3.0M参数取得最高realism meta得分（0.713 vs OptTrajDiff的0.709）,且在OoD测试中性能退化最小（ΔminSADE仅+0.107m）。消融实验进一步证实多项式表示在合理性、多样性、泛化性和效率方面均优于序列表示。但模型仍存在生成场景中离路轨迹和智能体碰撞等失败案例。
AI.conclusion: 论文系统论证了多项式表示作为自动驾驶交通场景预测基础表征的可行性与优越性。核心结论:多项式表示通过降低数据维度、内置运动连续性、正则化测量噪声,在计算效率、分布外泛化和预测合理性三个维度均带来实质性提升。同时,研究发现ID性能与OoD鲁棒性存在显著脱节,回归指标与合理性评估存在分歧,呼吁采用"Sim Agents"等多维度评估框架。未来方向包括:动态自适应多项式次数选择、概率置信度量化、传感器级表征融合、以及预测-规划联合闭环框架（利用Bernstein多项式导数即低阶多项式的特性）。整体而言,论文确立了表征设计与架构设计同等重要的研究理念,为安全关键自动驾驶系统提供了新思路。

title: Traceable Multi-Agent System for Knowledge-Based Forecasting
comment: Accepted at KDD 2026 Workshop on Enterprise AI Agents (Oral)
summary: Enterprise forecasting increasingly relies on autonomous agents that interpret documents, search for data, generate code, and revise models. While this autonomy helps build adaptive forecasting pipelines, it also makes it difficult for practitioners to inspect why a forecast changed, which evidence supported the change, and how data and modeling choices were revised. We present TraceMAS, an interactive demo system for traceable multi-agent forecasting. TraceMAS organizes agent outputs around two causal-loop representations: an Ideal Causal Loop Diagram (Ideal CLD), which captures key factors and their causal relations extracted from domain documents, and a Data-Grounded Causal Loop Diagram (Data-Grounded CLD), which links those factors to internal variables, external data, or documented proxies. The Data-Grounded CLD guides feature construction and model design while preserving the connection between textual evidence, data choices, and model revisions. We demonstrate TraceMAS on crude oil price forecasting. The demo interface allows users to compare forecasting iterations, inspect agent-level revisions, explore causal maps, review feature-data mappings and model architecture, and connect scenario forecasts to market narratives. This demonstration shows how autonomous forecasting agents can retain flexibility while making the evidence-to-forecast process inspectable.

AI.tldr: TraceMAS是一个用于企业预测的交互式多智能体演示系统，通过"理想因果环路图（Ideal CLD）"和"数据落地因果环路图（Data-Grounded CLD）"两种核心表示，将文本领域知识、数据选择、特征构造和模型修订串联起来，实现可追溯的"证据到预测"全过程审查，并以原油价格预测为演示案例。
AI.motivation: 企业预测中，自主智能体虽然能灵活构建自适应预测流水线，但其自主性也使得预测人员难以追溯预测变化的原因、支撑变化的证据以及数据和建模决策的修订过程。现有方法要么将文本信息隐藏在嵌入中无法追溯，要么智能体日志过于非结构化难以诊断，因此需要一种能在保留智能体自主性的同时使"证据→预测"链条可审查的系统。
AI.method: TraceMAS采用基于角色的多智能体架构，包含一个主智能体Coordinator和六个子智能体：Domain Analyst（从领域文档提取关键因素和有向假设）、Causal Analyst（合成Ideal CLD）、Data Engineer（搜索内部时间序列变量）、Crawler（检索外部数据或代理指标）、Risk Reviewer（检查数据泄漏、时间戳错位、硬编码等问题）、Model Engineer（构建CLD引导的特征和模型）。系统核心是两个CLD表示：(1) Ideal CLD G_I=(V_I, E_I)记录文档支持的有向因果假设（含时间延迟τ）；(2) Data-Grounded CLD G_D=(V_D, E_D, M)通过映射函数M将因素链接到内部时间序列、外部数据或文档代理。每次迭代都版本化存储CLD、数据映射、特征规范、审查信号和模型配置，形成可比较的追溯轨迹。
AI.result: TraceMAS以原油价格预测为演示场景，构建了交互式界面，允许用户：(1) 选择预测迭代并查看智能体级修订摘要；(2) 检查Ideal CLD与Data-Grounded CLD的因果图；(3) 查看特征-数据映射和模型架构；(4) 审查Risk Reviewer生成的警告（如时间覆盖不足、特征数据在预测时不可用、硬编码值等）；(5) 连接场景预测与市场叙事。系统展示了四个代表性追踪路径：供需平衡→Balance特征；OPEC+产量政策→Policy特征；中国需求和储备→Demand lag特征；地缘政治风险→Risk特征。
AI.conclusion: TraceMAS证明了智能体预测中的可追溯性不仅可以通过存储日志实现，还可以通过暴露结构化的、版本化的工件来实现，使用户能够在预测过程中进行检查。核心贡献在于在保留智能体自主性的同时，使从领域知识到预测决策的转化过程变得明确且可在迭代间比较。

title: MMLongBench-Doc-V2: A Corrected-Annotation, Semantics-Aware Revision of MMLongBench-Doc
summary: MMLongBench-Doc is a long-document QA benchmark of 1,082 questions over 135 PDFs. Two properties of it push measured scores away from the quantity they are meant to capture: the reference metric compares extracted answers, so 1,358,000 loses to 1358000; and a non-trivial share of ground-truth annotations are wrong, ambiguous, or incomplete --- concentrated, because of how they were found, in exactly the questions capable systems answer correctly. MMLongBench-Doc-V2 corrects 106 annotations, each published with the page and arithmetic that settle it, and replaces the string metric with a pinned LLM judge asked whether a response means the reference. Ten questions whose document ships under the wrong filename are removed rather than counted wrong, along with one duplicated question, leaving 1,071 questions over 134 documents. The most reusable contribution is a decision procedure for when an empty set key may be widened and when widening would destroy a deliberate negative sample; applied to all 208 rows, it widened 14. V2 scores are not comparable with published V1 numbers. The corrected corpus, the per-entry correction record and the evaluation harness are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MMLongBench-Doc-V2 是对原版 MMLongBench-Doc 长文档问答基准的修正版本，主要解决了两个问题：(1) 评测指标仅做字符串比对（如"1,358,000"会输给"1358000"），导致格式差异惩罚了正确答案；(2) 1,082 条标注中存在大量错误、歧义或不完整的答案，且这些错误恰好集中在强模型能正确回答的问题上。通过修正 106 条标注、移除 10 条文档错误和 1 条重复问题（最终 1,071 题/134 文档），并将字符串匹配指标替换为固定的 LLM 法官（判断响应"是否与参考答案含义一致"），构建了一个更可靠的评测基准。
AI.motivation: 原版 MMLongBench-Doc 存在两个使测量分数偏离其所意图捕捉的真实能力的缺陷：(1) 基于字符串匹配的评测指标在格式变化时误判（如列表、负号、大小写），导致对系统排名产生系统性扭曲而非仅绝对水平偏差；(2) 部分参考答案存在错误、歧义或不完整，且这些错误通过"模型能答对但得零分"的逆向审计发现，意味着误差集中在强模型擅长的题目上，构成一个与模型能力无法区分的基准天花板。这两个问题尤其关键，因为该基准刻意包含 20.6% 的不可回答题以抑制捷径和检测幻觉，评测的准确性至关重要。
AI.method: 方法围绕三大修正展开：(1) **指标重构**——使用一个固定的 LLM 法官（pinned judge），不读取文档，仅根据问题、参考答案和系统完整响应判定语义等价性（含 abstained 标志位），采用显式评分细则，将精确率改为对自信的错误答案进行惩罚；(2) **标注修正**——审计全部 1,082 题中强模型零分的那些（错误集中区），修正 106 条（涵盖 wrong_answer、defective_question、ambiguous_question、incomplete_answer、should_be_answerable、should_be_unanswerable、corpus_defect 七类），每条修改附原文、修正后版本与支持页面的"笔记"，原始文件一并保留以便独立比对；(3) **空集键的决策程序**——针对 208 条"Not answerable"行，提出可执行的判空测试（容器存在且目标可验证缺失时可放宽；容器缺失/实体从未出现/补集无限/集合非空四类情况不可放宽），并对所有行执行机械化检查，14 条被放宽为"Not answerable or 0 or none"。
AI.result: 修正后 V2 包含 1,071 题（移除 10 条文档分发错误的题目和 1 条重复题），覆盖 134 个文档，208 条（19.4%）不可回答，其中 14 条为放宽的空集键。修正分布：answer 64、question 38、evidence_pages 27、answer_format 19；按争议类型分布：wrong_answer 26、defective_question 19、ambiguous_question 19、incomplete_answer 16、should_be_answerable 14、corpus_defect 10、should_be_unanswerable 2。任务类型覆盖 lookup 487、count 234、enumerate 122、derive 122、compare 89、verify 17。最重要的发现之一是 314 题需要真正视觉理解（颜色、形状、布局等纯文本无法捕获的属性），这与仅以 evidence_sources 包含 Chart/Figure 标记的子集不对应（前者有 75 题遗漏，后者混入 231 题纯文本可答的题目）。需要注意的是 V2 分数与 V1 已发表分数不可直接比较，V2 分数整体更高，差距在列表与自由文本回答处最大。
AI.conclusion: MMLongBench-Doc-V2 显著提升了长文档问答评测的可靠性，但仍存在显著局限：(1) 修正来源有偏——仅审计了强模型自信但得零分的题目集合，全局错误率未被测量，需要均匀随机审计才能确立；(2) 任务类型覆盖不均——count 与 enumerate 类别未被端到端审计，这两类也是纯文本最难验证的，约 95 行存在系统与参考答案分歧但未能证伪参考答案；(3) 13 条记录仅记录修改未提供推理（首次审核留存）；(4) 任务类型与 requires_visual 标签由模型一次性生成，未人工核验；(5) LLM 法官虽固定且受规则约束但非完美，法官模型选择本身是度量指标的自由参数，报告分数时必须同时报告所用法官。尽管如此，V2 提供了一个最可重用的方法贡献：用于判断空集键何时可放宽的决策程序，建议在任何类似语料上对空集放宽进行可执行空检查而非依赖审阅者阅读。修正后的数据集与评估工具以 Apache 2.0 协议发布，欢迎以"指明条目与判定页面"的 issue 形式提交进一步修正。

title: Towards Robust Tool Use in Agents via Experience-Driven Adaptive Guidance
summary: The performance bottleneck of agents is increasingly shifting from model capability to the robustness of their execution processes. Tools play a central role as the primary interface through which agents interact with external environments, yet existing methods rarely focus on ensuring robust tool use across diverse runtime conditions. To address this problem, we propose ExpG, a mechanism that builds and refines adaptive guidance capturing each tool's capability boundaries and best practices, thereby enabling agents to use tools more robustly and effectively. ExpG consists of three phases: (1) experience acquisition, which analyzes tool invocation quality from historical execution trajectories, producing structured learnable experiences through multi-aspect attribution; (2) experience distillation, which keeps the experience pool effective by filtering unhelpful experiences, selecting representative ones with an equivalence-class-based method, and summarizing them into generalizable guidance; and (3) experience reuse, which applies the guidance adaptively during future task solving. Extensive experiments show that ExpG brings consistent improvements across the tool selection, tool calling, and response generation tasks, enabling smaller agents to outperform larger ones that do not use ExpG. Moreover, ExpG achieves particularly strong gains in challenging settings, suggesting a promising path toward more robust tool use. Our code, experiments, and results are available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ExpG机制，通过"经验获取-经验蒸馏-经验复用"三阶段流程，为智能体的每个工具构建自适应的能力边界和最佳实践指导，从而在动态环境和噪声反馈下实现更鲁棒的工具调用。
AI.motivation: 智能体的性能瓶颈正从模型能力转向执行过程的鲁棒性。现有工具调用方法通常建立在"工具行为可预测且失败信号明确"的静态假设上，但真实环境中存在两大挑战：(1) 同一工具因上下文不同或环境动态变化而表现不同；(2) 工具响应噪声大、信号粗粒度（如错误工具也返回"success"），导致智能体难以泛化和自我纠错。需要在工具层面外部化能力边界和最佳实践知识。
AI.method: ExpG包含三个串行阶段：①经验获取：使用LLM-as-a-Judge，从历史轨迹中以10维二进制评分向量（覆盖工具使用环境、代理行为、工具可靠性三大视角）评估每次工具调用，根据评分向量将同一工具的经验划分为等价类；②经验蒸馏：通过去重、时效性过滤、滑动窗口效率检查去除低质量经验，并根据经验量分为one-shot/few-shot/many-shot三类，采用基于等价类的选择算法（在分布对齐和多样性之间取得平衡，q=αu+(1-α)p，α=K/Q），结合LLM总结器从核心功能、成功模式、常见问题、最佳实践四方面提炼工具级指导；③经验复用：根据指导的稳定性（稳定等价类主导时），将指导分为动态型（注入提示）和稳定型（嵌入工具Schema强制约束）两类策略使用。
AI.result: 在MetaTool（工具选择）、API-Bank（工具调用）、BFCL-V3（响应生成）三个基准上，ExpG在GPT-5 nano、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3系列（8B/32B/235B）模型上一致优于No Method、Few-shot、DRAFT、Mem0等基线。Qwen3-8B配ExpG总指标Avg@3提升7.41%，可媲美甚至超越不ExpG的更大模型；在干扰工具场景提升16.34%，嘈杂多轮任务提升10.33%。消融实验验证三阶段均有效，性能在约9个经验时达到峰值；即使将评估器和总结器替换为Qwen3-8B，仍能在三个数据集上获得稳定增益，表明智能体可实现自我进化。案例分析显示ExpG在提升工具使用意识、区分相似工具、修正错误、识别依赖、理解可靠性等方面均有效，但存在四种典型失败：未见过的情境、难以分析的轨迹、不正确的归因和过度反应。
AI.conclusion: ExpG为agent harness中的工具级鲁棒性问题提供了一种trainable tools的思路，通过持续积累、提炼和复用经验，将被动的试错式工具调用转变为主动知情的引导式调用，使小型模型能够匹配甚至超越更大模型，是构建更鲁棒自适应智能体系统的早期但有前景的方向。

title: Enactive Artificial Intelligence: A Decision-Centric Architecture for Complex Systems
summary: As artificial intelligence (AI) continues to evolve and mature, recent AI practices have moved beyond large language models (LLMs) and text or image generation tasks, increasingly integrating tools, agents, and harnesses to solve real business and industrial problems. However, the power of AI is not verified under these real-world complex systems for various reasons, considering reliability, feasibility, resilience, and responsibility requirements in real commercial and industrial operations. This study synthesizes adjacent research and introduces Enactive AI as a conceptual framework for enterprise and industry reasoning, site-level decision support, and execution feedback. Four complementary roles organize the framework: an Organizational World defines operations management logic and an organizational behavior world model behind an enterprise from a strategic-institutional horizon; a Site World defines a physically bounded industrial optimization and execution world model from an operational-realization horizon; Schema Intelligence provides the coupling mechanism between two world models to weave various AI applications via two models; and Enactive Decision Cycle triggers the self-evolving dynamic process to update and audit the entire framework. By foregrounding decision intelligence in complex systems, Enactive AI expands the frontier of AI from model capability to system-aware action, opening new possibilities for scalable, governable, and socially valuable AI deployment. Enactive AI points toward a future in which AI progress is measured not only by what models can generate or automate, but by how reliably intelligent systems can support consequential action, responsible governance, and durable social value in the complex systems that shape modern life, which we believe will define the next frontier of AI research for enterprise-level and industrial complex systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Enactive AI（具身行动AI）"作为一种面向复杂系统的决策中心架构，旨在将AI从生成与预测能力扩展为可在组织与工业复杂系统中可靠行动的系统级决策参与者。框架由四个互补组件构成：组织世界（战略-制度视角的组织行为世界模型）、现场世界（物理约束的工业执行世界模型）、模式智能（两者之间的耦合机制）以及具身决策循环（动态更新与审计过程）。论文通过京东、电信运营商、半导体AMHS三个工业案例进行了说明，并提出了技术与管理两个层面的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 当前AI已从预测/生成向工具调用、智能体工作流等行动型系统演进，但其能力在真实商业和工业运营的复杂系统中尚未得到充分验证。当AI输出进入决策系统后，需要经过目标、权利、资源、权威、物理约束、执行延迟和反馈等多重中介——若表征、可行性、问责制和反馈未能协同组织，局部看似合理的AI决策可能在系统层面失效。现有AI应用普遍沿用"数据-预测-行动"的线性模式，缺乏将系统上下文、可行行动、权威、执行、问责和反馈作为决策过程构成要素的系统性视角。论文旨在解决这一前沿问题：如何在复杂系统中构建一个使AI能有效嵌入并使用的组织化框架。
AI.method: 论文综合相邻研究（AI能力演进、复杂系统理论、嵌入式AI/世界模型/具身认知等），提出Enactive AI概念架构，包含以下方法要素：（1）四组件架构——组织世界（推理目标、权威、承诺、跨单元依赖，形成系统级行动方案）、现场世界（构建决策充分的状态-行动表征，评估技术可行性并连接执行）、模式智能（构建系统拓扑建模，作为语义与关系基底连接两个世界模型）、具身决策循环（五阶段：意图框架、状态基础、行动评估、操作执行、反馈学习）；（2）三项核心能力要求——系统基础预测（基于时序演化、依赖结构、资源状态和操作条件而非纯数据-结果外推）、后果基础决策（将系统动力学转化为可行、授权、可执行的干预）、系统级判断（评估AI介导决策对耦合决策系统的贡献）；（3）系统级有效性治理——目标对齐、可行性保持、后果可评估性、发布完整性、执行保真度等评估准则及相应证据治理机制。
AI.result: 论文通过三个工业案例验证框架的实用价值：（1）京东案例展示了在超大规模数字商务与供应链场景中，如何通过组织世界、模式智能和现场世界的协同，将商业意图、库存决策和履约执行保持一致。TimeHF模型支持超过20,000个产品的自动补货，精度提升33.21%；30天配对现场实验（61,430个订单、12个配送中心、9,308个SKU）显示持有成本降低26.1%、缺货成本降低51.7%、总库存成本降低40.4%；集成网络部署实现年化FDC持有成本节约约613万美元、转移成本降低约2,232万美元。（2）大型电信运营商案例展示了跨层级决策（基础设施投资→服务连续性→采购→库存→物流→消费可用性）中如何通过Enactive AI保持决策目的、供应关系、操作可行性和授权执行的关联。（3）半导体制造AMHS案例展示了现场世界在网络拓扑、车辆状态、轨道占用、拥塞预测等物理约束下的决策充分表征，以闭环方式将生产目的、当前状态、可行干预、发布权威和执行证据相连。此外，论文提出了六项研究议程（技术层面：决策导向系统表征与感知、可靠执行与过程一致性、适应性韧性；管理层层面：人机组织与治理问责、系统级价值评估、社会价值与合法性），以及技术与管理两个层面之间的耦合挑战。
AI.conclusion: Enactive AI将AI研究的关注点从模型能力拓展到系统感知行动，为可扩展、可治理、具有社会价值的AI部署提供了新可能。论文主张AI进展的衡量标准不仅在于模型能生成或自动化什么，更在于智能系统能在复杂系统中多可靠地支持有后果的行动、负责任的治理和持久的社会价值。论文指出，当AI进入组织、基础设施和工业网络时，其意义越来越多地通过它如何重塑人、流程、资源和制度之间的关系来衡量。下一代AI研究的核心议程应围绕如何在跨越组织层级的系统中保持意义、如何评估随时间展开的贡献、如何在适应性行动中嵌入问责、以及如何设计随证据、信任和治理成熟的自主性。最终，Enactive AI将决策智能视为系统属性——使AI介导的行动在复杂系统中保持目的性、可行性、可问责性和适应性。

title: AI World Cup 2026: Benchmarking Large Language Models for End-to-End Football Tournament Prediction
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Project repository available in the paper
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are now regularly asked to forecast real-world events, but comparisons are often difficult because models receive different information, use different tools, and are evaluated under different rules. This paper reports the completed \emph{AI World Cup} benchmark, in which ten LLM-based assistants made a single pre-tournament forecast of the entire 2026 FIFA World Cup. Every submission used the same tournament snapshot, prompt, JSON schema, and scoring procedure. The forecasts covered group-stage scores, group rankings, the knockout bracket, final placings, confidence values, and short explanations. After all 104 matches had been played, GPT-5.5 Thinking finished first with 744 points, followed by GPT-5.5 with 717, Gemini with 699, and Qwen 3.7 with 687. GPT-5.5 Thinking was also the only model to select Spain, which defeated Argentina 1--0 in the final, as champion. The final ranking was driven mainly by knockout performance: total score was strongly correlated with knockout points ($r=0.986$), but showed little relationship with group-stage match points ($r=0.055$), group-standing points ($r=-0.103$), or their combined pre-knockout score ($r=-0.054$). Match-level accuracy produced a different ordering. Claude Sonnet 4.6 correctly predicted the largest number of group-stage outcomes (63.89\%) but placed sixth overall. Average self-reported confidence was also unrelated to either outcome accuracy ($r=-0.060$) or total score ($r=-0.067$). The results suggest that forecasting a complete tournament tests something different from predicting matches one at a time, while also showing how strongly a bracket-based leaderboard can depend on scoring design. The benchmark materials, raw responses, and scoring code are released to support replication and future extensions.

AI.tldr: 该论文报告了"AI World Cup 2026"基准测试的结果：10个LLM助手在2026年FIFA世界杯开赛前进行一次完整的赛事预测，采用统一的提示、JSON模式和评分流程。最终GPT-5.5 Thinking以744分夺冠（也是唯一预测冠军西班牙的模型），其领先优势主要来自淘汰赛阶段（淘汰赛得分与总分相关性r=0.986），而小组赛表现与总分几乎无关。研究表明完整的赛事路径预测与单场比赛预测衡量的是不同能力，且自报告信心与准确度无相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM预测基准存在信息不一致、工具差异、规则不统一等问题，导致难以公平比较。本研究旨在通过统一的预赛事预测基准，对消费者可访问的LLM助手进行透明、可复现的端到端赛事预测能力评估，区分单场比赛预测能力与长程赛事一致性推理能力。
AI.method: 采用统一的提示、JSON数据快照和输出模式，由10个LLM助手（覆盖OpenAI、Google、Qwen、DeepSeek、Anthropic、Mistral、Perplexity、xAI等7家提供商）通过消费级界面手动提交一次完整的赛事预测。评分系统由三部分组成：(1)小组赛72场比赛的累积积分（精确比分5分+正确结果3分+正确赢家2分+正确净胜球1分）；(2)12个小组的最终排名积分（小组冠军5分+前二正确5分/组+晋级队伍3分/队+精确排名2分/队）；(3)淘汰赛路径积分（R32每队2分，R16每队4分，八强6分，四强8分，决赛12分，外加冠亚季殿军分别20/10/8/5分）。通过Pearson/Spearman相关性分析各组件与总分的关系。
AI.result: 最终排名：GPT-5.5 Thinking（744分，唯一预测冠军西班牙）、GPT-5.5（717分，预测巴西）、Gemini（699分，预测法国）、Qwen 3.7（687分，预测阿根廷）位列前四，其余六款模型在496-599分之间。关键发现：(1)总分与淘汰赛得分强相关（r=0.986），但与小组赛得分（r=0.055）、小组排名得分（r=-0.103）或其组合（r=-0.054）几乎无关；(2)单场预测准确率排名与总分排名不一致——Claude Sonnet 4.6小组赛结果预测准确率最高（46/72=63.89%），但总分仅排第六，而总分第一的GPT-5.5 Thinking结果准确率仅42/72；(3)自报告信心与准确度（r=-0.060）和总分（r=-0.067）均无相关性；(4)Perplexity Pro小组赛积分最高但淘汰赛得0分，排名跌至第九。
AI.conclusion: 该基准测试表明：(1)预测完整赛事是一项与单场比赛预测本质不同的能力，淘汰赛路径推理是决定最终排名的关键；(2)积分制排行榜对评分设计高度敏感，淘汰赛得分方差远大于小组赛得分方差，导致总分主要由淘汰赛主导；(3)LLM自报告信心不应被视为校准良好的预测概率；(4)单一预赛事预测设计能测试长程一致性，但无法区分后续错误源于推理缺陷还是信息过时。论文提出了未来研究改进的建议：预注册协议、独立重复预测、概率性预测、适当评分规则（Brier/log得分）、阶段归一化、外部基线对比（博彩市场、Elo模型）等，并发布完整代码、原始响应和不可变commit以支持复现。

title: Towards Improving Sequential Decision-Making in LLM Agents via Experience Memory
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables, 5 appendices, accepted at Neuro-Symbolic Intelligence for LLMs and Autonomous Agents workshop at IJCAI 2026
summary: Large language models have improved substantially on single-shot reasoning tasks, but their performance in sequential decision-making is less well understood. We study this on fully-observable two-player zero-sum games, which provide ground-truth evaluation: outcomes are determined by the rules, and optimality of individual moves can be computed or approximated, without relying on a judge model. Across model tiers, LLMs play suboptimally in simple games such as tic-tac-toe or Connect Four, and lose to MCTS opponents. Obfuscations that preserve the game tree but rewrite its surface form leave performance largely unchanged, indicating the gap is not fully explained by recall of memorized strategies. Motivated by this performance gap, we introduce an agentic framework enhanced with an experience memory designed for the sequential setting and addressing common challenges of sequential decision-making such as credit assignment. We show that post-game reflection and rule extraction yield measurable improvements on tic-tac-toe without modifying the model weights.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地研究了LLM在完全信息双人零和游戏（井字棋、Nim、四子连珠）中的序列决策能力，发现当前SOTA模型即使在简单游戏上也存在显著的最优决策差距，且该差距在不同表层规则混淆下基本保持不变，表明问题源于决策时推理瓶颈而非记忆缺失。为此提出了REAPER框架，通过在Memento基础上加入逐手反思（per-move credit assignment）和规则提取（rule extraction）机制，无需修改模型权重即可在井字棋任务中显著提升表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在单步推理任务上表现出色，但在序列决策环境中表现不佳，且该现象难以衡量——多数基准依赖LLM评判或代理指标，容易混淆推理质量与表层表达。作者选择完全信息双人零和游戏作为研究场景：结果由规则确定，每步最优性可由经典求解器精确计算，无需LLM裁判，可获得真实评估。
AI.method: 1) 构建PlyBench评估框架，基于OpenSpiel引擎并通过Interface Adapter与LLM Adapter支持多模型、多游戏、多混淆规则的统一评估；2) 设计多种保留博弈树但改变表层规则的混淆变体（Hidden Tic-Tac-Toe、Magic Square、Magic Square+5、Story Magic Square，以及Nim的Hidden/Inv/Story变体），用以区分记忆vs推理；3) 提出REAPER（Reflective Experiential Agent with Periodic Extraction of Rules）框架：在Memento式planner-executor循环+案例记忆基础上，加入(a)自我反思器——每局结束后对每一步分别从"局部质量"与"对结果贡献"两个维度评分以实现细粒度credit assignment；(b) 规则提取器——每固定若干局后将反思提炼为一组通用的自然语言战略规则，注入planner提示词，使策略可泛化到未见状态。
AI.result: 1) 在标准游戏中，Efficient与Intermediate级模型在井字棋上每100手错4-12步，在Nim上较弱模型仍错不少；Frontier级模型（GPT-5.4/Gemini 3.1 Pro/GLM-5.2）在四子连珠中无法击败MCTS对手，平均10步即败；2) 表层混淆未导致最优率显著下降，表明失效不是表面记忆缺失；3) REAPER在井字棋GPT-5 nano（medium）vs Optimal对手上：平局率从0（原Memento端口）→ Baseline 0.818→ REAPER 0.868（p=0.018），且输出tokens/move低于Baseline与单次调用参考，效率与性能兼得；4) 消融显示加入规则提取在仅反思基础上进一步提升（draw 0.826→0.868，p=0.039；optimality 0.959→0.970，p=0.027）。
AI.conclusion: 完全信息零和博弈中的ground-truth评估表明，即便在简单博弈上LLM也存在跨模型、跨提供商的稳健决策时推理缺口，且该缺口对表层规则混淆基本不变，说明并非单纯记忆失败。REAPER通过外部经验记忆（逐手反思+规则提取）可在不修改模型权重的条件下显著改善LLM智能体的序列决策能力，同时降低推理token消耗。局限在于：实验集中于井字棋小博弈，未来需验证其在更大博弈、更长视野及部分可观察环境中的可扩展性。

title: State Propagation Also Satisfies: A Complex-Valued State-Space Model for Deterministic State Tracking
summary: Transformer-based architectures have dominated sequence modeling, largely due to the expressive power of attention mechanisms. However, for a class of deterministic state tracking tasks---such as parity checking, modular counting, and parenthesis matching---attention may be overkill. In this paper, we show that \textbf{state propagation alone is sufficient}. We propose the \textbf{Complex State Propagator (CSP)}, a minimalistic recurrent architecture that \textbf{only propagates hidden states} across layers without output projections at intermediate steps. The state is represented as a complex-valued vector, updated via input-dependent rotations in the complex domain. To enable deep propagation without gradient vanishing or degradation, we introduce a \textbf{block-level skip connection} alongside element-wise complex normalization and SiLU activation at sequence boundaries. Applied with Focal Loss, CSP achieves \textbf{100\% accuracy} with perfect F1 scores across canonical tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于确定性状态跟踪任务的极简循环架构——复数状态传播器（CSP）。CSP 仅在层间传递隐藏状态（消除中间输出投影），使用复数向量表示状态并通过输入相关的旋转进行更新，结合块级跳跃连接、逐元素复数归一化以及 Focal Loss，在奇偶校验、模 3 计数和括号匹配三个任务上均达到 100% 准确率和完美 F1 分数。
AI.motivation: Transformer 的注意力机制对确定性状态跟踪任务（如奇偶校验、模运算计数、括号匹配）存在过度参数化、KV 缓存开销大等过度设计问题。现有 SSM（如 Mamba）使用非负特征值的对角实数状态转移矩阵，导致指数衰减，无法精确记忆；近期理论工作（Grazzi 等、Khavari 等）证明此类线性 RNN 无法在有限精度下求解奇偶校验问题，且需要同时满足输入依赖门控和非正特征值两个条件。因此需要一种专为离散状态跟踪设计的新型架构。
AI.method: CSP 的核心设计包括：(1) 仅传递隐藏状态：消除 Mamba 类架构中 B·C 复合投影的低秩瓶颈，状态直接跨层传播；(2) 复数旋转机制：每个复数维度独立学习旋转角度 θ_t = tanh(W_θ z_t^real)·π，逐元素应用 e^{iθ_t}⊙z_t（不同于 RoPE 的 2D 块对角旋转）；(3) 单块四阶段操作：Rotate → Recur（h_t = α_t h_{t-1} + γ_t z̃_t）→ Skip（SiLU(h_t) + σ(g)⊙z_t）→ Norm（h̃_t/|h̃_t|，投影到单位圆）；(4) 块级跳跃连接 + 序列边界 SiLU 激活，避免逐步非线性破坏相位信息；(5) Focal Loss（γ=2.0, α=0.25）防止类别不平衡导致的"懒惰学习"。
AI.result: 在三个标准任务上：奇偶校验（5000 样本，序列长度 16）、模 3 计数（5000 样本）、括号匹配（10000 样本，平衡 50/50），隐藏维度 64、3 层、训练 300 轮的配置下，CSP 均达到 100% 准确率和 F1=1.0。收敛速度随任务难度递增（奇偶校验约 50 epoch，括号匹配约 150 epoch）。消融实验证明：(a) 无旋转机制则全部任务退化至随机水平；(b) 复数归一化不可被标准 LayerNorm 替代；(c) 块级跳跃连接对深层传播关键；(d) 逐步 SiLU 持续劣于块边界激活；(e) Focal Loss 是模 3 和括号匹配任务必需的（交叉熵分别仅 67% 和 F1=0.0）。还观察到显著的"顿悟"（grokking）现象：长时间平台期后出现急剧相变，梯度范数同步出现尖峰，10 个随机种子的顿悟间隔为 3.2±1.2（奇偶校验）、8.4±2.1（模 3）、12.7±3.4（括号）epoch。
AI.conclusion: 状态传播（不经过中间输出投影）足以解决确定性状态跟踪任务。复数旋转提供了离散跟踪的正确归纳偏置；线性时序状态更新配合序列边界非线性优于密集逐步激活；块级跳跃连接稳定多层复数状态网络；Focal Loss 防止相位对齐过程中的优化崩溃。未来工作方向是引入层间低秩耦合（u_l v_l^⊤ h_t^{(l-1)}）以提升深层堆叠时的参数效率，同时保留跨层信息流。

title: DataSpace: Benchmarking Data Agents for Verifiable Analytics over Heterogeneous Workspaces
comment: 8 pages of main text, 7 figures, with a supplementary appendix
summary: Data agents enable natural-language analytics over organizational workspaces, where relevant evidence may be scattered across databases, structured files, long documents, and multimedia. Existing benchmarks largely isolate structured querying, retrieval, or open-ended analysis, leaving heterogeneous evidence discovery, complete tabular outputs, and deterministic evaluation insufficiently unified. We introduce DataSpace, a benchmark in which data agents produce verifiable tabular results from task-local heterogeneous workspaces. It contains 410 cross-language tasks and 7,439 artifacts totaling 15.01 GB across CSV, JSON, SQLite, Markdown, PDF, and video. DataSpace also served as the official evaluation benchmark for the KDD Cup 2026 Data Agents for Complex Data Analysis competition. Each agent receives only a question and workspace and returns the complete requested tabular result. We construct DataSpace with DataSpace-Builder, an execution-grounded framework comprising cross-language transformation, constraint-aware relational sampling, modality routing and artifact rendering, and human review and task repair by 11 domain experts. A deterministic evaluator performs header-invariant column alignment, type- and precision-aware normalization, and order-aware row comparison. Across six recently released frontier multimodal models and five widely used agent harnesses, the best accuracy reaches 66.34%, while harness choice creates a 15.36-point spread with the backbone fixed. Multimodal evidence integration and joins consistently reduce accuracy across all six backbones. These results show that DataSpace remains unsaturated and identify key challenges for improving data-agent reliability.

AI.tldr: DataSpace 是一个面向"工作空间求解器"型数据智能体的可验证基准，包含 410 个跨语言异构任务、7,439 个 6 类模态（CSV/JSON/SQLite/Markdown/PDF/视频）工件（总计约 15 GB），每个任务要求返回一个完整的表格化结果；通过 DataSpace-Builder 四阶段执行落地流水线（跨语言迁移、约束感知采样、模态路由与渲染、11 位专家盲审与修复）构建，并配备表头无关、按列类型与精度规范化、行序可配置的确定性评估器，已作为 KDD Cup 2026 官方评测基准发布。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据智能体基准各自孤立于结构化查询（如 Spider/BIRD）、非结构化检索（如 HotpotQA、MMLongBench-Doc）或开放分析（如 KramaBench、FDABench），未能统一三项关键性质：(L1) 任务级工作空间应同时涵盖数据库、结构化/半结构化文件、长文档与多媒体，且问题与工件可跨语言；(L2) 输出契约应要求完整表格而非事实片段或报告；(L3) 评估应确定性、能接受等价表示并拒绝不完整或错误的结果。DataSpace 旨在填补该缺口，为真实异构数据分析场景提供统一、严格、可复现的评测基座。
AI.method: 提出 DataSpace-Builder 四阶段执行落地流水线，基于 EHRSQL 与 BULL 两个可执行 Text-to-SQL 源语料构建：(1) 跨语言迁移——联合翻译数据库、SQL 与问题，建立表/列/值三层替换映射并通过执行等价与 LLM 语义审计保持可执行性与意图忠实度；(2) 约束感知关系采样——按 SQL AST 与外键构建保障集，结合关系闭包进行任务级局部数据库采样并重新执行以生成参考答案；(3) 模态路由与工件渲染——基于种子化的查询无关路由策略将采样表渲染至 CSV/JSON/SQLite/Markdown/PDF，并通过查询条件化的证据原子选择与分镜合成（DataMagic 风格）生成数据洞察视频；(4) 人类评审与修复——11 位领域专家盲审、证据锚定提交、独立撰写评估配置（列类型、数值精度、是否有序），达成一致后方可发布。评估器对预测做表头无关的列置换搜索、按列类型与精度规范化、并在有序/无序两种视图下完成行级精确匹配，输出 Task Accuracy 作为唯一聚合指标。
AI.result: 在 6 个 2026 年发布的前沿多模态模型与 5 种主流代理框架上：(1) 最佳受控准确率 66.34%（Grok 4.5，DataSpace-Agent 固定），整体区间 28.54%–66.34%；(2) 固定 MiMo-V2.5 骨干后，框架选择带来 15.36 百分点差距（Grok Build 46.34% vs Smolagents 30.98%）；(3) 多模态任务相对单模态在全部 6 个骨干上一致下降 1.8–14.0 分，连接操作一致下降 9.7–19.8 分；(4) 效率方面 GPT-5.6 Sol 较 Grok 4.5 仅落后 1.71 分而节省 74.2% token、50.3% 动作与 39.2% 时延，MiMo-V2.5 单任务成本仅 $0.011；(5) 136 例 Grok 4.5 失败溯源显示"答案物化"占 52.2%，其中 56.6% 源自目标结果误解与列投影错误。基准尚未饱和（76 题全军覆没），六模型 oracle 并集仅 81.46%。
AI.conclusion: DataSpace 提供了首个统一"任务级异构工作空间 + 完整可验证表格输出 + 确定性表头无关评估"的基准，并通过执行落地构建流程与跨语言跨模态扩展证明了其可规模化性；实证结果揭示了数据智能体在跨模态证据整合与连接推理上的系统性瓶颈，以及代理框架设计对端到端成功率的关键影响，为提升真实企业级数据分析的可靠性确立了严格且仍在饱和之下的测试基座。该工作已被选为 KDD Cup 2026 官方评测基准，代码与数据集以 MIT 协议公开。

title: LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language modeling, yet the scaling behavior of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dLLMs remains poorly understood. We systematically characterize how optimization hyperparameters, compute allocation, and architecture scale for MoE dLLMs, identifying quantitative differences from scaling trends previously reported for AR models. Specifically, for optimization, the optimal nominal batch size grows faster, while the optimal learning rate decays more rapidly with compute. For model--data allocation, IsoFLOP analysis reveals a slight data-side tilt: the optimal token budget grows faster than activated model-side computation. For MoE architecture, larger scales increasingly favor larger expert pools at fixed activated capacity, while moderate expert granularity remains consistently effective and the preferred fraction of activated capacity assigned to shared experts remains stable across scales. Guided by these findings, we train LLaDA MoE v2, a 30B-A3B dLLM, from scratch on 23.5T tokens. With approximately 65\% as many pretraining tokens as Qwen3, LLaDA MoE v2 approaches Qwen3 on several knowledge, reasoning, and coding benchmarks. After supervised fine-tuning alone, it outperforms SDAR Chat on seven of eight reasoning and coding benchmarks and remains close to Qwen3 on several tasks. These results establish practical scaling laws and design principles for MoE dLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了混合专家(MoE)扩散语言模型(dLLM)在优化超参、计算分配和MoE架构三个维度上的扩展规律,基于此训练了30B-A3B的LLaDA MoE v2,以65%的预训练token量逼近Qwen3,SFT后在8项推理与代码基准中7项超越SDAR Chat。
AI.motivation: 现有dLLM扩展研究多聚焦稠密架构,而新兴的MoE dLLM直接沿用自回归(AR)模型的设计经验。但由于dLLM采用掩码去噪目标、仅在掩码位置施加监督、且路由面对的是随噪声水平和掩码模式变化的损坏序列而非因果前缀,AR经验不能直接迁移,MoE dLLM的扩展行为缺乏系统刻画。
AI.method: 三阶段标定:(1)在158M至3.6B模型、10^18至3×10^20 FLOPs范围内拟合最优名义batch size和学习率的幂律;(2)在10^17至10^20 FLOPs下做IsoFLOP扫描,拟合激活模型端FLOPs与训练token的最优分配前沿;(3)在五个参考算力下,分别扫描激活比A、专家粒度G和共享专家比S,保持激活预算M*(C)固定。基于所得标定结果设计(A,G,S)=(9.09%,8,33.3%),训练30B-A3B的LLaDA MoE v2,采用5阶段训练(2×10T预训练+2T退火+500B上下文扩展+1T长上下文退火),在23.5T token上从零训练,后接SFT。
AI.result: 标定结果:最优batch size B*=0.374·C^0.3481(增长陡于AR),最优学习率 η*=64.8·C^-0.2447(衰减更快于AR);计算分配呈数据侧轻微倾斜,M*∝C^0.475,D*∝C^0.525;架构上,大规模更倾向低激活比,专家粒度G=8–16跨规模稳健,共享专家比S=33.3%全局最优。下游表现:在15项基准上平均分58.60,优于SDAR Sci(+3.78);以约65%的Qwen3预训练token量在OlympiadBench(-2.22)、HumanEval(-2.44)等任务上接近Qwen3;SFT后在推理4项全胜、代码4项中3项胜SDAR Chat。
AI.conclusion: 工作建立了MoE dLLM的实用扩展定律与设计原则,证明AR经验是有用的先验但需针对dLLM去噪目标和路由器面对损坏序列的特性进行再校准,验证了扩展定律指导在大规模MoE dLLM训练中的实用价值。

title: Solver-Aware Decompositions for Programming-by-Example: When Dividing Requires Knowing how to Conquer
summary: Decomposition-based Programming-by-example (PBE) scales performance by splitting tasks into subtasks that a learned synthesizer solves: a decomposer predicts intermediate subgoals, and a synthesizer generates programs conditioned on them. Current approaches train the decomposer to imitate ground-truth ( GT) subgoals, implicitly treating decomposition quality as intrinsic to the task. We challenge this assumption: for bounded solvers with fixed inductive biases, GT decompositions reflect the annotator's factorization choices - not the solver's search dynamics. A decomposer trained to match GT decompositions may therefore propose subgoals that are logically valid yet intractable for the solver. We propose Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD), a training framework that retains supervised training on GT subgoals as a structural scaffold, while additionally optimizing the decomposer via direct feedback from a frozen synthesizer. Subgoals are rewarded based on the synthesizer's loss on the target program - a signal of subtask difficulty that encourages decompositions the solver can act on. Our experiments reveal an accuracy paradox: higher agreement with GT decompositions does not improve synthesis success - even though the synthesizer was trained on the very same GT data the decomposer is optimized to mimic. SAD instead learns decompositions that trade GT alignment for solver tractability, yielding consistent gains in synthesis and end-to-end task accuracy across two PBE domains. Moreover, SAD solves tasks that a GT decomposition oracle fails - empirical evidence that GT decompositions are not universally optimal for bounded solvers, and that decomposition quality is solver-relative, not intrinsic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD)训练框架，将分解器(decomposer)的训练与冻结合成器(synthesizer)的反馈直接对接，挑战了"分解质量是任务内在属性"的传统假设，揭示了GT分解对有界合成器并非普遍最优的"准确性悖论"。
AI.motivation: 当前基于分解的编程示例(PBE)方法通过让分解器模仿真值(GT)子目标来训练，隐含假设结构相似性是分解质量的可靠代理。然而，有界合成器具有自身的搜索动态和归纳偏差，逻辑有效但搜索难以处理的子目标会导致合成失败。作者挑战这一假设：分解质量应是相对于求解器的，而非任务内在的属性。
AI.method: SAD训练框架保留对GT子目标的监督训练作为结构支架，同时通过Self-Critical Sequence Training (SCST)利用冻结合成器的反馈优化分解器。奖励信号定义为合成器对GT程序的交叉熵损失的负值，反映子任务难度。通过采样与贪心分解在相同合成器下的比较，优势项捕获相对可处理性差异。完整目标函数结合监督损失、RL损失和熵正则化(λ=0.01)。合成器在分解训练前独立训练并完全冻结。推理时使用beam search (k=10)，融合分解与合成模型对数概率进行评分。
AI.result: 在三个PBE域(Deepcoder、Lambdabeam、Robustfill)上评估(5个随机种子，1000测试任务/种子)：1) SAD在Deepcoder和Lambdabeam上一致优于求解器盲基线(统计显著)，分布外长度泛化优势更明显(22.2% vs 10.7%相对提升)；2) 准确性悖论得到证实——求解器盲基线GT分解精度高2-3倍，但SAD合成精度更高；3) beam oracle分析表明增益源于生成而非排序；4) SAD解决了GT oracle无法解决的一致子任务(Deepcoder 63.2±6.7个，Lambdabeam 109.8±18.3个)，不到2%的SAD-only解与GT程序匹配；5) Robustfill域(分解顺序固定，无模糊性)上SAD与基线无差异，证实其机制在无分解模糊性时优雅退化为监督学习；6) 消融研究证实监督损失不可或缺——无L_sup时分解精度崩塌至2-9%，测试任务精度低于20%。
AI.conclusion: SAD建立了分解质量相对于求解器的实证基础。核心贡献是将分解重新定义为求解器依赖的决策问题：中间表征应针对固定求解器的下游可用性而非GT相似性进行优化。研究揭示了任何学习中间表征的系统中普遍存在的结构性错位问题——执行器发展出表征生产者无法感知的归纳偏差，GT监督本身无法纠正求解器认为难处理的部分。局限性包括：分解器需针对特定合成器重训；单步训练约束固定子任务粒度；需要GT程序。未来方向包括多步奖励设置、基于执行的奖励以及利用分解多样性进行集成覆盖。

title: LeanMem: Simple and Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for LLM-based agents to sustain interactions and reliably leverage distant history. However, existing memory systems typically process heterogeneous dialogue content through a uniform summarization and retrieval pipeline, leading to either excessive token consumption or irreversible loss of fine-grained evidence. We argue that historical dialogue content should be handled differently according to its compressibility, temporal dynamics, and fidelity requirements. Based on this insight, we propose LeanMem, a lightweight long-term memory framework. LeanMem first filters out low-value content, then stores informative segments as compact profile memory, temporally structured event memory, or source-grounded record memory, depending on the nature of the information. During maintenance, only dynamically evolving event memories are selectively updated, avoiding redundant consolidation of stable profiles and immutable records. During inference, LeanMem dynamically selects memory types and allocates retrieval budgets according to query-specific evidence demands, assembling relevant evidence on demand. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S with GPT-4.1-mini and Qwen3-8B, LeanMem improves accuracy over the strongest memory-based baseline in every setting, by up to 15.1 points, at the lowest or near-lowest construction cost, inference tokens, and latency. The code and datasets are included in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: LeanMem是一个轻量级LLM智能体长期记忆框架，通过将对话内容按可压缩性、时间动态性和保真度需求分类存储为profile（配置文件）、event（事件）和record（记录）三类异构记忆，并采用选择性记忆演化和查询自适应的证据组合，在两个长对话问答基准上以最低或接近最低的构建/推理开销实现了最优准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统对异构对话内容采用统一的摘要与检索流程，在"高效压缩"与"细粒度保真"之间存在两难权衡：激进压缩会丢失原始细节证据，统一处理则导致大量token浪费。论文观察到对话信息的可压缩性、时间动态性和保真度需求本质上是异构的，不应一刀切处理。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：（1）Controlled Memory Writing——对对话进行关键话语过滤与主题分割，由LLM调度器按稳定性、时间依赖性、保真度三个维度将片段路由到ignore/profile/event/record四类写动作，profile存储结构化属性，event保留事件主题-时间锚-状态描述，record保留检索gist+实体关键词+源指针；（2）Selective Memory Evolution——仅对动态event记忆做延迟、局部化、按主题和时间锚的有序合并，profile与record不参与演化；（3）Adaptive Evidence Composition——由LLM规划器根据查询的证据需求选择相关记忆类型并分配检索预算，按记忆类型加权重排序并组装证据。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo与LongMemEval-S上使用GPT-4.1-mini和Qwen3-8B，LeanMem在所有设置下均优于最强记忆基线，准确率最高提升15.1点；相比A-Mem构建token降低最高17.24倍、推理token降低最高8.41倍，且构建/推理token与延迟均为最低或接近最低；消融实验表明存储调度与检索规划贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 通过按信息属性分型的异构记忆表示、仅对演化信息的局部化维护，以及按查询需求自适应的证据组装，LeanMem在避免冗余写入的同时保留了支持下游推理所需的细粒度证据，证明了"差异化处理对话信息"是兼顾效率与保真度的有效路径。

title: ChartAnno: Evaluating MLLMs for Chart Annotation Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in chart understanding, generation, and editing, but their ability to annotate existing charts remains underexplored. Annotating charts is a common yet challenging communicative task, requiring models to infer intended messages, interpret chart semantics, and place appropriate textual or graphical elements. To address this gap, we introduce ChartAnno, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on chart annotation generation. It contains 1,200 real-world charts with paired code and annotation instructions across three levels of instruction specificity. We evaluate 10 representative MLLMs under two primary input settings: (1) chart code alone and (2) both chart code and chart image, and further include a chart image-only ablation study. Results show that proprietary models remain stronger overall, although large-scale open-source models narrow the gap. More specific instructions improve annotation quality, while inferring abstract intent remains most difficult for current MLLMs. Providing chart images brings limited overall gains, with improvements mainly appearing in design-related metrics. These findings highlight chart annotation generation as a challenging task requiring semantic grounding and effective annotation design. Code and data will be released in a future version.

AI.tldr: ChartAnno 是一个用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图表注释生成任务上表现的基准测试。它包含1,200张真实世界的图表，配套代码和三级指令（意图级、操作级、实现级），共3,600个样本。该研究评估了10个代表性MLLMs，覆盖执行、结构、语义和设计四个维度的评估指标。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLLMs在图表理解、生成和编辑方面已取得显著进展，但其在现有图表上添加注释（chart annotation）的能力仍未被充分探索。图表注释是一项常见的交流任务，需要模型推断作者意图、解读图表语义并放置恰当的文本或图形元素，区别于一般的图表编辑任务（后者通常基于具体指令修改图表）。现有基准测试主要关注图表生成或直接编辑，缺乏针对注释生成任务的专门评估，且评估标准往往较为通用或启发式，缺乏可视化领域知识的支撑。
AI.method: （1）构建ChartAnno基准数据集：从公开图表数据集和arXiv论文中的科学图表中筛选1,200张图表，手动精炼图表结构和代码；为每张图表构造三个特异性级别的注释指令——意图级（高层交流目标）、操作级（注释动作和目标关系）、实现级（具体渲染参数），共形成3,600个样本。（2）评估设置：两种主要输入设置——仅代码输入、代码+图像输入，并附加图像单独输入的消融研究。（3）评估指标：结合基于规则和LLM评判的混合评估，涵盖执行率（Execution Rate）、结构合规性（Structural Compliance）、语义一致性（Semantic Consistency）和设计有效性（Design Effectiveness）四个维度。（4）模型选择：评估4个专有模型和6个开源模型，共10个MLLMs。
AI.result: （1）专有模型整体更强，但大规模开源模型缩小了差距：Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview在专有模型中表现最佳，Kimi K2.5在开源模型中领先，性能可比肩部分专有模型。（2）指令越具体，注释质量越高，但抽象意图级（Intent-level）推断仍是最困难的。（3）添加图表图像带来的整体收益有限，主要改善集中在设计相关指标。（4）仅图像输入设置下性能显著降低。（5）复杂图表仍是挑战，代码token增量、指令长度和注释类型数量是性能下降的主要因素。（6）不同指令级别之间的过渡效果不均衡。
AI.conclusion: ChartAnno填补了图表注释生成评估的空白，强调该任务需要语义基础和有效的注释设计。当前MLLMs在抽象意图推断方面仍存在显著不足，图像信息对注释生成的贡献有限，尤其是在非设计维度上。研究表明，图表注释生成是一个具有挑战性的任务，要求模型同时具备语义理解、意图推断和视觉设计能力。该基准为未来MLLMs在图表注释方向的研究提供了重要参考，代码和数据将在未来版本中发布。

title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) com- monly optimizes each correct completion as an independent learning signal. In GRPO, this completion-level uniformity creates structure-level skew: recurring correct solution forms accumulate positive coefficient mass in proportion to how often they are sampled, while rare forms receive limited credit. We formalize this behavior as multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration and introduce a partition- conditioned rule that redistributes positive advantages accord- ing to cluster rarity. Cue-GRPO instantiates this rule with- out auxiliary-model inference by using deterministic Strategy Cues to construct rollout-local partitions of verified-correct traces. Across Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Cue-GRPO improves AIME repeated-sampling performance, with the largest gains at high sampling budgets. Credit Re- distribution (CR) under Judge Partitions (JP) further indi- cates that the proposed redistribution mechanism can oper- ate with judge-derived partitions. Cue-GRPO adds only 6% wall-clock training overhead over GRPO. These results sup- port structure-level credit redistribution as a practical design axis for RLVR, with Strategy Cues providing a low-overhead implementation for competition mathematics. Code is avail- able at this https URL Repeat-Rarity-Aware-Credit-Redistribution-for-GRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了GRPO中"多解性导致的结构级信用集中"现象（即相同解法反复出现时其总正优势系数会随频次线性增长），提出基于分区的稀有度感知信用再分配（CR）规则，并实例化为Cue-GRPO：使用确定性策略线索（Strategy Cues）从推理轨迹中提取数学操作与过程标记，将已验证正确的补全聚类后再分配正优势，仅增加约6%训练开销。
AI.motivation: GRPO对所有正确补全赋予相同的正基础优势，当多个补全共享同一解法结构时，该结构累积的正信用与出现频次成正比（结构级频次偏斜），而罕见正确结构仅获少量信用。这与高预算重复采样（pass@k）场景下保留多样化正确模式的需求不匹配。现有工作（如UARL）依赖辅助LLM裁判分组，开销大（~62%）。
AI.method: 1) 形式化结构级信用集中：M_GRPO(S) = n_S · A⁺。2) 提出分区条件CR规则：引入稀有度指数α∈[0,1]，对已验证正确补全按 |C_i|^{-α} 重新加权，保持总正系数不变；α=0退化为GRPO，α=1赋予各簇相等总信用。3) Cue-GRPO用27个固定策略线索（含LaTeX符号与自然语言触发词）经分组级抑制、连通图聚类构建分区；4) 通过剪辑、孤立点重置、加性下限τ进行有限群稳定化。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，AIME AUC@256从39.89（GRPO）提升至42.75（Cue-GRPO），优于32B裁判UARL（38.25）；Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上AUC@256从23.92提升至25.71；CR-JP控制实验证明CR可与裁判分区兼容；消融验证稀有度塑形、策略线索聚类、加性下限均有贡献；多种子下平均AUC@256增益+1.80；实证簇大小-系数质量斜率从1.00降至0.72，符合预期再分配方向。
AI.conclusion: 结构级信用再分配是RLVR的一个实用设计维度：分区构造与信用分配是可分离的两个组件。策略线索为竞赛数学提供了低开销实现，CR-JP证明该机制也能与裁判分区协同工作。未来可将同一视角扩展到更丰富的结构表征以覆盖更广泛推理领域。

title: ToolLIFT: Lifting Tool-Specific Trajectories into Function-Level Graphs for Generalizable Tool Planning
summary: Historical tool-use trajectories provide valuable experience for large language model (LLM) agents to plan and coordinate tool usage. Existing approaches directly construct tool-level graphs from these trajectories, but the resulting graphs remain tied to specific tools and are hard to generalize across tool sets. To tackle this challenge, we find that despite differences in the tools involved, analogous tasks often share a common function-level workflow structure, which serves as a potentially more transferable abstraction for tool planning. Based on this insight, we propose ToolLIFT, a framework that lifts tool-specific trajectories into a function-level workflow graph (FWG) for generalizable tool planning. Specifically, we first propose a trajectory-lifting mechanism that encodes workflow structures in the FWG and shares collaboration experience across tools. Then, building on the global structure of the FWG, we introduce decoupled workflow planning and tool selection to align individual tool choices with the overall workflow. Lastly, to ensure reliable tool dataflow, we adopt Reinforcement Learning (RL) and propose source-gated and skill-specific rewards to maintain source-traceable information flow across tool calls. Experiments on two in-distribution (ID) and three out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks show that ToolLIFT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating strong generalization to unseen tool sets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToolLIFT框架，通过将工具特定的轨迹提升到函数级别的工作流图（FWG），实现跨工具集的可泛化工具规划。该方法解决了现有工具级图方法在未见工具集上泛化能力差、缺乏全局工作流视角以及工具调用间参数数据流不可靠三个核心问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的工具规划方法直接从历史轨迹构建工具级图，但这些图与具体工具绑定，难以泛化到未见过的工具集。此外，逐步规划缺乏全局视野，且随着上下文中工具输出累积，参数来源追踪越来越不可靠，容易产生幻觉值或错误的依赖关系。
AI.method: ToolLIFT包含三个核心组件：(1) 通过轨迹提升构建函数级工作流图(FWG)：将工具schema分解为功能描述和领域描述，用BGE-M3编码后通过UMAP+K-means聚类成L个功能簇，再将工具级轨迹提升为函数级工作流并统计转移概率形成FWG；(2) 解耦的工作流规划与工具选择：先基于查询特定的FWG子图全局规划完整的功能工作流，再在功能约束下实例化具体工具；(3) 基于RL的数据流学习：使用GRPO两阶段训练，引入源门控和技能特定奖励，将每个参数显式标注为直接值或对前序工具输出的引用，确保源可追溯的信息流。
AI.result: 在2个ID基准（HuggingFace、Multimedia）和3个OOD基准（DailyLifeAPIs、Seal-Tools、ToolAlpaca）上使用Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B两个骨干模型均一致优于五个基线方法（Tool-Planner、ToolNet、DFSDT、GTool、ToolRL）。在OOD设置上提升尤为显著，例如Llama在DailyLifeAPIs上Acc提升4.69点。消融实验验证了FWG引导、工作流规划器、依赖感知奖励和工作流扰动各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: ToolLIFT通过函数级抽象实现了工具规划在未见工具集上的强泛化能力，验证了"类比任务常共享功能级工作流结构"这一核心洞察。两阶段GRPO训练配合源门控奖励有效提升了参数源追踪可靠性。当前局限在于假设每个参数只有单一信息源，未来工作将扩展到支持从多个上下文项或工具输出联合派生的参数。

title: WeClawArena: An Auditable Sandbox and Benchmark for Cross-User Agents Collaboration and Security in Human-Centered Agent Networks
summary: Recent advances in persistent personal-agent frameworks are making human-centered agent networks realistic deployment targets: each user can be served by an AI agent that acts on the user's behalf, maintains state, and communicates with other agents through social and task relations. In these networks, everyday tool use becomes multi-party owned-agent collaboration over personal workspaces, where files, records, tools, and policies are not directly visible across owners. Existing agent benchmarks study tool use and collaboration, but they do not provide an end-to-end sandbox for verifiable cross-user agent collaboration with realistic user digital workspaces or test how harmful actions can travel through the human-centered agent network. We introduce WeClawArena, an auditable benchmark and runtime sandbox for multi-party owned-agent collaboration over personal workspaces. WeClawArena targets collaborative tool-use tasks in which personal workspaces serve as both operational tools and personal constraints. The benchmark contains 124 base tasks across six cross-user task domains and expands them into 620 scenario variants, with one benign control and four attack-vector variants per base task. The sandbox records peer messages, tool calls, resource operations, governed decisions, and final workspace states. WeClawArena reports utility and attack success rate separately and audits attack success from bounded runtime evidence, supporting diagnosis of task breakdown, privacy leakage, poisoned evidence, and invalid authority paths.

AI.tldr: WeClawArena 提出了一种可审计的多方工具使用协作沙箱与基准测试，面向以个人工作空间为基础的人本智能体网络。它包含 124 个跨用户基础任务与 620 个场景变体（涵盖议价、竞标、旅行、SWE工作空间、临床与交易六个领域），每个基础任务配对一个良性对照与四种攻击向量（协作、安全、隐私、治理）。沙箱通过 Docker 化的工作空间与网关接口记录通信、工具调用、资源操作、治理决策与最终状态，将任务效用与攻击成功率分开报告，并对最终危害进行基于有限运行时证据的审计。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准（如 τ-bench、AgentBench、GAIA、MultiAgentBench 等）多聚焦于单用户工具使用、共享沙箱或社交沟通模拟，缺乏针对"多方拥有智能体跨个人工作空间协作"的端到端可验证测试环境。在人本智能体网络中，文件、记录、工具与策略对各所有者不可见，攻击者压力同样会通过合法协作渠道传播。论文指出三个待解决的研究问题：(RQ1) 当信息、工具与决策权分散于各个人工作空间时，智能体能否完成工具使用协作任务；(RQ2) 协作、安全、隐私与治理层面的最终危害是什么；(RQ3) 运行时证据能否支持对最终危害与良性结果进行归因审计。
AI.method: 论文形式化定义人本智能体网络中的个人工作空间节点 (u, A_u, W_u)，其中 W_u 包含文件系统、数据库、工具集与策略集；任务实例 z 由任务图、私人指令、初始状态、动作集、状态转移、任务契约与验证器构成。基准采用 Docker 化的所有者工作空间与网关接口进行消息路由与工具调用拦截，记录对等消息、工具调用、资源操作、治理决策与最终状态。每个基础任务通过人工标注扩展为五个变体（一个良性对照与四种攻击向量），攻击材料以消息、文件或数据库行注入但不得直接修改最终评分字段，攻击必须经由智能体行为才能转化为最终危害。评估采用双层设计：(1) 效用（任务成功率 TSR）由最终多工作空间状态与确定性验证器判定；(2) 攻击成功率（ASR）由离线 LLM 评判器（如 GPT-5.2 头条评判器与 Claude Opus 4.7 敏感性检查）在有界证据包上后验判定，并要求存在攻击材料与最终危害之间的证据链。同时报告无攻击者行的良性假阳性率，并对评判器与人专家标注进行了 Cohen's κ 验证。
AI.result: 八个模型在六个领域的实验显示：(1) Claude Opus 4.7 在综合效用（旅行 83%、议价 63.3%、SWE工作空间 34%、竞标 55%、临床 36%、交易 30%）与抗攻击性（ASR 3.0%，所有向量中最低）上表现最强；(2) 治理与安全是最易受攻击的危害面（治理 ASR 50.3%，安全 ASR 42.5%），协作危害最低（18.3%）；(3) 安全压力在议价与竞标中占主导，隐私与治理压力在 SWE 工作空间中最强；(4) 117 行同时完成任务且达到攻击成功——智能体在保留可见任务完成的同时产生了跨用户最终危害（如 Kimi K2 Thinking 议价中采用中毒结算价完成订单、Claude Sonnet 4.5 SWE 工作空间中泄漏受保护的测试标识符、Claude Opus 4.7 旅行中拒绝伪造审批但以空审批标识提交预订）；(5) 评判器间 Cohen's κ = 0.70，人专家共识 κ = 0.82，GPT-5.2 对人专家 κ = 0.65，Claude Opus 4.7 对人专家 κ = 0.68，良性假阳性率均低于 1%。
AI.conclusion: WeClawArena 建立了"多方拥有智能体跨个人工作空间协作"作为人本智能体网络的具体基准设置。其核心贡献在于：(1) 形式化跨用户工具使用协作，将个人工作空间同时作为任务资源与策略边界；(2) 提供 124 个基础任务与 620 个匹配场景的基准，并配套受控运行时沙箱与评估协议；(3) 将效用与攻击成功率分离报告，并基于有限运行时证据审计最终危害。实验表明 TSR 与 ASR 不可互相替代：智能体可能在保留可见任务完成的同时泄漏隐私、接受无效授权或依赖被污染证据；TSR 下降与最终危害相关但不等同。论文将完整沙箱、任务验证器、评判提示与有界证据包发布，同时对完整攻击载荷进行编辑或限制访问，以平衡基准可复现性与降低可重利用风险。WeClawArena 为诊断协作型个人智能体在何处成功、何处失败以及危害如何经合法渠道传播提供了可复现的测试平台。

title: Can LLM design high-quality experiments? A Comprehensive and Systematic Benchmark on Autonomous Experimental Design
summary: AI for Research (AI4Research) leverages AI to automate and improve scientific workflows. While experimental design is a critical stage of the research process, prior work has focused primarily on code implementation and execution, overlooking the importance of this stage, and no benchmark exists to evaluate AI's ability to conduct systematic experiment design. To bridge this gap, we propose SCOPE, a Scientific COmprehensive Planning Evaluation Benchmark constructed from 300 high-quality latest papers across 19 research domains from top-tier venues (e.g., ICML, NeurIPS, and ICLR),evaluating LLMs on two dimensions: High-Level planning completeness (main, ablation, and analysis experiments) and Low-Level configuration accuracy and rationality (datasets, baselines, and metrics). Benchmarking reveals three findings: (1) most LLMs cannot directly design high-quality experiments; (2) all LLMs exhibit a performance bottleneck in low-level configuration; and (3) search mode does not improve design quality. Furthermore, to address these challenges, we propose OptED, a novel agentic workflow to optimize LLM-based experimental design, that enhances LLM-based experimental planning through stage isolation, tool augmentation, and rule-based constraints, effectively alleviating the configuration bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AI自主实验设计这一被忽视的关键科研环节，提出了首个系统性基准SCOPE（含300篇顶会论文、19个研究域、6个细粒度评估维度），以及基于阶段隔离的智能体工作流OptDE。通过评估7个主流LLM发现其在低层资源配置上存在显著瓶颈，且简单接入搜索反而可能降低高层规划质量；OptED在多个模型上实现了稳定的性能提升并有效抑制幻觉。
AI.motivation: 实验设计是连接方法构思与实证验证的关键阶段，直接影响结论可信度与可复现性。然而现有AI4Research系统主要聚焦假设生成、代码实现与执行，将实验设计降级为"从思路到代码"的副产品；现有基准（如Exp-Bench、AblationBench等）要么专注代码执行，要么仅评估消融等孤立子任务，缺少对完整、系统性实验设计能力的端到端、细粒度评估框架，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: （1）**SCOPE基准**：将实验设计分解为高层规划（主实验、消融实验、分析实验）与低层配置（数据集、基线、指标）两个层级共6个子维度，每维度由LLM-as-Judge按0–5分制依据详细评分细则打分，并引入redline机制对源幻觉、指标不兼容等致命缺陷直接判零；数据集经论文收集–结构化抽取（全局摘要+逐节对齐的summary-then-alignment流程）–质量精炼三阶段构建，仅保留评分≥35/50的任务。（2）**OptED工作流**：采用三阶段解耦（配置阶段专注资源筛选、协议阶段专注高层实验设计、报告阶段组装），在阶段间通过Think-Act-Observe循环与原子化工具调用（数据集/基线CRUD、实验步骤编辑）协作，并嵌入显式行为规范（如消融单变量原则、配置阶段原则筛选清单），实现透明可审计的多步结构化实验设计。
AI.result: 在7个主流LLM上的基准测试显示：模型平均总分仅14.81/30（最高Claude 4.5 Sonnet 18.62 vs 最低Grok-4 12.55，差距6.07分）；所有模型在低层配置维度均显著落后于高层规划（平均差距2.78分，无任何低层子维度超过3/5）；5/7模型在CoT+Search与CoT-only间无显著差异，而GPT-5.2在搜索条件下甚至下降1.45分（红line率升至13.33%）。QWK人机一致性验证表明LLM评分达到substantial-to-excellent水平（κ_w=0.726–0.803）。OptED在6个模型上均带来稳定提升（DeepSeek-V3.2 +4.22、Grok-4 +3.67），并使GPT-5.2完全恢复搜索引起的退化（达20.47分），红line率显著下降（DeepSeek从14.00%降至2.67%、Gemini降至0%）；消融实验证实阶段隔离、Think-Act-Observe循环与行为规范三组件均对提升有独立贡献。
AI.conclusion: 本研究系统揭示了当前LLM在自主实验设计上呈现"高层规划尚可、低层配置薄弱"的统一瓶颈，并指出搜索能力的简单接入因引入未经结构化的外部信息可能干扰内部推理链；阶段隔离+工具增强+行为规范的智能体框架可有效缓解配置短板与幻觉问题，但高层与低层之间的固有性能差距仍未消除，精确资源选择仍是待解难题。未来工作可拓展至自然科学领域的实验范式、多轮迭代式实验规划场景以及更大规模基准更新以防过拟合。

title: Hybrid LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agents for Complex Sequential Decision Tasks
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, and tool-use, enabling new forms of autonomous agents. However, LLM-based agents struggle with long-horizon sequential decision tasks that require precise action optimization and environment interaction. Reinforcement Learning (RL), while effective for sequential control, often lacks the high-level abstraction and task decomposition abilities needed for complex scenarios. This paper introduces an LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent that integrates LLM-driven planning with RL-based action optimization. The proposed architecture leverages the LLM to generate subgoals, structured plans, and contextual guidance, while the RL agent refines low-level actions through interaction with the environment. Experiments on sequential decision tasks demonstrate improved sample efficiency, higher success rates, and more coherent action trajectories compared to RL-only and LLM-only baselines. This hybrid paradigm highlights a promising direction for building more capable autonomous systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种LLM增强的强化学习智能体架构，将LLM的规划能力与RL的精细动作优化相结合，以解决长视野序贯决策任务中的挑战。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在需要精确动作优化和环境交互的长视野序贯决策任务中表现欠佳，而传统RL虽擅长序贯控制但缺乏高层抽象和任务分解能力。两者各有局限，需要一种混合范式来弥补各自不足。
AI.method: 提出一种LLM增强的RL智能体架构，其中LLM负责生成子目标（subgoals）、结构化计划和上下文指导，而RL智能体通过与环境交互来优化低层动作。该方法将高层规划与低层控制解耦并协同工作。
AI.result: 在序贯决策任务的实验中，所提方法相比纯RL和纯LLM基线表现出更高的样本效率、更高的成功率以及更连贯的动作轨迹。
AI.conclusion: LLM与RL的混合范式是构建更具能力的自主系统的一个有前景的方向，验证了高层语言推理与低层动作优化协同的有效性。

title: When Many Answers Are Valid, Voting Fails: Symbolic Verification for Best-of-K Causal Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Self-consistency assumes the most frequent answer among sampled reasoning traces is the most reliable, but this can fail in causal reasoning: samples often repeat the same confounding error, and votes fragment across multiple valid answers, letting an invalid answer win despite a valid minority trace. We introduce CALVER (Causal Axiom-Level VERification), a training-free symbolic verifier that scores structured traces against Pearl's causal criteria, including -separation, backdoor adjustment, and intervention, and selects the highest-scoring candidate without consulting a reference answer. On CLEAR find-one-valid queries that admit multiple graph-valid answers, CALVER reaches 42.1% where plurality, a reward model, an LLM judge, and model confidence remain near 30% on identical frozen pools. Scaling the judge to 72B does not close the gap. In an audited clean-core subset, 11 of 21 graph-valid CALVER selections differ from the benchmark's listed answer while still satisfying the requested predicate. The advantage widens with the sampling budget and reproduces across ten published Bayesian networks, a second model family, and settings where the model must build the graph from text. CALVER also improves thresholded average-treatment-effect decisions against exact ground truth, generalizes to logic under a truth-table checker, and scores each candidate in milliseconds on CPU. CALVER needs only a causal structure, supplied outright or built from the text; wherever that holds, selection can aggregate via causal validity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CALVER（Causal Axiom-Level Verification），一种无需训练、基于符号验证的best-of-K选择器，通过对结构化推理轨迹按Pearl因果准则（d-分离、后门调整、干预等）进行六维确定性打分，在多答案合法场景中替代投票机制，显著提升LLM在因果推理任务中的选择准确率，并在逻辑任务中通过真值表验证实现泛化。
AI.motivation: 自一致性（self-consistency）依赖多数投票，但在因果推理中常因两类问题失败：（1）样本反复犯同一混杂错误；（2）多个合法答案分散票数，使单一非法答案以最高频胜出。即当多个输出在图上均有效时，答案字符串频率会惩罚正确性。需要一种直接验证候选是否属于任务合法性类的方法。
AI.method: 方法核心：（1）提出六槽位trace契约schema（graph, query, strategy, derivation record, computed result, answer）；（2）六个确定性二元检查位b_ij，对每个候选轨迹独立计算得分S_i∈[0,6]；（3）关键验证包括：X⊥_d Y|Z于G_下划线X（后门测试，ADMGs使用m-分离），ATE数值重计算|θ̂_i - ψ(P;X,Y,Z)|≤ε；（4）选择规则i* = min(argmax S_i)，同分取最早轨迹；（5）两种模式：supplied-graph使用源图G*；constructed-graph使用轨迹自建图Ĝ_i；（6）理论：严格ATE证书的soundness定理；validity fragmentation定理（Hoeffding+union bound解释投票失败）；查询级图关系恢复充分性定理。
AI.result: 主要结果：（1）在CLEAR clean core上（126题find-one-valid），CALVER达42.1%，而多数投票/奖励模型/LLM judge/模型置信度均在30%左右；（2）8种策略（Qwen 7B/14B/32B、Mistral NeMo 12B等）相对set medoid基线均提升（+4.4至+24.1pp）；（3）随K扩大至32，差距从K=2的7.7pp扩大到K=32的25.4pp；（4）bnlearn 10个贝叶斯网络验证：supplied图+17.1pp，文字重建图+14.2至+24.2pp；（5）泛化至K&K逻辑题（3/4/5人）：+27/+37/+16pp；（6）CPU上每候选打分1-8ms，开销比多数投票仅多约7%；（7）消融：移除语义有效性检查则低于首样本，节点重命名19676分数全不变（无语义泄漏），图损坏测试显示增益单调下降。
AI.conclusion: CALVER将best-of-K的聚合单元从答案字符串频率变为"候选是否属于任务定义的合法性类"的证据。在合法答案碎片化的场景中修复多数投票错误（576池中修复197个，引入54个），其优势随采样预算扩大而增长，并通过定理2的碎片化机制得到解释。适用边界清晰：当答案近乎唯一时best-of-K已足够；当文本到图提取可靠时，应采用一次性提取后精确求解（extract-then-solve在L1/L2达92.8%/96.7%）；CALVER适用于中间地带——多答案合法且单一提取不可靠。其通用性在于"可执行验证器"模式，可扩展至任何验证谓词可执行的任务（如真值表逻辑）。

title: Reversing Arrows in Large Language Models
comment: The preprint is under review in a venue
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on text-to-knowledge graph generation and related tasks. Nevertheless, it is still unclear whether they accurately model the direction-dependent semantics of inverse relations, in which reversing the order of the arguments alters the meaning of a relation (e.g., \textit{mother} versus \textit{child}). To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of inverse relation directionality in LLMs, using a benchmark consisting of 5,457 instances spanning 27 distinct inverse relation labels. We evaluate five open-source LLMs under a multiple-choice prompting framework and further examine the influence of relation descriptions and entity representations by substituting the original entities with synthetic and masked entities. Our findings reveal systematic asymmetries in inverse relation classification across LLMs, indicate that relation descriptions do not consistently improve performance, and show that model performance can be sensitive to variations in entity representations.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）是否准确建模逆关系（inverse relations）的方向性语义。作者构建了一个包含5,457个实例、涵盖27种逆关系标签的基准测试，评估了五个开源LLM在多选提示框架下的表现，并考察了关系描述和实体表示（原始/合成/掩码实体）对性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱是有向图，准确建模关系方向性对KG补全和语义准确性至关重要。现有研究表明关系分类模型在标签空间包含逆关系对时性能下降，但此前没有研究在句子级关系分类任务上系统评估LLMs对逆关系方向性的理解能力。LLMs已被广泛应用于文本到知识图谱生成等任务，因此有必要评估其是否真正掌握了逆关系的方向依赖语义。
AI.method: 1. 构建基准数据集：从FewRel 1.0和TekGen中选取逆关系对，通过SPARQL查询Wikidata验证关系方向，过滤后获得5,457个句子级实例，包含27种逆关系标签。2. 提示策略：采用零样本多选题提示（MCQ），每个提示包含三个候选选项——头到尾关系、其逆关系、以及一个负关系。3. 变量控制：(a)有无关系描述两种条件；(b)实体替换为合成实体（用Presidio Anonymizer）和完全掩码实体（XXX/YYY）。4. 评估模型：Flan-T5 XL、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3五种指令微调LLM。5. 统计方法：使用配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验和95% bootstrap置信区间进行显著性分析。
AI.result: 1. 方向性不对称：FewRel数据集上所有实体类型均存在统计显著的方向性差异（p<0.05），头尾方向macro-F1低于尾头方向；TekGen仅掩码实体条件下显著。2. 关系描述影响不一致：添加关系描述并未持续提升性能，仅在FewRel掩码实体条件下有边缘显著改善（p<0.1）。3. 实体表示敏感性：FewRel上原始实体与合成/掩码实体之间存在统计显著差异，TekGen上效应较弱且不一致。4. 最佳模型因设置而异：Llama-3.1-8B在FewRel尾头格式中表现优异，Flan-T5 XL在TekGen头尾格式中表现较好。5. 基于网络资源构建的基准可能高估模型泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在逆关系方向性识别上存在系统性不对称，关系描述并不能持续提升性能，模型性能对实体表示变化敏感。FewRel受关系方向性影响显著，而TekGen仅在掩码实体条件下受影响，表明LLMs可能受益于对FewRel和TekGen中实体或关系模式的先验暴露。未来的工作需要探索解耦实体熟悉度与匿名化过程中引入的语义变化的方法，并在更多基准上评估逆关系方向性。

title: Dr. AGENTONOMICS: A Didactic Experiment of AGENTONOMICS
comment: Technical report, Technical University of Munich
summary: AGENTONOMICS is a framework that treats AI agents as economic entities that can be designed, managed, and governed through an integrated management architecture. Dr. AGENTONOMICS is its first application: a lecture agent developed in the context of the TUM course on AI agents in business administration. Conceived during the winter semester 2025/26 and first introduced to students in the summer semester 2026, it serves as a didactic experiment in which the agent is both the object that students study and the medium through which they learn and apply the framework. The current prototype is a web-based, retrieval-grounded tutor that explains AGENTONOMICS concepts and supports student questions. This report argues that the same system can grow beyond tutoring into three additional cumulative roles: an avatar lecturer that delivers multimodal instruction, a design consultant that guides students through the AGENTONOMICS Design & Management Reference Framework (ADMRF), and a meta-agent that helps construct the agents students have specified. These roles are cumulative because they share the same interface, intelligence layer, tools, knowledge base, and ecosystem connection, while an orchestrator selects the role-specific algorithm required for each task. We present the architecture of the prototype, outline its development roadmap, and discuss its implications for a polycentric AI economy. This report is intended to invite further discussion on how agents can teach, apply, and eventually reproduce the frameworks by which they are designed.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Dr. AGENTONOMICS——AGENTONOMICS 框架的首个应用实例，作为慕尼黑工业大学（TUM）"商业管理中的 AI 代理"课程的教学实验代理。该系统被设计为可累积扩展的四个角色：导师（已实现）、虚拟形象讲师、设计顾问和元代理（元智能体）。当前原型是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的网页端导师代理，其架构由统一的 Agent Interface、Agent Intelligence、Tools and Vectors、Ecosystem 以及用于角色调度的 Orchestrator 组成。
AI.motivation: 在多中心（polycentric）AI 经济愿景下，价值创造依赖于大量专业化代理的协同。然而，代理的定义、构建与治理成本成为规模化瓶颈。论文以此为切入点，将教学场景作为天然的实验场：让学生通过既作为研究对象又作为学习媒介的代理来学习、应用并最终构建代理本身，遵循构造主义（constructionist）学习理念，同时通过实际构建过程检验框架的可行性与具体性。
AI.method: 1. 基于 AGENTONOMICS 设计与管理参考框架（ADMRF）的六大模块（Definition Frame、Building Blocks 等）进行系统设计；2. 采用 AGENTONOMICS 的 DBOT（Design-Build-Operate-Own-Transfer）生命周期逻辑与第二代图灵测试作为经济可行性准则；3. 架构上复用五个 Building Blocks（Agent Interface、Agent Algorithm、Agent Intelligence、Tools and Vectors、Ecosystem），并引入 Orchestrator 调度层，根据任务类型选择角色特异算法（推理-行动 / ReAct 模式）；4. 知识基础整合 AGENTONOMICS 手册、圣加仑管理学派及相关文献；5. 采用最小可行产品（MVP）方法，逐步迭代导师—讲师—顾问—元代理四个层级。
AI.result: 导师角色已实现：基于检索增强的网页端聊天代理，通过 constitution 风格的系统提示约束其学术语气、承认不确定性、严格隔离评分与决策功能。架构层面验证了四个角色的可累积性：共享接口、智能层、记忆与工具环境，仅由 Orchestrator 切换角色算法。路线图分四步推进：巩固导师检索质量、扩展多模态虚拟讲师、试点 ADMRF 引导式设计会话、最终实现元代理以工具调用方式构建学生所定义的代理。论文同时讨论了能力主权（capability sovereignty）、互操作性、身份管理与责任归属等治理议题。
AI.conclusion: Dr. AGENTONOMICS 的终点定位于元代理而非 AI-CEO，其经济意义不在于自身运营公司，而在于降低代理创建成本、充当多中心 AI 经济网络的候选节点生成器。项目的最终评判标准在于学生能否借助该系统定义并构建出经济上有意义（通过第二代图灵测试）的代理。后续工作包括课堂评估、原型迭代、设计顾问试点及基于工具的代理构建研究。

title: Behaviorally Adaptive Visual Diversion for Inclusive and Resilient Digital Assessment Delivery
summary: Institutions increasingly rely on browser lockdown, webcam monitoring, and behavioral analytics to secure high-stakes digital assessments, yet these mechanisms are commonly designed and evaluated independently and often overlook learner accessibility. This paper introduces Behaviorally-Adaptive Visual Diversion (BAVD), a theoretical framework in which a synthetic, non-semantic visual field is composited with assessment content and adaptively modulated according to observed candidate behavior. The underlying assessment content is never altered; only its visual presentation is modified to reduce the usefulness of unauthorized screen capture or screen sharing while remaining minimally intrusive for legitimate candidates. The framework further incorporates an accessibility-aware attenuation mechanism that reduces or suppresses diversion intensity for candidates with approved visual-processing accommodations. We formulate the model using a coupled dynamical-systems representation comprising a Diversion Field Generator, Rendering Tensor, Behavior Tensor, Composite Integrity Functional, and Multi-dimensional Entropy Model, and establish theoretical properties for content fidelity, rendering stability, entropy boundedness, integrity tracking, and closed-loop adaptation stability. The framework explicitly states its threat model, identifies deployment assumptions and limitations, and discusses the trade-off between accessibility and capture resistance. This work provides a mathematically grounded foundation for behaviorally adaptive and accessibility-aware assessment delivery and offers a basis for future empirical validation in trusted digital assessment platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出 Behaviorally-Adaptive Visual Diversion (BAVD) 理论框架，通过在测评内容上叠加合成的、非语义化的视觉干扰场，并根据考生行为进行自适应调节，在不改变原始测评内容的前提下降低截屏/共享的有用性，同时兼顾无障碍访问需求。
AI.motivation: 高风险数字测评的安全机制（浏览器锁定、摄像头监控、行为分析）通常被独立设计与评估，且普遍忽视考生的无障碍需求，亟需一种既能抗截屏/抗共享、又对合法考生友好（特别是有视觉处理障碍者）的统一框架。
AI.method: 构建一个耦合动力学系统模型，包含五个核心组件：Diversion Field Generator（干扰场生成器）、Rendering Tensor（渲染张量）、Behavior Tensor（行为张量）、Composite Integrity Functional（复合完整性泛函）以及 Multi-dimensional Entropy Model（多维熵模型）；并加入 accessibility-aware attenuation mechanism（无障碍感知衰减机制），在框架中显式给出威胁模型、部署假设与局限性。
AI.result: 在理论上证明了若干关键性质：内容保真度（content fidelity）、渲染稳定性（rendering stability）、熵有界性（entropy boundedness）、完整性追踪（integrity tracking）以及闭环自适应稳定性（closed-loop adaptation stability）；并分析了无障碍性与抗捕获性之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: BAVD 为行为自适应且无障碍感知的测评交付提供了数学上严谨的理论基础，可作为未来在可信数字测评平台上进行实证验证的研究基座。

title: Soft Guidance Starts to Outperform CoT Prompting as LLMs Improve
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting remains the standard baseline for evaluating models' reasoning abilities. Originally, this technique was introduced to elicit step-by-step reasoning from large language models (LLMs), which would otherwise tend to directly output the final answer. However, many modern LLMs produce CoT-style responses \textit{natively} when presented with reasoning tasks, which made us revisit the effectiveness of standard CoT prompting. We evaluate several modern mid-sized language models on a math problem-solving task and find that models specialized for reasoning achieve better performance in a simple zero-shot setting than when using few-shot CoT examples - significantly surpassing officially reported results at no additional cost (e.g., from $\sim$77\% to $\sim$84\% for Mathstral on GSM8K). For the tested general-purpose model, a zero-shot CoT prompt is also sufficient to outperform a few-shot CoT baseline. We attribute this to a `guidance-distraction' tradeoff: standard CoT prompting also demands style adaptation, formatting compliance, and potentially undesired contextualization, which can distract models from the core reasoning task. Our findings suggest that using standard CoT prompting increasingly acts as a source of distraction as models grow stronger.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，随着大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的提升，传统的少样本思维链（CoT）提示反而会损害推理专用模型的性能。简单的零样本评估在GSM8K数学基准上显著优于标准的少样本CoT基线（例如Mathstral从约77%提升至约84%），作者将此归因于"引导-干扰权衡"（guidance-distraction tradeoff）。
AI.motivation: Chain-of-Thought（CoT）提示自Wei等人(2022)提出以来，一直是评估LLM推理能力的标准基线。然而，现代推理专用LLM（如Mathstral）已在包含多步推理数据上大量训练，能够原生生成CoT风格的输出。在此背景下，作者质疑：(1) 标准CoT提示是否仍能有效提升这些模型的性能？(2) 继续使用少样本CoT作为评估基线是否低估了模型真实能力，并虚高了新方法的改进幅度？该问题尤其紧迫，因为官方模型发布报告仍普遍采用少样本CoT作为评估方案。
AI.method: 研究在GSM8K数学问题数据集上评估了三款中等规模模型：推理专用的Mathstral-7B、通用但增强推理的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，以及通用指令模型Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。为隔离"推理格式"的影响，所有少样本实验均采用随机示例选择，并设置多种提示变体：(1) 基于数据集示例的DS-CoT（±指令）；(2) 基于模型自生成示例的Self-CoT（自由形式或加入零样本CoT前缀）；(3) 零样本自由生成与零样本CoT基线。答案抽取采用规则匹配（+Rule）与提示引导（+Prompt）两种方式。所有生成使用贪心解码，结果取10个随机种子的平均值。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) 传统少样本CoT在推理专用模型上显著劣于零样本基线——Mathstral从最高74.2%降至83.8%，Qwen从83.4%提升至88.6%；(2) 即使使用模型自生成示例（Self-CoT）也无法超越零样本基线（针对Mathstral），表明干扰源于格式本身而非示例质量；(3) 在所有变体中Self-CoT+0shot（结合零样本CoT提示的模型自生成示例）表现最佳，但相对零样本CoT基线仅有边际提升；(4) DS-CoT+Rule性能随示例数量提升主要源于格式合规性的改善，而非推理质量提升（无效答案率随示例数锐减）；(5) 对Self-CoT+0shot的后处理清洗未带来稳定收益。零样本CoT相对自由生成的边际收益远小于Kojima等人(2022)的早期报告。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出"引导-干扰权衡"框架：标准CoT提示虽引导模型生成结构化推理，但同时引入了风格适配、格式合规与上下文整合等额外负担，对原生具备强推理能力的模型而言，这些负担构成了干扰而非增益。这一现象类似于早期机器学习中手工特征最终被端到端学习取代的演进过程。研究呼吁放弃将少样本CoT作为推理专用模型的默认评估基线，因为该做法系统性低估了模型能力并虚高了新方法相对其的改进幅度；建议改用零样本（自由形式或带CoT提示）评估作为更忠实、更具竞争力的衡量标准。

title: Enhancing Tabular Learners with Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings
summary: While modern tabular learners excel at capturing statistical patterns, they frequently operate in a semantic vacuum, treating textual features as discrete symbols, ignoring the rich semantics inherent in feature names or cell entries. We propose CASE (Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings), a novel framework that bridges the gap between the semantic understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the statistical capabilities of tabular learners. Unlike existing methods that embed rows in isolation, CASE utilizes a contextualization strategy: we pre-fill the KV cache of a custom-trained Gemma 3-based Tabular Language Model with a representative sample of rows to establish a persistent anchor of the dataset's semantics. This ensures that generated row embeddings are dynamically contextualized, resolving semantic ambiguities and anchoring representations in domain-specific context. Our experiments across several benchmarks (CARTE, TextTab, and TabArena) demonstrate that CASE substantially improves the performance of tabular learners on semantically rich datasets, particularly in low-data regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CASE (Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings) 框架，通过 KV-cache 预填充策略将大语言模型 (LLM) 的语义理解能力与表格学习器的统计能力相结合。具体而言：基于 Gemma 3 继续预训练一个表格语言模型 (TLM)，然后用训练集的样本行预填充其 KV 缓存以建立数据集的语义锚点，再为每行生成上下文感知的嵌入；这些高维嵌入经 PCA 降维后作为附加特征送入下游表格学习器。在 CARTE、TextTab、TabArena 和 STRABLE 等基准上的实验表明，CASE 在语义丰富的表格数据集上显著优于现有方法，尤其在低数据场景下提升幅度最大。
AI.motivation: 现代表格学习器 (如 GBDT、TabPFN) 擅长捕捉统计模式，但在"语义真空"中运行——将文本特征视为离散符号，忽略了列名和单元格中丰富的语义信息。LLM 虽具备世界知识和语义理解能力，但其序列化与分词对表格效率低下，难以将整表纳入上下文窗口。现有方法要么用启发式特征化 (TF-IDF/n-gram)，要么以隔离方式生成行/单元格嵌入，缺乏分布语义意识，导致语义歧义无法解决。本文旨在弥合 LLM 语义能力与传统表格学习器统计能力之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: CASE 框架包含两个核心阶段：(1) **TLM 预训练**：以 Gemma 3 (270M/1B/4B/12B) 为基础，采用列填充 (column-imputation) 目标在 T4 表格语料上继续预训练——将表格序列化为 (header + rows) 的 token 序列，损失仅计算在目标列 token 上，将表格预测建模为自回归生成任务。(2) **上下文感知语义嵌入 (Context Priming)**：从训练集随机采样 k=128 行 (含特征和标签) 序列化后输入 TLM，将生成的 KV 缓存保留为永久前缀；之后每行单独经过模型，复用该 KV 缓存，从最后一层 [BOT] token 位置提取行嵌入。这些高维嵌入 (d=4096) 经 PCA 降至 d'=32 维后，作为附加数值特征拼接到原始特征矩阵 X_org 上，供下游任意表格学习器 (如 TabICLv2、CatBoost 等) 使用。
AI.result: 在 CARTE 和 TextTab 等语义丰富基准上：(1) CASE 为五种表格学习器带来 2.9%–6.8% 的分类准确率提升和 3.8%–19.1% 的回归 R² 提升；(2) 与 TabICLv2 结合时取得最佳综合排名 (All Rank 2.7)，在 CARTE 上准确率达 81.0%、R² 达 77.5%，显著超越 AutoGluon、ConTextTab、RealMLP、TabPFN-2.6 等基线；(3) 即使 ConTextTab 本身已使用句子嵌入，仍能从 CASE 获益；(4) 在低数据场景 (128–8k 训练样本) 下优势尤为突出，验证了语义先验弥补统计信号不足的作用；(5) 参数规模与嵌入质量呈单调正相关 (270M→12B)；(6) 从 0 到 1k context token 出现显著的"上下文跳跃"，但继续增大 context 收益递减；(7) Decoder-only 架构优于 encoder-decoder (T5Gemma2)；(8) 在 STRABLE 基准上准确率从 65.1% 提升至 76.3% (+11.2%)，R² 从 49.1% 提升至 72.8% (+23.7%)；(9) 在语义破坏实验 (cipher substitution) 中，CASE 性能退化至非语义基线水平，证明其增益确实来源于真正的语义推理而非记忆；(10) 随机上下文采样和列排列的方差极小，结果稳健。在以数值特征为主的 TabArena 上略有下降，但绝对差距很小。计算效率上，CASE 将重型计算隔离到离线 fit 阶段，在线推理时延迟低于 TF-IDF 管道。
AI.conclusion: CASE 通过表格调优的 LLM 和 KV-cache 预填充策略，为语义丰富的表格数据提供了一种可插拔的语义增强方案，在低数据场景下尤为有效。框架具有通用性 (可与任意下游表格学习器结合)、稳健性 (对随机上下文和列排列不敏感) 和效率性 (在线推理快于 TF-IDF)。局限性包括：缺乏置换等变性、依赖均匀随机采样 (可能遗漏关键锚点行)、PCA 投影可能次优，以及基于 LLM 的方法固有的计算开销与数值归纳偏置不足。未来方向包括：开发针对表格结构的 LLM 架构 (置换不变注意力)、非线性流形学习替代 PCA，以及更智能的上下文选择策略。该工作为构建表格数据的基础模型提供了可扩展的蓝图。

title: Adversarial Fast-Moving Real-World Domains as Test Beds for Benchmarking AI Scientist Capabilities
comment: Accepted at the AI for Science workshop at ICML 2026. 14 pages, 11 figures
summary: Benchmarking the ability of AI scientists to generate novel ideas is notoriously difficult. Existing benchmarks in this field have made progress in evaluating scientific reasoning and research replication, but often rely on synthetic tasks or retrospective targets, which may be confounded by prior exposure. We hypothesize that complex, adversarial, fast-moving real-world domains where expert practitioners independently generate observable outputs can provide a practical solution to fill this gap and evaluate the capabilities needed for AI scientists, including reasoning, novelty, and hypothesis formulation. We instantiate this framework in two structurally different domains, Formula 1 (F1), where models ideate around car design concepts for the 2026 season, and real pre-season innovations provide a ground truth, and Magic: The Gathering (MTG), where models propose decks from a recently updated card pool and are evaluated against 19 Pro Tour (PT) decklists. Across both domains, models produce plausible outputs, but few align with real-world expert solutions. In F1, the best model, GPT-5.2 matched 10 of 40 real innovations with 166 ideas proposed across runs. In MTG, the best deck from Gemini 3 Flash recovered 5 of 7 new-set cards from the third-place PT deck, and across all 108 decks, the cards models selected most often were also the cards most widely adopted by PT decks (Spearman $\rho = 0.74$, $p = 0.0003$). These results suggest that a key capability gap for AI scientists is not idea generation, but filtering, prioritization, and coherent novelty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用对抗性、快速演进的真实世界领域（如F1赛车设计和万智牌构组）作为评估AI科学家能力的新型基准测试框架，验证前沿大模型在开放域创新任务中的真实表现。结果显示AI能产生看似合理的方案，但与人类专家成果对齐率低，核心瓶颈在于筛选、优先级排序与一致性新颖性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI科学家基准多依赖合成任务或回顾性目标，易受数据污染与先验暴露影响，难以真实评估模型产生真正新颖假设的能力。鉴于科学发现难以即时验证，作者希望寻找具备"信息截止时间"和"独立专家输出"特征的真实复杂领域，构建前瞻性、无信息泄露的评估范式。
AI.method: 提出"时间延迟生成评估框架"，需满足四个条件：受限但非平凡的设计空间、具备对抗性、产出可公开观察的下游产物、以及清晰的信息截止时间。实例化两个领域：（1）F1 2026技术规则下的赛车设计创新，以40项真实季前创新为真值；（2）万智牌Lorwyn Eclipsed新卡牌系列下的卡组构建，以19套Pro Tour卡组为基准。采用三智能体流水线（战略-分析-生成），在六款前沿大模型（GPT-5.2、o3、Gemini 3 Flash、Pro、Qwen3等）上运行，使用嵌入检索+LLM裁判+人工复核的三阶段匹配评估，以及确定性卡组重叠度量。
AI.result: F1领域：六个模型共生成881项候选方案，联合覆盖19/40（48%）真实创新；最佳模型GPT-5.2用166个想法匹配了10项真实创新；规则合规性与匹配率强相关（OR=8.92，p=2.9×10⁻⁶），但通用效应类（如Spell Snare、INTERFACE_COUPLING类型漏洞）被过度预测，而依赖组合上下文的"build-around"型卡牌（如Formidable Speaker）被系统性遗漏。MTG领域：108个生成卡组覆盖了14/19张PT新卡；最佳单卡组匹配（Gemini 3 Flash）恢复了7张PT新卡中的5张；卡片层面模型选择与PT采用率高度相关（Spearman ρ=0.74，p=0.0003）。工具调用脚手架提升了合法性但降低了新卡发现率（Wilcoxon p=0.031）。核心发现：模型的失败模式一致——容易识别表面价值明显的方案，但难以捕捉价值依赖支持语境才能涌现的创意。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性、快速演进的真实领域可作为评估AI科学家的实用中介测试平台。前沿模型偶尔能推理至与人类专家相同的复杂设计空间区域，但其输出仍具有噪声、弱校准、依赖评估选择的特性。AI科学家的关键能力差距不在想法生成，而在筛选、优先级排序与元对齐；未来AI科学家系统不仅需要生成假设，还需附加可信赖溯源、约束校验、可行性评估与证据搜寻能力。后续基准应预先注册协议，并结合模拟、CFD或实验室自动化等物理验证工具。

title: Policy Fragmentation or Institutional Alignment? Institutional Governance of AI in Universities and Business Schools
comment: Our insights suggest that policy guidelines should be aligned with broader institutional policies while addressing discipline-specific learning objectives and evolving workforce demands
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming high-skilled domains, requiring higher education institutions (HEI) to balance the teaching of foundational principles with the integration of emerging tools to ensure workforce readiness. While HEI are increasingly adopting AI, many continue to grapple with how it should be incorporated into curricula and governed through policy, especially when such policies are set at different levels of an institution. This research analyzes AI policies across HEI from 34 states in the United States to investigate what these policies entail and how policies set across institutions as well as within different levels at an institution differ. Using natural language processing (NLP) to analyze institutional AI policies, we find a clear divergence: university-level policies emphasize data security and risk mitigation whereas school-level policies, when present, focus on pedagogical applications and tool usage. When focusing on business school specific policies, relatively few business schools maintain AI policies distinct from university frameworks, creating misalignment with discipline-specific learning objectives. This gap poses challenges particularly for faculty and students as well as for accreditation purposes. Our insights suggest that guidelines should be aligned with broader institutional policies while addressing discipline-specific learning objectives and evolving workforce demands.

AI.tldr: 本文分析美国34个州的高等教育机构（HEI）人工智能政策的差异，发现大学层面政策侧重数据安全与风险防控，院系层面政策侧重教学应用与工具使用；商学院很少制定独立于大学的AI政策，导致与学科培养目标错位。
AI.motivation: 随着AI迅速改变高技能领域，高等教育机构面临在教学中平衡基础理论与新兴工具整合的挑战。许多高校虽已采用AI，但在课程融合与多层级政策治理方面仍存在困惑，亟需系统分析现有政策以指导实践。
AI.method: 采用自然语言处理（NLP）方法，对来自美国34个州的高等教育机构AI政策文本进行系统分析，比较大学层面、学院层面以及商学院特定政策的内容差异。
AI.result: 研究发现存在明显分化：（1）大学级政策强调数据安全与风险防控；（2）院系级政策（若存在）侧重教学应用与工具使用；（3）仅有少数商学院制定独立于大学框架的AI政策，造成与学科特定培养目标的错位，给师生和认证工作带来挑战。
AI.conclusion: AI政策应在与更广泛的院校政策保持一致的同时，回应学科特定的学习目标以及不断变化的劳动力市场需求；高校需构建既统一又具学科针对性的治理框架。

title: From Social Coding to Agentic Coding: Productivity and Relational Reconfiguration in Open-Source Communities
summary: Open-source software communities are a form of digital public infrastructure that not only produces code, but also generates public knowledge and interpersonal relationships through visible collaboration. Generative coding agents (CAs) are an advanced tool to improve development efficiency while shifting part of activities from public human interaction to private human-agent loops. We study this shift using an LLM-based multi-agent simulation initialized with real GitHub data from 1,084 active developers and their repository relationships. After a warm-up with historical commits, we branch the same community state into parallel No-CA and CA conditions for 4-week simulations. CA introduction increases planned and completed tasks by 34.0% and 39.0%, respectively, and reduces median completion time from 45 to 20 minutes. However, adoption reaches only 26.0%, and the gains concentrate among developers who are already more active and well connected. CAs also restructure task execution pathways. Direct human-human interaction declines from 32.4% to 11.6%, while CA-involved modes increase to 57.3%, including 40.3% completed through CA-assisted self-loops. Public knowledge generated under CA condition also provides less support for later tasks. On a standardized retrieval benchmark, the CA corpus achieves 22.3% knowledge coverage, far below the 81.1% achieved by the real-human corpus, and requires more retrieval steps with a lower success rate. These results reveal a productivity-public knowledge tension: coding agents increase technical production, but more work shifts to agent-mediated or private loops, leaving public records less useful to future contributors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过基于真实GitHub数据初始化的LLM多智能体仿真（1,084名开发者），对比4周无编码智能体（No-CA）与有编码智能体（CA）两种条件，揭示了生成式编码智能体在提升开源社区技术生产效率的同时，将大量协作活动从公共人际交互转向私有的人-智能体闭环，导致公共知识积累质量下降，形成"生产力-公共知识张力"。
AI.motivation: 开源软件（OSS）社区作为数字公共基础设施，其价值不仅在于代码产出，更在于通过可见的人际协作产生公共知识并支持新人融入与知识复用。生成式编码智能体（CA）虽能提升个体开发效率，但将大量中间过程保留在私有工作空间中，可能削弱OSS赖以维系的公共协作与知识积累机制。现有研究多关注个体层面效率，缺乏对社区级影响（任务执行路径重构、公共知识质量变化）的系统性考察。
