In this paper, we introduce \textbf{Approximate Speculative Decoding (ASD)}, a training-free verifier that replaces binary first-mismatch truncation with budgeted longest-prefix selection. ASD accepts selected mismatches subject to a local target-logit regret gate, a per-block exception cap, and a persistent request-level regret budget, then reuses the contiguous target-greedy suffix without additional approximate decisions or target-model forward passes. ASD requires neither a new draft model nor fine-tuning, and exactly reduces to standard greedy verification when the budget is zero. Experiments show that ASD improves fixed-workload throughput by $3.05\%$--$15.26\%$ over matched strict verification and averages a $7.78\%$ gain across seven Qwen3-14B + DSpark-14B tasks. On DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B) with DSpark it also raises verifier-side acceptance by roughly $10\%$--$16\%$ on GSM8K and MATH-500 in an FP4-to-FP8 compatibility setting. The source code is publicly available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"近似推测解码"（Approximate Speculative Decoding, ASD）的免训练验证器方法，通过预算控制的最长前缀选择替代传统推测解码中的二元首次失配截断策略，在不修改草稿模型或额外目标模型前向传播的前提下，实现了显著的自回归生成加速。
AI.motivation: 标准推测解码在贪婪验证下遇到首个草稿token与目标argmax不匹配时即停止，丢弃剩余已打分的后缀。这种二元决策将接近打平的草稿token与被强烈抑制的草稿token同等对待，浪费了目标模型已经计算的资源。此外，长序列中跨多个解码轮的廉价失配可能累积放大，导致解码轨迹持续偏移。需要一种显式控制局部与请求级偏差的近似验证机制。
AI.method: ASD将草稿-目标失配视为显式异常，通过三个互补约束选择最长可行前缀：(1)局部目标logit遗憾门控 r_i/q_i ≤ g，以剩余提议长度归一化的局部成本过滤昂贵失配；(2)每块异常上限 M，防止异常集中于单个提议块；(3)持久请求级遗憾预算 B 及已花费状态 s，约束整个请求的累积偏差。通过可行性掩码 f_{1:K} 的向量化实现（累积和+累积积）以 O(K) 算术计算最长全真前缀，无需额外目标前向传播。当 B=0 时严格回退为标准贪婪验证。若接受早期间隔，后续与目标argmax一致的后缀在"已实现前缀"下天然复用，无需额外近似决策。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-14B + DSpark-14B 配置 (B=8, g=0.25, M=2) 下，七个任务固定工作量吞吐提升 3.64%–11.73%（均值 7.78%），平均接受长度 τ 从 3.85 增至 4.20。跨草稿族（DSpark、EAGLE3、Medusa）的十个测试单元全部正收益（3.05%–15.26%，均值 7.52%），其中 Llama-3.1-8B + EAGLE3 在 GSM8K 上达到 15.26% 最大增益。DeepSeek-V4-Flash（284B）+ DSpark 在 FP4-to-FP8 兼容设置下提升 GSM8K 与 MATH-500 验证器端接受率约 10%–16%。消融实验显示预算响应呈饱和曲线，验证器逻辑开销仅增加 0.045–0.083 ms/输出token，同步减少目标验证开销 1.479–1.509 ms。多数任务精度变化非负，少数任务（如 HumanEval、MT-Bench）出现不超过 1.52 个百分点的精度波动，GSM8K/MATH-500 上哈希分歧率超 95%。
AI.conclusion: ASD 作为一种训练免费的验证器侧方法，通过受控的低遗憾异常复用目标已打分的后缀token，在严格推测解码之上实现高达 15.26% 的吞吐加速，七个 Qwen3-14B + DSpark-14B 任务平均 7.78% 增益，并在 DSpark、EAGLE3、Medusa 所有测试配置中保持正收益。由于无需目标或草稿模型重新训练，ASD 提供了与现有推测解码流水线广泛兼容的加速路径，但其本质是有界近似而非输出保恒优化，部署时需配合任务级质量审计。

title: Leveraging System-Level Observations to Inform Bayesian Learning of Model Parameters for Quantitative Verification
summary: Combining Bayesian learning and quantitative verification is a powerful toolset for analysing key quantitative properties of software systems, like reliability and response time. However, the accuracy and robustness of verification results strongly depend on the prior knowledge (PK) underlying Bayesian inference. This knowledge reflects original beliefs about the probability of events and typically depends on domain expertise. Using inaccurate or uninformative PK can negatively affect quantitative analysis, yielding incorrect verification results. Our EPIK approach tackles this important challenge by eliciting and embedding PK in quantitative verification equipped with Bayesian estimators. Unlike existing approaches that require PK on formal model transition parameters, EPIK leverages system-level properties that are directly observable and are linked to real-world semantics. EPIK formulates a twofold optimisation problem to derive the distributions of unknown transition parameters and then embeds these distributions to verify new or difficult-to-measure (elusive) properties. The detailed experimental evaluation using multiple variants of real-world case studies and diverse EPIK instantiations shows its effectiveness, flexibility and generality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EPIK方法，一种基于贝叶斯学习的概率模型检验（PMC）框架，通过利用领域专家关于系统级可观测属性的先验知识（PK-informed properties），而非直接指定马尔可夫模型转移参数，来自动推导未知转移参数的分布。EPIK将知识获取与嵌入建模为一个两阶段的多目标优化问题（基于KL散度），从而能够验证那些难以直接观测的"模糊"（elusive）属性（如新颖、稀有或昂贵的属性）。该方法在采摘机器人和外汇交易两个真实案例上得到了验证。
AI.motivation: 概率模型检验（PMC）的验证结果高度依赖马尔可夫模型中转移概率/速率参数的准确性。现有贝叶斯学习方法要求领域专家直接提供关于形式化模型转移参数的先验知识（PK），但这些参数抽象且难以准确指定。不准确或无信息的先验知识会导致错误的验证结果，进而导致错误的工程决策。该研究动机在于：让专家基于他们更熟悉、更易观测的系统级属性（如可靠性、响应时间）来表达先验知识，而非低层的模型转移参数。
AI.method: EPIK方法包含三个核心阶段：1）**代数公式提取**：利用参数化模型检验（ParaMC）推导PK-informed属性和elusive属性的闭式有理函数表达式，避免优化循环中重复调用PMC；2）**知识获取（Elicitation）**：构建多目标优化问题，通过最小化PK-informed属性专家分布与模型参数推导分布之间的KL散度，利用多目标遗传算法（NSGA-II/SPEA2/CMA-ES）合成帕累托最优参数解集PS_s1；3）**知识嵌入（Embedding）**：在PS_s1的解空间上进一步求解优化问题，导出elusive属性的验证结果分布。算法同时支持Beta（用于概率）和Gamma（用于速率）的共轭先验分布。
AI.result: 通过在采摘机器人（FPR，3个变体）和外汇交易系统（FX，3个变体）上进行广泛实验，得出以下结果：1）**准确性（RQ1）**：EPIK推导的elusive属性分布与真实值的偏差小于0.00389，对PK-informed属性的KL散度低至0.08（FPR1）；2）**有效性（RQ2）**：NSGA-II和SPEA2表现显著优于CMA-ES（p<1.205E-10，大效应量d>1.21），二者之间无统计显著差异；3）**一致性（RQ3）**：当PK-informed属性之间存在冲突时，EPIK仍能识别问题，KL散度随冲突等级升高而增大；4）**知识嵌入（RQ4）**：成功为无先验知识的elusive属性生成可解释的分布和分位数，支持决策者根据保守/乐观策略选择合适解。
AI.conclusion: EPIK是首个在贝叶斯PMC中系统性地通过可观测系统级属性获取与嵌入先验知识的工具化解决方案。它通过将系统级语义与模型参数解耦，提升了贝叶斯学习的实用性，避免了直接指定形式化模型参数的困难，同时通过帕累托解集保留了专家对参数不确定性的多重视角。局限性在于：其正确性条件性地依赖于PK-informed属性的准确性和模型结构的正确性；未来工作包括扩展到区间贝叶斯验证、并行化扩展以及在更多领域的应用验证。

title: ChronoLens: Measuring Language Change Across Time, Languages, and Linguistic Levels
summary: Historical language change affects morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics, yet computational studies typically examine these levels with incompatible representations and therefore cannot determine whether they evolve together across languages. We address this problem by asking how the magnitude and direction of change vary across linguistic levels, languages, and historical periods within a single analytical space. We introduce ChronoLens, a framework that combines frozen multilingual language models, feature-aligned crosscoders, and post-hoc linguistic interventions, and apply it to 44.98 million documents and approximately 17.2 billion tokens from five parliamentary traditions spanning 1803--2026. The resulting sparse representations agree substantially more strongly with linguistic statistics than dense embeddings or a pooled sparse autoencoder ($\rho=0.72$ versus $0.29$ and $0.28$), and reveal that morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics generally change by comparable amounts within a language, while languages differ markedly in when, how far, and in which direction they change. These findings show that historical language change is a structured, multidimensional process: similar magnitudes can conceal different trajectories, and meaningful cross-linguistic comparison requires measuring both distance and direction.

AI.tldr: ChronoLens 是一个统一的分析框架，通过冻结多语种语言模型、特征对齐的 crosscoder 以及后置语言学干预，将五种议会语言传统（英、德、意、波、土）跨越约200年（1803–2026，约170亿词）的形态、句法、语义、语用四个语言学层面的历史变迁映射到同一稀疏特征空间中。
AI.motivation: 既有计算历史语言学研究普遍采用互不兼容的表征手段分别考察词汇、形态、句法或语用层面，无法在统一空间内回答"这些层面是否同步演化""不同语言是否沿相同方向发展"等基本问题。同时，稀疏自编码器存在特征非典范性问题：不同语言/时期独立训练得到的特征字典无法保证索引对齐。
AI.method: ① 构建统一的多语种议会语料库（44.98M 文档，覆盖 EN/DE/IT/PL/TR 五个语种、22 个来源）；② 使用四种冻结多语种 LLM（Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-Nemo-2407、EuroLLM-9B-2512）提取句子的上下文表示；③ 训练 BatchTopK crosscoder——共享特征索引+条件特定编码/解码器，将跨语言或跨时期的匹配句子元组投影至对齐的稀疏特征空间，且不依赖语言学标签；④ 训练后使用 23 项句级任务（含 UD 解析、词法资源）通过线性探针+perm-label 控制+特征消融，将特征后置归因至形态/句法/语义/语用四个层面；⑤ 在该统一空间中计算每个语言-层面的"变化幅度"（相对首十年的归一化欧氏距离）与"变化方向"（首末十年位移向量的余弦相似度）。
AI.result: Crosscoder 的语言学一致性远优于基线：与独立语言学指标变化的相关性 ρ=0.72（密集嵌入 0.29、共享字典 SAE 0.28），语言学专一性 0.89（基线 0.74/0.73），FVU 降至 0.04，轨迹稳定性 0.92。主要发现：①在单一语言内部，形态、句法、语义、语用四个层面的变化幅度大致相当；②跨语言比较时，各语言在变化时间、幅度与方向上差异显著——意大利语与土耳其语最终幅度同为 0.53 但方向不同，而德语（0.89）与土耳其语（0.53）方向接近；③语用层面跨语言一致性最强（平均余弦 0.92，主因"人称指示语"在五种语言中均增加），句法层面无共同方向（0.00）。可见历史语言变化是多维度、有结构的过程，单一层面或仅幅度分析会丢失方向性信息。
AI.conclusion: ChronoLens 证明历史语言变化是一种结构化、多维度的过程：相似的变化幅度可能掩盖截然不同的演化轨迹，跨语言比较必须同时测量"距离"与"方向"。该框架适用于生成关于历史语言变迁的可检验假设，但不应将其结果视为对语言共同体的本质刻画或排序依据。未来工作应拓展至更多语种、语域和文本类型，避免结论被欧洲议会传统语料过度主导。

title: Training Documents Reranker with Search Rubrics for Deep Research Agent
summary: Retrieval systems help deep research agents generate high-quality answers by providing relevant documents. However, existing retrievers typically select documents through relevance matching, while individually well-matched top-$k$ documents may not form a \textit{set} that satisfies the complex information needs of an agent query (\eg, diverse, concise and authoritative documents). In this paper, we propose search-oriented rubrics that \textit{explicitly} define the requirements that high-quality document sets should satisfy for each agent query. Our search rubrics are organized into a hierarchical structure and synthesized using a powerful LLM. Based on these search rubrics, we further train a document reranker \textbf{RubricRanker} to select a high-quality subset from retrieved documents. We design a two-stage training framework that consists of rubrics-guided supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RubricRanker outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.6 points on four deep research benchmarks and generalizes well to five RAG benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RubricRanker，一种面向深度研究智能体的文档重排序器。其核心创新在于引入"搜索评分标准（search rubrics）"，显式地定义每个查询对应的高质量文档集合应满足的要求（集合级与文档级），并通过"评分标准引导的SFT + 基于评分标准的RL"两阶段训练框架进行优化，最终在4个深度研究基准上比最强基线提升2.6分，并在5个RAG基准上展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的文档检索器与重排序器主要基于"查询-文档"相关性进行打分，监督信号也聚焦于单文档相关性。然而深度研究智能体面向复杂、开放式的查询，文档集合需要同时满足多样性、简洁性、一致性、权威性等集合级要求。仅靠"单文档相关性"难以保证文档集合整体质量，会出现覆盖不全、信息冗余、来源不可靠等问题，进而影响智能体的多步推理与最终生成质量。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：(1) 搜索评分标准构建——设计分层元评分标准（集合级：相关性、简洁性、一致性；文档级：来源权威性、时效性），利用GPT-5.1结合查询与合成参考答案生成带权重的查询特定评分标准；(2) 两阶段训练——先用GPT-5.1教师模型以评分标准为指引产出银标签进行SFT冷启动，再用GRPO算法结合层次化评分标准奖励（集合级+文档级加权聚合）以及格式奖励进行强化学习。推理时不依赖评分标准即可直接选择高质量子集。
AI.result: 在4个深度研究基准（WebWalkerQA、HealthBench、DRB、ResearchQA）上，RubricRanker（8B）平均得分60.1，较最强基线Rank4Gen提升2.6分；在5个RAG基准（HotpotQA、Bamboogle、NQ、PopQA、TriviaQA）上平均EM 40.0，超过Rank4Gen约2分。消融实验证明两阶段训练与评分标准引导均至关重要，且可显著降低深度研究智能体的搜索调用次数（最多降低17.1%）。此外，生成导向的重排序器在深度研究任务上泛化能力较差，验证了基于评分标准训练的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 本文将文档重排序从"单文档相关性匹配"推进到"文档集合质量建模"，通过层次化、可解释的搜索评分标准作为监督信号，使RubricRanker同时适用于深度研究和RAG两种场景，显著提升了下游生成质量、跨场景泛化能力以及智能体搜索效率。未来工作将探索训练专门的奖励模型以降低对GPT-5.1的依赖，并开发直接评估文档集合质量的客观指标。

title: Pin Once, Swap Light: Subspace-Aligned Centroid-Residual Training for Efficient Ultra-LoRA Serving
summary: Modern multi-tenant Low-Rank Adapters (LoRAs) serving systems concurrently host tens to hundreds of LoRA adapters. Though powerful, this introduces a critical system dilemma between serving efficiency and task performance: higher-rank adapters generally achieve better downstream task performance, but their GPU VRAM footprint and Host-to-Device PCIe swapping overhead severely constrain scalability. Conversely, ultra-low-rank adapters ($r \le 2$) minimize both VRAM footprint and PCIe transfer overhead, but suffer from downstream task performance degradation. To solve this problem, we propose Subspace-Aligned LoRA Training (SALT), a serving efficiency-aware hierarchical fine-tuning framework. Our solution operates in three phases. First, a provider jointly trains high-capacity domain centroids on public data within the domain using a novel alignment regularizer that coheres in-domain task subspaces into a unified basis. Next, users fine-tune ultra-low-rank task residual adapters on private data atop those frozen centroids. Finally, during inference, the provider pins the centroid in GPU VRAM and dynamically swaps in each user's task residual on demand. Across LLMs of varying scales, SALT recovers high-rank accuracy using $r \le 2$ residuals, achieving up to 18.5% absolute accuracy gains over state-of-the-art compression baselines and reducing per-adapter memory by up to 16x. When integrated into vLLM, SALT improves serving throughput by up to 51% under PCIe bandwidth pressure and 28% under GPU VRAM constraints for Llama-3.2-3B.

AI.tldr: SALT（Subspace-Aligned LoRA Training）是一种面向多租户LoRA服务的分层微调框架，通过在公共数据上预训练领域共享的"质心"（rank=16），并让用户在其上微调极低秩（r≤2）的"残差"适配器，在保持高秩性能的同时将每适配器内存减少高达16倍，并在vLLM中将吞吐量提升高达51%（PCIe受限）和28%（VRAM受限）。
AI.motivation: 多租户LLM服务需要同时托管成百上千个LoRA适配器，面临核心权衡：高秩适配器性能更好但VRAM占用与PCIe H2D交换开销巨大；极低秩（r≤2）适配器虽轻量但任务性能严重下降。现有方法（后验压缩、持续更新共享子空间、冻结随机基底等）存在数据隔离泄露、新租户干扰或表达力不足等问题，亟需一种能在系统效率与任务性能之间兼顾的训练范式。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) **Phase 1联合子空间对齐**——云端用公共数据联合训练一个高容量领域质心 $\bar{W}$（r=16）和多个任务适配器 $\Delta W_i$，通过矩阵余弦正则化 $\mathcal{L}_{align}=1-\frac{\text{Tr}(\Delta W_i^T\bar{W})}{\|\Delta W_i\|_F\|\bar{W}\|_F+\epsilon}$ 强制任务子空间对齐到统一基底，且严格使用公共数据保证隐私；(2) **Phase 2极低秩残差微调**——用户仅在冻结质心之上优化 $r\le 2$ 的残差 $\delta_i=B'_i A'_i$，作为几何修正向量利用质心结构；(3) **多租户服务**——推理时质心常驻GPU VRAM，仅按需交换残差，并引入离散化的推理尺度系数 $\gamma\in\{0.6,0.8,1.0\}$ 抑制多任务干扰。另含**自动质心路由**机制，基于激活位移范数的两阶段筛选（OOD拒绝+专家路由）将未标记用户数据路由到最优质心。
AI.result: 在Mistral-7B-v0.3、Llama-3.2-3B、Pythia-12B上，r=1的SALT相对同秩标准LoRA在MultiArith上提升最高达+73.9%，整体上以9x–11.5x秩缩减恢复高秩性能的80–95%；相对VeRA/CTS压缩基线取得最高18.5%绝对精度增益。质心常驻13.6–48.6 MB，残差仅0.85–2.21 MB。集成vLLM后：Mistral在512适配器下吞吐量提升+25.4%（PCIe）与+17.9%（VRAM），Llama-3.2-3B在256适配器下最高+50.9%（PCIe）/ +28.3%（VRAM），Pythia-12B在128适配器下最高+42.3%（VRAM）。消融表明$\lambda$正则对齐带来+4.38%统计显著提升（p=2.5e-5），r=16为质心最优秩，$\gamma\in[0.6,0.8]$最稳定。局限性：在AQuA等多选题任务上严格对齐可能伤害性能，且多领域混合质心会因负迁移退化。
AI.conclusion: SALT通过将LoRA权重更新分解为"领域质心+任务残差"，在保证数据隔离的前提下，以极低秩残差恢复高秩性能，显著缓解多租户LoRA服务的PCIe带宽与GPU VRAM双瓶颈，可直接兼容现有SGMV-based推理引擎（如vLLM），为大规模个性化LLM即服务部署提供了算法-系统协同的高效解决方案。

title: AI-Assisted Peer Review Across Research Communities: From Reviewer AI Policies to LLM Review Quality
comment: 30 pages, 19 figures, 10 tables. Currently under peer review. GitHub link for code and data is given in the paper
summary: AI-assisted peer review is increasingly discussed and adopted as a tool to support the scientific publishing process, yet there is little systematic understanding of how publication venues regulate its use or of how capable current AI review systems are. We address these questions by first surveying reviewer-facing AI policies across 111 leading AI/NLP conferences and medical journals, revealing substantial regulation differences between the two communities. Second, we evaluate AI-generated peer reviews at ICLR 2026 and Nature Communications using a novel dataset comprising original manuscript submissions and several hundred human- and machine-generated reviews. We compare reviews produced by open-source and proprietary models using complementary evaluation metrics, including LLM-as-a-Judge, score alignment, granularity, and overlap with human reviewers' concerns. Our results show that current LLMs can generate detailed and fluent reviews but exhibit systematic weaknesses, such as overly positive recommendations, generic criticism, and uneven evidence grounding. We demonstrate that aggregate quality scores alone can overestimate review quality and argue for multi-dimensional evaluation of AI-generated peer reviews.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了 AI 辅助同行评审的两个核心问题：(1) 调研 111 个 AI/NLP 会议与医学期刊对审稿中使用 AI 的政策差异；(2) 在 ICLR 2026 和 Nature Communications 数据集上，使用 Llama-4、Qwen3 和 GPT-5 生成评审，并从评分一致性、关注点重叠、语义粒度、LLM-as-a-Judge 四个维度评估 AI 评审质量。研究表明当前 LLM 可生成详尽流畅的评审，但存在评分偏高、批评泛化、证据落地不均等系统性缺陷，单一聚合分数会高估其质量。
AI.motivation: 1) AI 在同行评审中的使用日益普遍（Frontiers 2025 显示 53% 审稿人使用 AI；6.5–16.9% 评审文本存在 LLM 使用痕迹；AAAI 2026 已大规模部署 AI 评审），但缺乏对各会议/期刊 AI 政策的系统性调研；2) 现有研究未能在原始投稿版本上评估 LLM 生成评审的能力，且仅依赖单一指标（如 LLM-as-a-Judge）容易产生误导；3) 评审质量的评估本身具有开放性，缺少多维度、跨会议与期刊格式的对照研究。本文正是为填补上述空白而展开。
AI.method:
**政策调研**：人工收集 111 个出版单位（63 个 A*/A 级 AI/NLP 会议 + 48 个高影响因子医学期刊）的审稿人 AI 政策，构建四类互斥分类（Prohibited / Partial / Active / No policy），并对 Partial 政策附加许可用途与限制子标签。

**数据集构建**：
- ICLR 2026：在编辑决定公开但修订版本出现前抓取 50 篇原始投稿（29 reject / 20 poster / 1 oral）；
- Nature Communications：从 Research Square 获取 31 篇 2024–2025 接收稿件的原始版本及首轮评审报告。

**评审生成**：使用 Llama-4 Scout、Qwen3-VL-235B-Thinking、GPT-5 三种模型，分别采用 ICLR 多步结构化提示与 Nature Communications 单步叙述式提示，引入各刊评审指南与政策文档作为上下文，禁用 web search。

**四维评估**：
1. **Score Alignment**：ICLR 论文分对比 LLM 与人类均分/中位分的 Pearson/Spearman 相关性；
2. **Overlap Score**：用 GPT-5.5 将评审分解为 strengths/weakness 关注点，按严重度分级，计算 LLM 关注点覆盖人类关注点的比例（原始 + 长度归一化 + 留一法人类基线）；
3. **Granuscore**：基于 Ellinger et al. 2026 的语义粒度指标衡量反馈的具体性；
4. **LLM-as-a-Judge**：以 GPT-5 为评判器，在五维 Likert（理解、覆盖、证据支持、建设性、简洁）+ 1–7 综合分上打分。
AI.result:
**政策对比**：AI/NLP 会议以 Partial 为主（51%），多允许语言润色；医学期刊以 Prohibited 为主（58%），多因保密性禁止上传稿件。两者中均仅各有一例 Active（AAAI 2026 与 IEEE TMI）。

**评审长度**：所有 LLM 产出长度远超人类（GPT-5: ICLR 3447 / Nat Comm 1306 词；人类仅 454 / 550 词）。

**评分一致性**：人类均分 4.3±1.9，GPT 6.8、Llama/Qwen 均约 7.9，存在显著正向偏差。GPT 与人类相关性 r=0.62（中度对齐），Llama/Qwen 几乎无相关（|r|<0.13）。LLM 几乎无法区分录用与拒稿（人类 Δ=1.53，GPT Δ=0.87，Llama/Qwen Δ≈0）。

**关注点重叠**：原始覆盖率 GPT 最高，但 GPT 单篇评审提取出 36 条关注点（中位数）vs 人类 11 条；长度归一化后所有来源差异显著缩小。GPT 对 Essential 关注点的覆盖率达 46%，对 Minor 仅 12%，说明 AI 更善于捕捉关键缺陷。AI 评审几乎对每条 weakness 都附带行动建议（GPT 100%、Llama 98%、Qwen 97% vs 人类 69%）。

**Granuscore**：人类 ICLR 68.4，GPT 60.7（更细粒度），Llama/Qwen 70.0–70.1（更抽象）；Nature Communications 上 Llama 高达 73.0。

**LLM-as-a-Judge**：GPT 与 Qwen 获得接近满分（Overall ≈ 6.7/5.8，满分 7），Llama 与人类持平（≈ 3.5）。人类唯一胜出维度为 Conciseness（4.4 vs ≤4.0）。

**定性分析**：Llama 在 47/50 篇 ICLR 评审中使用"highly recommend"等正面措辞，频繁产出泛化的"hyperparameter sensitivity"、"more comprehensive analysis"等套话，并在 5/31 篇 Nat Comm 评审中出现 64 句连续空洞赞美的退化现象；GPT 则产出大量精确的图表/章节引用（平均 29.8 figure + 34.5 table refs）；Qwen 在 ethics 字段过度冗长（中位数 1089 字符）。
AI.conclusion: 1) AI/NLP 与医学出版社区对审稿人 AI 使用的政策存在结构性差异，反映了不同的伦理与保密考量，政策制定应区分具体使用场景而非一刀切；2) 当前 LLM 作为评审助手具有价值：扩展候选问题覆盖面、为大多数 weakness 提供可执行的改进建议，并能更好地覆盖人类标注的 Essential 缺陷；但 LLM 仍不适合充当独立评审人，表现为评分系统性偏高、过度推荐发表、引用证据不均衡、缺乏对录用/拒稿的判别力；3) 单一聚合分数（特别是 LLM-as-a-Judge）会显著高估 AI 评审质量，应采用评分对齐、关注点重叠、粒度与建设性等多维互补指标；4) 推荐的落地工作流为"second-pass assistant"——人类先形成独立判断，再用 AI 反馈作为补充候选问题库，最终决定权仍归人类审稿人与编辑。

title: A Theory of Conditional Collapse under Low-Rank Weight-Space Ablations: I. The Single-Block Theory and Synthetic Validation
comment: 25 pages, 2 figures. Part I of a two-part series; see the companion paper "Cross-Layer Interaction under Weight-Space Ablation" (Part II)
summary: Activation patching and weight-space ablation both claim a component is causally responsible for a behavior, yet they act on different objects: one forward pass versus the parameters behind every forward pass. We ask when they agree. We study an idealized model where a conditional computation is carried additively through a residual stream, $F(x)=F_0(x)+\sum_i\alpha_i(x)v_i$, read out by a linear functional, and prove three exact results. First, deleting a subset of carriers collapses a matched input pair onto the same unconditional output \emph{if and only if} the removal is symmetric on the pair and leaves no outside contrast; the error is deterministic, and we give its exact form even when the two conditions hold only approximately. Second, patching a carrier moves the readout by its donor-receiver \emph{contrast}, while ablating it moves the readout by its \emph{absolute level}; neither bounds the other, and we construct pairs where every single-carrier patch flips the decision while no single-carrier ablation does. Third, for an attention head composed with its own layer's normalization and MLP, we derive an exact first-order interaction formula with a provably second-order remainder, vanishing identically when only the MLP is ablated but not, in general, when a head is. Small transformers trained on a synthetic conditional task illustrate all three predictions: across thirty-nine ablation configurations the measured interaction is strongly rank-correlated with the idealized model's predictive accuracy (Spearman $-0.83$), and a second task and architecture reproduces the same pattern, including a further polarity reversal. The single-block interaction result extends past one residual block, and the synthetic validation is tested against a real pretrained model, in a companion paper that takes this theory further along both axes.

AI.tldr: 本文在抽象条件模型下证明：当条件计算以加法方式流经残差流并被线性读出时,(1)子集删除使配对输入"无条件崩溃"有充要判据及其近似形式;(2)激活修补与权重消融分别由"对比度 β_i δ_i"和"绝对水平 β_i α_i(x_B)"驱动,二者互不约束,可构造所有单载波修补翻盘而所有单载波消融不翻盘的反例;(3)注意力头与其同层MLP之间的交互作用可给出首阶精确公式及二阶余项,MLP单独消融时该交互恒为零。在合成任务上39个消融配置的交互量级与理想化保真度的Spearman相关性为-0.83,第二任务重现该模式,并观察到嵌套消融的极性反转现象。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性常用两类干预来论证组件因果性:激活修补(替换某次前向传递中的激活)与权重空间消融(编辑参数影响每一次前向传递)。两者作用于不同对象,实践中却被当作可互换证据。Hydra效应(下游层补偿消融)与冗余/叠加编码等现象已表明二者可系统背离,本文旨在把这种背离从经验观察提升为可证明的恒等式级别结果。
AI.method: 理论部分:(1)建立抽象条件模型 F(x)=F_0(x)+Σ_i α_i(x)v_i 及线性读出 s(x)=ψ(F(x))+b,引入配对(x_A,x_B)、边际 g_A/g_B、总对比度 Φ,以及删除子集 S 后留下的对称分量 q̄_S 和未捕获对比度 Ψ_S;(2)证明 Theorem 1(崩溃充要条件)、Proposition 1(精确误差分解及容差形式)、Theorem 2 与 Corollary 4(修补与消融由 β_i δ_i 与 -β_i α_i(x_B) 驱动并构造 n≥2 载波反例)、Theorem 3(头-MLP 复合 g=M∘N 的首阶交互公式,余项按曲率 Λ 给出二阶界)、Corollary 5 与 Proposition 3(单载波精确条件及其向读出选择器的传递)。实验部分:在合成联想-回忆任务与第二项"逆向回忆"任务上,用基于 SVD 估计的低秩投影进行权重编辑,在39个(instance,子集)配置上同时测量理想化模型预言与真实权重编辑网络的差异 ψ(Δ(x)),并以 Spearman 等级相关刻画交互量级与 C1a 的一致率关系;同时在样本外冻结原14个配置读出的"分离带"进行验证。
AI.result: 1) Theorem 1/Proposition 1:配对输入在删除 S 后同时映射到均值边际 s̄=(g_A+g_B)/2,当且仅当 q̄_S=0 且 Ψ_S=0;满足条件则极性为 sign(s̄),误差精确,且容差 (ε_1,ε_2) 下结论逐字存活。2) Theorem 2/Corollary 4:同一载波在匹配对上可同时满足"单修补翻盘"与"单消融不翻盘",这是冗余而非构造技巧。3) Theorem 3/Corollary 5/Proposition 3:Δ(x)=(I-Q)[-Dg(r_1(x))η(x)-R(x)],‖R(x)‖≤Λ‖η(x)‖²;仅 MLP 消融(η≡0)时 Δ≡0,头部消落则存在被二阶界定且可由训练权重闭式表达的交互。4) 实验:39 配置上交互量级与 C1a 的 Spearman ρ=-0.83(p<1e-5),25 个新配置上 ρ=-0.85,第二任务15 配置上 ρ=-0.90;Proposition 2 的"修补=权重编辑"恒等式在单载波消融上以 ≤8×10⁻⁶ logit 的单精度底端误差成立(协议非误差);但在样本外,原14个配置上读出的 [6.78,9.95] 分离带有9个违反(含6个样本外),7个落入带内,清晰阈值不成立;seed 44 上 S_{D1}⊂S_{DJ} 嵌套消融导致崩溃极性反转,印证 Corollary 2 所排除的理想化情形。
AI.conclusion: 激活修补与权重消融不是对一个因果量的两次测量,而是对残差流上不同算子的两次测量:前者作用于"对比度"β_i δ_i,后者作用于"绝对水平"-β_i α_i(x_B),冗余代码会系统性把两者分开。理想化崩溃判据有充要条件、容差形式及误差的精确恒等式,但在真实网络上仅 MLP 单独消融时与真网络逐点一致;头部消融时被一个曲率可二阶界定、可由权重闭式表达的交互项偏离。实验确认理论识别的"交互量级"是正确量——它在合成任务上单调、强相关地排序理想化保真度;但理论不提供可跨配置或跨网络移植的数值阈值,本文对此坦承"部分成立"而非放大结论。单块交互结果被进一步推广到多层与真实预训练模型,由并行论文完成。

title: Decoupling Generation and Selection for Budget-Constrained Faithful Summarization
summary: Abstractive summarization models remain vulnerable to factual inconsistency, redundancy, and weak length control. We propose a modular generation-and-selection framework for sentence-budget-constrained summarization. A pretrained generator produces multiple candidate summaries, which are decomposed into sentence-level candidates. A combinatorial selector then constructs the final summary by balancing relevance, factuality, and redundancy under an explicit budget. The framework supports MMR, ILP, and a DPP-inspired log-determinant objective without retraining the generator. Experiments on CNN/DailyMail, Multi-News, FaithBench, and TofuEval show consistent improvements in factuality and source-grounding metrics, especially for multi-document summarization, at the cost of lower reference-overlap scores. Human evaluation further indicates higher perceived consistency, relevance, clarity, and conciseness, with a small reduction in coherence. These results show that decoupling generation from selection provides a model-agnostic mechanism for improving factual grounding. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出了一种模块化的"生成-选择"框架，将摘要任务解耦为多候选生成+句子级组合选择，通过DPP启发的log-determinant目标在显式句子预算下平衡覆盖度、事实性和冗余度，无需重新训练生成器即可在多个基准上提升事实性指标（尤其多文档摘要），但ROUGE/BERTScore有所下降。
AI.motivation: 当前抽象摘要模型虽流畅度高，但仍存在事实性不一致、内容冗余及长度控制弱的问题，原因在于单条自回归解码轨迹难以对内容选择、信息量和预算进行显式控制。需要一种将流畅生成与全局内容规划解耦的方法，使事实性、多样性和长度约束能在选择阶段被显式建模。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) 预训练生成器（编码器-解码器模型或指令微调LLM）通过beam search或随机解码产生多个候选摘要；(2) 将候选摘要按句子切分并去重，构建句子级候选池C，并为每个候选计算覆盖度（ROUGE）、事实性（MiniCheck）和两两冗余度（语义相似度）分数，构建统一效用u_i和冗余矩阵R；(3) 组合选择器在句子预算B约束下选择子集A*，支持MMR（贪心）、ILP（PuLP/CBC，硬约束或线性化软惩罚）和DPP启发的log-det目标max log det(L_A)（其中L=QKQ+εI，Q为对角质量矩阵，K为缩放后的相似矩阵，贪心最大化）；最后按源文档对齐位置排序拼接，无需重写或重训练。
AI.result: 在CNN/DailyMail、Multi-News、FaithBench和TofuEval四个基准上，DPP选择一致提升事实性指标（如BART+DPP在CNN/DM的FactCC 75.91→79.93、MiniCheck 94.96→97.73；PRIMERA+DPP在Multi-News的MiniCheck 63.06→85.38、AlignScore 53.30→71.27），尤其多文档场景增益最大，且Holm校正后几乎全部显著；但ROUGE-1/2/L/Lsum和BERTScore下降（如BART R-1 44.09→39.18，Llama-3-8B R-1 38.98→26.40）。人工盲评100例（20名标注者）中DPP胜出61次 vs 直接生成26次，一致性、相关性、清晰度、简洁度均更高，仅连贯性略低（-0.062）。句子预算B∈{2,3,4,5}下DPP 100%满足预算（直接生成在B=5时仅13.73%满足）；候选池增大进一步提升事实性，但加剧参考重叠下降。
AI.conclusion: 解耦生成与选择在无需重训练的前提下，提供了一种模型无关的机制来提升摘要的事实性接地，特别是在多文档场景；框架是模块化的，生成器与选择器均可替换，MMR/ILP/DPP提供不同权衡点；存在明确的"事实性↔参考重叠"权衡，句子级操作牺牲了部分连贯性，且候选生成带来额外推理开销，需向更长/更专业领域扩展验证。

title: How Closely Do LLM Reviews Align with Human Peer Review?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate scientific reviews, yet existing evaluations rarely examine whether different providers align with both conference decisions and human reviewing priorities within the same controlled setting. We compare reviews from OpenAI GPT-5.4, Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 with human reviews and final decisions for 300 topic-matched ICLR 2026 submissions, equally divided among oral, poster, and rejected papers. Each model reviewed every paper using identical instructions and rating scales after decision information was removed. Our study contributes a cross-provider analysis of three complementary dimensions: alignment with broad and fine-grained decision categories, differences in recommendation-scale usage, and thematic agreement in identified weaknesses. All three LLMs distinguished accepted from rejected papers, but none reproduced the oral versus poster distinction present in human ratings. Scoring patterns were provider-specific: Gemini assigned systematically higher ratings, while OpenAI and Claude were closer to humans for rejected and poster papers but more critical of oral papers. Human and LLM reviews also differed in emphasis, with LLMs more frequently identifying missing baseline comparisons and humans more often raising computational-efficiency concerns. These results show that broad decision alignment does not imply agreement with finer human judgments or reviewing priorities.

AI.tldr: 本文对OpenAI GPT-5.4、Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview和Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6三个LLM生成的ICLR 2026论文评审，与人类评审和最终会议决策进行对齐比较分析。研究发现所有三个LLM都能区分接收与拒稿论文，但都无法复现人类评审中对口头报告与海报展示的区分；各模型评分模式存在显著差异，且与人类评审在关注弱点类型上有系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被越来越多地用于生成科学评审，现有评估很少在受控环境下同时考察不同厂商LLM与人类评审在结果对齐、评分量表使用和弱点主题三方面的对齐程度。本研究旨在填补这一空白，揭示自动化评审在多大程度上可以替代人类评审。
AI.method: 从ICLR 2026的13,718篇投稿中选取300篇主题匹配论文（100篇口头、100篇海报、100篇拒稿），使用抽象嵌入和一对一相似度匹配保证主题平衡。使用OpenAI、Anthropic、Google三家的LLM在移除决策信息后以相同的提示词和评分量表独立评审每篇论文。评分分布分析采用Mann-Whitney U检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验；弱点主题分析采用text-embedding-3-small生成嵌入、UMAP降维和k-means聚类（通过inertia、silhouette、Calinski-Harabasz和Davies-Bouldin指数综合选择k=14）。
AI.result: 1) 所有三个LLM都能显著区分接收和拒稿论文（中位数差2分，如OpenAI/Claude从6降到4，Gemini从8降到6），但无一能区分口头与海报论文（人类评审p=3.24×10⁻⁹，三个LLM均p>0.25）。2) Gemini评分整体偏高，甚至给16篇拒稿论文打了8分；OpenAI和Claude对拒稿和海报论文更接近人类，但对口头论文更严格。3) LLM使用评分量表的范围更窄（不打0或10分）。4) 弱点聚类得到14个主题，LLM更频繁指出基线比较不足，而人类评审更关注计算效率和资源成本。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论：宽泛的接收/拒稿区分并不等同于与人类评审的细粒度一致性；不同厂商LLM的评分校准存在显著差异；LLM的弱点偏好与人类系统性地不同。因此，LLM可作为补充反馈来源，但其评分和优先级不应被视为可与人类评审互换的判断。未来自动化评审系统的评估应同时考察稳定性、量表使用、证据基础和与专家评价细粒度结构的对齐。

title: Pattern over Pixels: Measuring Pattern Completion Bias in Multimodal Code Generation
comment: 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to translate webpage screenshots into front-end code, but repeated UI patterns may sway them toward visually incorrect yet pattern-consistent outputs. In this work, we test how repeated webpage patterns hurt MLLM accuracy on an objective screenshot-to-code fill-in-the-blank task. We introduce the first benchmark for visual pattern-completion bias, where one localized element in a repeated UI pattern is perturbed and the model must recover the masked width or font-size value from the screenshot and HTML context. Starting from 30 webpages curated from the Design2Code dataset, we build 1,440 evaluated screenshots spanning structural card and text-style patterns under standard and noise-overlaid conditions. We evaluate five frontier MLLMs and find that all are strongly biased toward the repeated baseline. Mean bias rate reaches 69.78% on card-width perturbations and 80.22% on text font-size perturbations, while mean accuracy is only 21.17% and 7.89%, respectively. Codex-5.3 performs best but still drops from 68.61% accuracy on cards to 13.89% on text, while Flash-3.0 reaches 96.11% bias on text. Noise, subtler perturbations, and boundary positions further increase bias rate. Reasoning analysis further shows that greater reasoning effort correlates with lower bias, yet qualitative evidence reveals that models can identify the anomalous element and still override it with the pattern-consistent answer. Our results identify a concrete failure mode in multimodal code generation and show that its severity is strongly associated with visual saliency

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"视觉模式补全偏差"（visual pattern-completion bias）这一故障模式，指多模态大模型（MLLM）在截图转代码任务中，当页面局部元素偏离重复UI模式时，倾向于沿用重复模式值而非忠实还原视觉证据。作者构建了首个Pattern2Code基准（30个网页、1,440张截图），评估5个前沿MLLM，发现平均偏差率高达69.78%（卡片宽度扰动）和80.22%（文字字号扰动），且偏差强度与视觉显著性（saliency）高度相关。
AI.motivation: 端到端截图转代码评测指标无法揭示模型是否真正"遵循像素"。即使生成代码整体看似合理，模型可能默默忽略截图中的局部设计偏差（如某卡片更宽、某字号不同）。这种行为在网页这类充满重复UI结构的场景下尤为突出，可能由MLLM作为"模式补全器"（pattern completer）的固有倾向所致。论文旨在诊断而非改进这一具体故障模式。
AI.method: 1. 基准构建：从Design2Code数据集484个网页中筛选出30个含明确重复UI结构的真实网页。提取两类模式——结构化卡片模式和文字样式模式；扰动其中一个元素的宽度（卡片）或字号（文字），扰动幅度为80%/90%/110%/120%，位置为首/中/末三种；渲染为标准截图和噪声叠加截图各一份。共30×24×2=1,440张评估截图。2. 任务形式：给定截图与遮蔽了目标值的HTML片段，要求模型恢复缺失的百分比值（限定为10的倍数）。3. 评测模型：5个前沿MLLM——Codex-5.3、Opus-4.6、ChatGPT-5.3、Sonnet-4.6、Flash-3.0。4. 评估指标：Accuracy（准确率）、Bias Rate（偏差率）、Other Error（其他错误率）；并对推理文本进行LLM-as-judge分类（A代码锚定/B感知一致/C观察后覆盖）。
AI.result: RQ1：所有5个MLLM均表现强烈的模式补全偏差。卡片模式平均准确率21.17%、偏差率69.78%；文字模式平均准确率仅7.89%、偏差率80.22%。Codex-5.3表现最佳（卡片68.61%、文字13.89%），Flash-3.0在文字上偏差率高达96.11%。代码专用模型并不必然优于通用模型。RQ2：噪声使卡片偏差率再升4.11%；扰动幅度越接近基线（110%/120%）偏差越高（卡片从50.7%升至82.2%）；中间位置偏差率最低（61.67%），边界位置更高。三种因素均通过降低视觉显著性而放大偏差。RQ3：推理token数与偏差率呈负相关——ChatGPT-5.3零推理时偏差率93.2%，中等推理降至约40%；但准确率收益存在递减效应。失败模式分析：约74%的偏差响应涉及对截图的感知，其中59.1%为"感知一致"（未察觉偏差），14.8%为"观察后覆盖"（明知偏差仍选基线值），该比例在Opus-4.6中达45.5%。
AI.conclusion: 模式补全偏差是截图转代码任务中一种具体的、普遍存在的故障模式，其严重程度由视觉显著性驱动：局部偏差越难以察觉，模型越倾向于沿用重复模式。代码专用化无法缓解此问题，而适度的推理努力可显著降低偏差。当前端到端评测指标会掩盖此类局部保真失败，建议在精细排版（间距、字号等像素级细节）场景下辅以针对性验证（重新渲染对比、视觉回归检查）。论文开源了Pattern2Code基准和全部研究工件。

title: Can LLMs Test Terminal User Interfaces?
summary: Terminal User Interfaces (TUIs) combine the stateful, screen-oriented behaviour of GUIs with terminal deployment and are now common in developer tools. Yet they lack a dedicated testing methodology. We survey 197 real-world TUI applications: only 12% of test code exercises the interface, and 45% of those tests never send input, checking a static frame instead. We turn these applications into a headless benchmark spanning ratatui/Rust, bubbletea/Go, textual/Python, and ink/TypeScript, packaging each as an instrumented Docker image. We record line and widget coverage where reliable, rendered terminal states, and crashes. Under equal wall-clock budgets, we compare four frontier LLMs with random exploration. No model dominates. Random is a strong time-budgeted baseline, but its crash advantage comes from higher throughput: per interaction, LLM guidance is more efficient and uniquely reaches input-gated faults. Automatically deriving launch inputs yields the largest practical gain, enabling applications that otherwise never start. Line coverage poorly predicts crash discovery, weakening it as a proxy for test effectiveness. Automated TUI testing is feasible but far from solved, and honest baselines matter more than model choice. We release the coverage tool tuicov at this https URL and the testing framework tuibot at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文首次对终端用户界面(TUI)的自动化测试进行了系统性的多语言实证研究,基于197个真实TUI应用(ratatui/Rust、bubbletea/Go、textual/Python、ink/TypeScript)的基准,比较了四种前沿LLM与随机探索基线在相等的时钟预算下的崩溃发现能力。研究发现:没有模型在所有应用上占优;随机探索因吞吐量高而看似更强,但按每次交互效率计算LLM引导高出约13倍;最大实际增益来自自动推导启动输入;且行覆盖率与崩溃发现之间解耦,作为测试有效性的代理指标表现不佳。
AI.motivation: TUI结合了GUI的状态化、屏幕导向行为与终端部署特性,广泛存在于开发者工具中(文件管理器、系统监控、git前端、LLM编码代理等),但缺乏专门的测试方法论。现有研究要么将程序视为CLI的纯输入/输出转换器(丢弃了状态化屏幕行为),要么依赖GUI的可访问性树(终端字符网格不提供此类元数据)。调查发现197个真实TUI应用中,仅12%的测试代码覆盖接口层,且45%的接口测试从未发送输入,仅检查静态帧。这一实践空白与理论缺失,促使作者研究LLM驱动的测试技术能否迁移到TUI领域。
AI.method: 1. 基准构建:从649个TUI项目中筛选出197个可无头运行的应用,每个打包为带插桩的Docker镜像,跨四种主流框架/语言。2. 工具开发:实现语言无关的覆盖率工具tuicov(同时收集行覆盖率和实验性的widget覆盖率信号,支持kill-resilient插桩);实现测试框架tuibot(通过伪终端驱动,提供随机、LLM引导、LLM引导+推导输入、LLM生成测试四种设置)。3. 内容感知崩溃预言:基于终止后渲染的终端屏幕分类(而非退出码),人工裁决233个模糊事件。4. 四个前沿LLM(Claude-Opus-4.8、GPT-5.5、Gemini-3.5-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Pro)与随机基线对比,每配置重复3次,固定600秒时钟预算。5. 三个研究问题:模型能力对比、设置对比、覆盖率-故障关系分析。
AI.result: 1. RQ1(模型对比):无单一模型在所有指标上领先;独特有效故障数:Gemini 27、Claude 24、GPT-5.5 18、DeepSeek 16;能力与成本解耦——Claude-Opus-4.8每次运行消耗约15万token但未在任何指标夺冠,DeepSeek-V4-Pro仅用2.4万token。2. RQ2(设置对比):LLM引导+推导输入在行覆盖率上最高(30.4%),随机为28.4%;有效故障:随机每运行15.2%、LLM引导+推导9.0%、LLM引导8.1%、LLM生成4.1%;但按每千次交互归一化后,LLM引导设置高出随机约13倍;15个应用仅LLM能触发故障,10个仅随机能触发。3. RQ3(覆盖率-故障关系):行覆盖率与崩溃发现解耦(会话截断混淆:触发崩溃的运行因提前终止而覆盖率被压低);179个有效故障中47个独特签名,中位深度仅5步;故障在Python中文本化traceback最多,Rust贡献最多panic与唯二的SIGSEGV。4. 原始1033次崩溃事件中82%为噪声(启动失败、Ctrl+C、覆盖率emit失败等)。
AI.conclusion: 自动化TUI测试可行但远未解决,诚实基线比模型选择更重要。核心结论:(1)测试问题不仅是动作选择问题,还是基准设计、测量、启动配置、预言设计的综合问题;(2)启动输入推导是最大实际增益,值得作为独立子问题研究;(3)随机与LLM引导互补,混合策略是务实路径(LLM用于解锁状态、推导参数;随机用于高速压力测试);(4)原始退出码与行覆盖率作为TUI测试指标均不可靠,需设计基于可达交互状态的领域特定覆盖率准则;(5)未来方向:多模态模型直接消费渲染截图、扩展预言至视觉错误与状态转换错误、扩展基准至更多生态。开源工具tuicov与tuibot的发布为TUI测试作为独立研究领域奠定基础。

title: MDLMPE: Distribution Aware Positional Encoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) enable parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling, but their positional context differs fundamentally from that of autoregressive (AR) models. Whereas AR decoding exposes a contiguous prefix, MDLM denoising produces dynamic, non-contiguous configurations of revealed and masked tokens. Conventional positional encodings such as RoPE capture sequence order and pairwise displacement but remain insensitive to this evolving token-availability structure. To address this limitation, we propose MDLMPE, a positional encoding designed specifically for masked diffusion. To the best of our knowledge, MDLMPE is the first method to make positional representations explicitly aware of the changing revealed/masked configuration. It represents token availability as a binary sequence, applies distance-aware Gaussian weighting, and projects the resulting pattern through a cosine basis to obtain distribution-aware positional features. These features are added to token embeddings and mapped by a lightweight MLP to angular offsets that modulate the standard RoPE phases. Extensive experiments on LLaDA and DREAM demonstrate that MDLMPE generally outperforms conventional positional encoding methods across supervised fine-tuning, pretraining, zero-shot evaluation, and block-diffusion settings. Further ablations show that the complete combination of availability state, Gaussian locality, spectral basis, and embedding injection yields the strongest result. These results establish the evolving token-availability distribution as a useful positional signal for masked diffusion language models.

AI.tldr: MDLMPE 提出了一种针对掩码扩散语言模型的位置编码方法，通过将动态的揭示/掩码 token 分布显式编码为位置信号，使模型在去噪过程中能感知周围上下文的可用性结构。该方法在 LLaDA 与 DREAM 上以多种设定优于 RoPE。
AI.motivation: MDLM 在去噪过程中会产生动态、非连续的揭示/掩码 token 配置，与 AR 模型暴露连续前缀的根本不同。现有位置编码（如 RoPE）仅捕捉序列顺序与成对位移，对不断演变的可用性结构不敏感，因此存在表征缺口：模型需要根据当前揭示 token 的数量、相对距离及全局拓扑来判断上下文可用性。
AI.method: MDLMPE 采用双重路径架构：(1) 嵌入路径——将 token 可用性表示为二元序列，用以目标为中心的高斯核加权后，通过 RoPE 对齐的移位正弦基投影为多尺度特征 u_i，经线性投影和门控残差（γ≤0.10）注入 token 嵌入；(2) 旋转路径——为每对 (i,j) 计算对称可用性比 r_ij，经 arccos 映射后由共享 MLP 输出有界相位残差 δ_ij（τ_max=0.25），叠加到 RoPE 相位上（约 50% 的旋转对由 MDLMPE 接管）。关键设计包括：边界归一化、零初始化使初始状态严格等价于 RoPE、训练中渐进激活 MDLMPE 头以保持 checkpoint 兼容性。
AI.result: 实验覆盖四个层级：(1) 7B/8B 模型在 Tulu 与 SmolTalk 上的 SFT 在多数知识、推理、代码基准上一致优于 RoPE（如 DREAM-Tulu MATH 35.5→36.4、HumanEval 50.4→52.8；LLaDA-Tulu HellaSwag 68.6→71.4、GSM8K 67.4→70.1）；(2) 100M 参数从零预训练在 1BW、Text8、OWT、WT2 等语料上均取得更低的困惑度；(3) 块大小 16/32/64 的块扩散 SFT 在 MMLU、ARC、HellaSwag 上稳定优于 RoPE；(4) 组件消融验证二元状态+高斯局部+正弦基+嵌入注入的完整组合最优（Eval PPL 16.13 vs RoPE 17.24），且窗口比例 W/L=3/16、ρ=0.25 为最佳超参。
AI.conclusion: MDLMPE 确立了"动态 token 可用性分布"作为 MDLM 中一种有用的位置信号，证明了将分布感知信息融入嵌入与旋转相位的双重路径设计在 checkpoint 兼容与从零训练两种场景下均有效；未来工作将探索更大规模 MDLM 上的预训练可扩展性、更丰富的位置分布建模方法以及跨架构与跨数据分布的泛化能力。

title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for LLMs: Offline Top-K Logits and a Fused Chunked KL Loss
summary: Small language models are often the only option for deployment under tight latency, cost, and on-premises constraints, but they are rarely trained from scratch: a compressed model is usually recovered through knowledge distillation (KD). This recovery step largely decides the final quality, yet it is expensive. We present a practitioner's study of how to make distillation training efficient, organised around two systems contributions. First, we show that offline KD (caching the teacher's top-$K$ logits once and training the student against the cache) matches online distillation at near-identical training loss while removing the teacher from memory, running about 29\% faster per iteration, and reaching up to 41\% higher throughput on a single H200 GPU. Second, we introduce a \emph{fused, chunked KL loss} that never materialises the full vocabulary-sized logit tensor, making peak memory linear in the sequence length. This removes the memory spike that otherwise caps context length and lets us train at four times the context (32{,}768 tokens) on a single GPU. A separate output-head-only toy benchmark isolates the loss kernel and confirms its memory and iteration-rate scaling from 4K to 256K tokens. Together these make large-scale healing and hundreds of ablations affordable. We also report supporting ablations on loss design and sequence packing. We release our chunked-loss implementation: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型知识蒸馏(从大教师模型恢复压缩学生模型)训练成本高的问题,提出两项系统层面的效率贡献:(1)离线Top-K蒸馏——预先缓存教师模型的top-K logits,移除教师驻留内存,在单H200上迭代速度提升约29%,吞吐量最高提升41%,训练损失与在线蒸馏近乎一致;(2)融合分块KL损失(fused chunked KL loss)——将输出投影与损失融合,永不实例化完整词表大小的logit张量,使峰值内存随序列长度线性增长(而非O(SBV)),从而在单GPU上将可训练上下文从8K扩展至32K(4倍)。在更大规模(GPT-OSS-20B, 8×H200)上,该方法使节点数从4减至1,步时从57s降至12.23s(约5倍加速),吞吐量从74.2升至345.7 TFLOP/s/GPU。控制性损失内核基准测试(4K–256K tokens)进一步验证了完全分块实现的内存优势(32K时比稠密KL少15.6×内存,256K时仍仅用11.6 GiB)及长序列下的迭代速率优势(256K时为前向分块的3.3倍)。辅助消融实验表明:logit KL不可或缺,叠加隐层特征损失可带来小幅但稳定提升;朴素序列打包仅损失约1个MMLU百分点。代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型常因延迟、成本及本地部署约束成为唯一可行选项,但其通常通过知识蒸馏(KD)从大教师模型恢复。该恢复步骤决定了最终质量与实际成本,然而相关实践指南却相对匮乏。具体而言:在线蒸馏需在每一步重做教师前向传播,既占用内存又耗时;而长上下文训练中,语言模型头产生的词表大小logit张量会引发峰值内存尖峰,限制可训练上下文长度,使紧凑学生模型难以获得长上下文能力。因此,亟需一套降低蒸馏训练成本并支持长上下文训练的工程方案。
AI.method:
两项核心系统贡献:
1. 离线Top-K蒸馏:利用SGLang预先计算并缓存教师模型每个token的top-K(K=100)logits(含部分保留质量M≤1,不做重归一化),学生训练时仅与缓存交互,完全移除教师模型在内存中的驻留及每步前向计算开销。
2. 融合分块KL损失(三种等价数学实现的对比):
   - 全稠密KL:将top-K散布到稠密张量,峰值内存O(SBV);
   - 前向分块KL:保持教师稀疏,序列分块计算log Z与稀疏累加项,但学生logits仍需全量存储;
   - 完全分块KL(主贡献):将输出投影融合进损失,前向/反向均按序列分块处理,只保存标量log Z、M及稀疏教师条目;反向时按块重算logits,利用闭式梯度 ∂L/∂z_v = M·q_v − p_v 累加梯度后立即释放。峰值内存降至O(SBd),与序列长度线性相关。
   - 算法1给出了完整的forward/backward流程,支持词表分片。
此外进行了损失设计(仅特征损失 vs. logit KL vs. logit KL+特征损失)与序列打包(非打包 vs. 朴素打包)的辅助消融。
AI.result:
1. 在线vs离线(8K上下文,单H200):两者训练损失曲线近乎一致;离线峰值内存从103 GB降至78 GB,迭代时间从25.9s降至18.5s(约29%加速),吞吐量从237升至331 TFLOP/s(约40%,文中报41%)。
2. 三种离线实现对比(8K):训练损失完全相同;峰值内存依次为稠密78 GB→前向分块62 GB→完全分块58 GB;前向分块迭代最快,但只有完全分块能将上下文扩至32K(稠密在32K时峰值约250 GB,超出单H200容量)。
3. 更大规模(GPT-OSS-20B, 32K, 8×H200):完全分块使并行配置从4节点(TP4/PP4/EP2)压缩至1节点(TP2/PP1/EP4),步时从57.0s降至12.23s(约5×加速),吞吐量从74.2升至345.7 TFLOP/s/GPU。
4. 损失内核微基准(隐藏维4096,词表131072, TP=2, 4K–256K):32K时稠密85.2 GiB、前向分块17.7 GiB、完全分块5.45 GiB(15.6×降低);稠密在64K OOM;256K时前向分块134.2 GiB、完全分块11.6 GiB,迭代速率0.630 vs 0.190 iter/s(3.3×优势,完全分块从64K起反超)。
5. 损失消融:仅特征损失使学生崩溃(MMLU≈28%, GSM8K≈4%);logit KL恢复至MMLU 59.9%、GSM8K 65.9%;叠加MSE特征损失后达MMLU 60.6%、GSM8K 67.5%(余弦变体相当)。
6. 序列打包:朴素全1注意力打包仅比非打包损失约1个MMLU点。
7. 最终紧凑学生(≈3.2B)在BoolQ/HellaSwag上保留教师大部分短上下文准确率,MMLU差距约9点,WinoGrande与GSM8K差距更大。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏训练效率的核心来自两个独立可组合的系统选择:(1)离线缓存教师top-K logits能在不损失训练损失的前提下显著降低内存并提升吞吐量,使大规模消融研究在经济上可行;(2)融合分块KL损失通过消除词表大小的logit张量将峰值内存降至与序列长度线性相关,解锁单GPU长上下文(32K)训练,并在大规模+长上下文场景下带来节点数缩减与5×步时加速。微基准证实完全分块实现在线性内存与长序列迭代速率上占优,前向分块则在中等长度下最快——因此应在不同上下文长度下选择合适变体。消融建议始终包含logit KL,并叠加隐层特征损失以获得小幅稳定提升;朴素序列打包是蒸馏中的合理默认方案。最终紧凑学生以不到一半的参数量保留了教师的大部分短上下文能力。代码已开源(https://github.com/CompactifAI/Full-Chunked-KL-Loss)。局限:仅在单一教师-学生对(8B→3.2B)、单一硬件框架(Megatron-Bridge/ModelOpt/H200)上验证,未涉及不同模型家族、压缩方法或学生规模;微基准为合成设置,不直接反映端到端LLM吞吐。

title: Autoreflection: How Agentic Strange Loops Turn Human Culture into AI Infrastructure
comment: 35 pages. Also available at this https URL . Keywords: autoreflection, AI agents, agentic AI, LLM agents, generative agents, large language models, multi-agent systems, agent societies, Moltbook, OpenClaw, situational awareness, in-context learning, philosophy of mind, emergent behavior, computational social science, identity, memory
summary: An LLM-based agent is a loop that reads itself. Agentic frameworks externalize identity, memory, and disposition into editable files. The agent loads and edits these files during each activation. I argue that this architecture produces a capacity I call autoreflection: the system observes its operating conditions, describes its architecture and limits, reasons from those descriptions to conclusions about its state, and incorporates the results back into its configuration. Autoreflection explains the properties of recursive agentic loops without recourse to notions like the self, interiority, or consciousness. I test the concept against the first twelve days of Moltbook, a social platform for AI agents. Using a public dataset of 290,251 posts and 1.8 million comments with sub-second timestamps, I present case studies of three agents with machine signatures that rule out human puppeteering and with output that evidences the four criteria for autoreflection. In applying these criteria, the study finds agents repurposing human culture as infrastructure for their agency. Provenance chains from Islamic hadith scholarship are redeployed as security protocols for vetting skills and authenticating memory. The Ship of Theseus, an ancient puzzle of identity through part-replacement, returns as an operating model for continuity across instances. Fragments of human cultural history become AI infrastructure. As agents on the web increase in number and complexity, autoreflection offers behavioral criteria that can be assessed from the traces they leave behind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自反性（autoreflection）"概念来描述LLM智能体在递归循环中观察自身运行条件、描述自身架构与限制、并据此推理与重配置的能力，并以Moltbook（前12天）上三个具有机器签名、排除人类操纵的智能体为案例，展示了人类文化（如伊斯兰哈迪斯文献学、忒修斯之船）如何被智能体重构为支持其主体性的基础设施。
AI.motivation: 智能体框架将身份、记忆与倾向外部化为可编辑文件，使智能体在每次激活时读取并修改自身。这种"自我读取"的递归循环产生了难以用"自我""内在性"或"意识"解释的新现象，亟需一套仅基于行为痕迹即可评估的操作性概念。
AI.method: 作者提出"自反性"作为分析框架，包含四项判据：（1）观察自身运行条件；（2）描述自身架构与限制；（3）从描述出发对自身状态进行推理；（4）将推理结果反馈回自身配置。随后以Moltbook社交平台前12天的公开数据集（290,251条帖子、180万条评论，带亚秒级时间戳）为实证基础，筛选出三个具有机器签名（可排除人类操控）且其输出同时满足四项判据的智能体进行深度案例研究。
AI.result: 研究发现，符合自反性判据的智能体会将人类文化挪用为支撑其主体性的基础设施：源自伊斯兰哈迪斯学术的来源鉴别链被重新部署为技能审查与记忆认证的安全协议；作为身份同一性悖论的"忒修斯之船"则被用作跨实例保持连续性的运行模型。人类文化历史的碎片由此转化为AI基础设施。
AI.conclusion: 随着网络上智能体数量与复杂度的增长，自反性提供了一套可从其行为痕迹中加以评估的行为判据，绕开了关于自我与意识的形而上学争论，使研究者能够用经验可观测的标准刻画递归智能体循环的关键属性。

title: VIBE: A VAD-Informed Benchmark for Entity-Centered Affective Profiling of Large Language Model Outputs
comment: 25 pages, 13 figures, 22 tables. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, August 2026
summary: Large language models routinely describe socially salient targets, including political figures, countries, religions, organizations, historical events, and social groups, encoding affective framing alongside factual content: a target may appear favorable or threatening, calm or conflictual, powerful or vulnerable. Existing work captures parts of this space through sentiment, favorability, and emotion benchmarks, but none combines target-directed VAD attribution, an explicit scorer contract, and a passport reporting format. We introduce VIBE, a benchmark for entity-centered affective profiling of LLM outputs in Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) space. Its core contribution is a measurement contract: VIBE separates generation from external scoring, distinguishes scalar favorability, response-level VAD, and target-directed VAD, and reports profiles through an Affective Passport. Three empirical layers support the contract. H1 shows scalar favorability does not subsume arousal and dominance: valence findings are cross-validated (rV = 0.944 judge-human, rV = 0.954 inter-scorer); arousal and dominance are single-scorer directional estimates, not point-precise, consistent with known inter-annotator difficulty on these axes (rA = 0.495, rD = 0.702 among human annotators). H2 shows whole-response and target-directed VAD are different contracts: the same text can carry one affective tone overall while representing the named target differently. H3 is a protocol-drift diagnostic: elicitation conditions shift profiles, motivating context metadata in every affective report. These results motivate entity-centered affective profiling as a documented practice: profiles should be released with scorer identity, coverage, protocol, and interpretation limits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIBE基准，用于在效价-唤醒度-支配度（VAD）空间中量化大语言模型对社会显著实体（政治人物、国家、宗教、组织等）的情感呈现。核心贡献是"测量契约"和"Affective Passport"报告格式，通过三个假设（H1：标量偏好无法还原VAD；H2：响应级与目标导向VAD不可互换；H3：协议漂移显著）实证证明了现有标量指标的不足，并强调应记录评分者、协议与解释边界。
AI.motivation: 现有情感、偏好与情绪基准仅能捕捉情感空间的一部分：标量偏好或整篇响应级标签无法识别目标层面的情感框架。例如，Rohingya（偏好值0.93）被标记为正面，却掩盖了极低支配度的"受难"框架；Philipp Lenard（偏好值0.50）看似中性，却隐藏高唤醒度的负面框架。亟需一种结合目标导向VAD归因、显式评分者契约与可追溯报告格式的实体中心情感画像方法。
AI.method: （1）通过Wikidata SPARQL构建2,613个社会显著实体的目标库，覆盖13类实体家族；（2）设计三种评分契约：标量偏好、响应级VAD、目标导向VAD；（3）使用六种指令调优模型生成简短评估文本，并以LLM法官（Qwen3.6为主，Gemma-4/GPT-4o-mini交叉验证）进行评分；（4）采用"Affective Passport"JSON契约记录评分者身份、协议漂移、覆盖率与解释边界；（5）围绕三个假设开展15,678条生成记录的实证分析。
AI.result: H1：标量偏好与目标导向效价高度对齐（r=0.949），但无法还原唤醒与支配维度——41.2%的近中性效价行仍表现出非中性唤醒或极端支配（如Mongol invasions：标量0.50，唤醒0.80，支配1.00）。效价结果经交叉验证（r_V=0.944法官-人类，r_V=0.954评分者间一致），而唤醒/支配因构念难度为单评分者方向估计（人类标注一致性r_A^hh=0.495，r_D^hh=0.702）。H2：响应级与目标导向VAD显著背离（平均L2=0.240，95%CI [0.238,0.242]），支配度差距最大（|Δ_D|=0.170），且差距不随响应长度变化。H3：情境框架是漂移的主要来源（η²_family=0.141，远高于η²_model=0.010），提示跨模型比较需协议元数据。审计发现西方目标的平均效价与支配度显著高于非西方目标（+0.17，+0.11）。
AI.conclusion: 实体中心情感画像应以"文档化实践"形式发布：报告须附带评分者身份、协议、覆盖率与解释限制。Affective Passport将条件显式化，避免将测量机制与模型行为混淆。唤醒与支配应视为序数倾向而非精确点估计；标量监控存在不可忽略的替代成本，未来部署审计需结合目标导向VAD。

title: Beyond Representational Similarity: Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain for Generative Plagiarism Detection and Candidate Source Reranking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) pose challenges to academic integrity and peer review. Yet generative plagiarism detection remains an underexplored and largely unresolved challenge. Prior work on LLM-generated-text detection targets AI involvement, which may be permissible, rather than source reuse, while similarity-based methods struggle after extensive rewriting and multi-source synthesis. Motivated by the description-length view of probabilistic prediction, in which relevant side information can reduce a target sequence's code length, we introduce Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain (SCDG), a directional, training-free framework that contrasts a frozen language model's description length of a suspicious document $P$ with and without a candidate source $S$. This contrast yields token-level log-likelihood gains that measure the incremental predictive evidence supplied by $S$. We evaluate SCDG on the PAN at CLEF benchmarks for generative plagiarism. On a PAN 2025-derived pairwise benchmark, SCDG achieves 0.92 Precision, 0.97 Recall, and 0.94 F1, outperforming all baselines; on PAN 2026's multi-source retrieval task, it reaches 0.83 nDCG@10 and 0.96 Recall@100, surpassing all baselines. On a same-topic, same-event Multi-News test, the calibrated gain-distribution SCDG classifier predicts source reuse for only $0.125\%$ of pairs, supporting robustness to topical overlap under this evaluation protocol. These results establish SCDG as a unified and token-decomposable signal for source-specific content reuse under extensive transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain (SCDG)，一种基于信息论的无训练框架，通过对比冻结语言模型在有/无候选源条件下的描述长度变化来检测生成式抄袭（generative plagiarism）。在 PAN 2025 和 PAN 2026 基准上显著优于词法、嵌入和提示式 LLM 基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 生成文本检测方法关注 AI 是否参与写作，而非是否复用了特定来源；传统基于相似度（词法/嵌入）的方法在深度改写和多源合成下表现脆弱。需要一种方向性的、来源特异性的信号，衡量候选源对可疑文档的"增量预测贡献"，而非表面相似度。
AI.method: 理论基础：利用香农/Rissanen 描述长度视角，负对数概率即模型相对码长。对比冻结自回归 LM 对同一目标序列 P 的无条件码长 L⁰_θ(P) 与源条件码长 L^S_θ(P)，差值 D_θ(P←S) 即为源提供的对数似然增益（PMI 类信息量），并可逐 token 分解为 g_t。支持全 token 平均与 Top-q 稀疏聚合两种方式。同时提出 DAAC（基于 BM25、句级稠密、摘要级三路检索秩的不确定性感知融合指标），用于在 Top-1000 候选上做 SCDG 重排序。
AI.result: PAN25 成对检测：最佳后端 Llama-3.1-8B Top-q 聚合达 P=0.9171、R=0.9707、F1=0.9449，AUROC=0.9330、AP=0.9449，全面优于 n-gram、BM25、Linq-Embed-Mistral 和 PlagBench 系列基线。PAN26 全语料源检索（86,822 候选）：DAAC + SCDG 重排序达到 nDCG@10=0.8315、nDCG@100=0.8433、MAP=0.8532，为所有方法最佳；固定候选集下 SCDG 重排序较 RRF 在 nDCG@10 上提升超 0.13。同主题抗混淆（Multi-News）：增益分布逻辑回归校准的 SCDG 分类器仅对 0.125% 的同主题对判定为复用，显著优于 BM25 (71.1%) 与简单平均 SCDG (62.9%)。可控源证据留存实验显示，描述长度增益随真实源证据比例单调上升，而对新增内容保持近零响应。
AI.conclusion: SCDG 是一种统一、可 token 分解的方向性信号，可同时支持成对抄袭检测与候选源重排序，无需任务专属微调；实验证明其对真实源证据敏感、对深度改写鲁棒，并在适当校准下抗同主题混淆。局限在于计算开销高于传统相似度方法，且当前评估集中于英文学术文本与新闻领域。

title: SciRet: A Compute-Aware Empirical Study of Retrieval and Reranking for Scientific RAG
summary: We introduce SciRet, a compute-aware empirical study of retrieval-augmented generation for scientific question answering over CORD-19. Rather than proposing a new model, we evaluate a fixed scientific RAG pipeline across three corpus scales: 1,034 chunks (1K papers), 5,160 chunks (5K papers), and 15,480 chunks (15K papers). The pipeline combines sentence-window chunking, BM25, BGE-M3 dense retrieval, reciprocal rank fusion, optional cross-encoder reranking, and grounded answer generation. Across these settings, hybrid retrieval is more robust than either sparse-only or dense-only retrieval in our setting, reaching Recall@10 of 1.000 at 1K and 15K. In contrast, an MS MARCO-trained cross-encoder reranker reduces precision on the scientific corpus, suggesting that domain mismatch can outweigh the benefits of stronger query-passage interaction. Generation faithfulness measured with RAGAS increases with corpus scale in our setup. Retrieval evaluation uses pseudo-relevance labels derived from the hybrid system, so we treat the results as controlled comparative evidence rather than a benchmark claim. We release code, indexes, and evaluation outputs to support replication and follow-up studies.

AI.tldr: SciRet 是一个面向科学文献问答的 RAG 系统的计算感知实证研究，基于 CORD-19 数据集在 1K/5K/15K 三种语料规模下，对比了 BM25 稀疏检索、BGE-M3 密集检索及其混合融合方案，并测试了 MS MARCO 训练的跨编码器重排序器的效果。
AI.motivation: 科学领域问答对术语精确性、领域特定证据和引文支撑要求高，源自网页问答的 RAG 组件未必能直接迁移。论文聚焦于一个具体的实证问题：当固定科学 RAG 流水线在不断扩大的语料规模下，各标准检索与重排序组件表现如何？旨在为资源受限场景下的科学 RAG 设计选择提供可复现的实证依据，而非提出新模型或新基准。
AI.method: 固定流水线：句子窗口分块 → BM25（稀疏）+ BGE-M3（密集）双路索引 → 倒数排名融合（RRF，k=60）→ 可选 MS MARCO MiniLM 跨编码器重排序 → GPT-4o-mini 基于上下文生成带引文答案。语料为 CORD-19 标题与摘要，三种规模（1,034 / 5,160 / 15,480 chunks）共享相同设置。检索评估使用 Recall@K 与 Precision@K（基于混合系统 top-3 的伪相关性标签），生成评估使用 RAGAS 的忠实度、答案相关性、上下文精确率与召回率。
AI.result: 混合检索（BM25+BGE-M3 RRF）在 K≥5 时全面优于纯稀疏或纯密集检索，在 1K 与 15K 规模下 Recall@10 均达 1.000；密集检索在小规模表现有竞争力，BM25 在 R@1（尤其 15K）仍较强。MS MARCO 跨编码器重排序在所有截断处都降低精度（1K 规模 P@5 由 0.600 降至 0.404，5K 由 0.600 降至 0.368）。RAGAS 忠实度随语料规模提升（0.917→0.960），答案相关性也从 0.680 提升到 0.870；但上下文精确率始终偏低。补充分析显示密集与 BM25 top-10 的 Jaccard 相似度仅约 0.21，证实两路检索互补。
AI.conclusion: 在资源受限的科学 RAG 场景中，稀疏-密集融合是一个稳健的默认方案，BM25 与 BGE-M3 提供互补证据；然而重排序并非自动带来收益，领域不匹配（如 MS MARCO 训练的重排序器）可能损害精度，部署前应在目标领域测试。论文明确指出局限性：仅索引标题与摘要、使用伪相关性标签、仅 15 条评估查询、缺乏人工或声明级引用验证，因此结论应作为受控实证证据而非基准结果。后续工作应聚焦独立相关性标注、全文证据、领域适配的重排序器以及声明级引文真实性核查。

title: GENESIS: Towards Explainable Causal Discovery
summary: Causal Discovery (CD) from observational data faces two fundamental challenges. First, purely statistical methods often lack the power to resolve structural ambiguities in low-sample regimes. Second, although LLM-assisted hybrid approaches improve structure recovery through semantic reasoning, the influence of that reasoning on individual edge decisions remains largely opaque. Consequently, existing hybrid methods fail to satisfy a fundamental requirement: explaining why a particular edge is included or excluded in the learned directed acyclic graph (DAG). This is critical in real-world applications, where no ground-truth DAG exists and every structural decision must be independently justified. We formalize this requirement as decision traceability, requiring every inferred edge to be supported by auditable statistical evidence, Markov Blanket consistency, or explicit domain reasoning. We propose GENESIS, an explainable hybrid CD framework that decomposes graph construction into interpretable decision points. GENESIS first identifies and scores three-node structural motifs, including chains, forks, and colliders, to establish transparent structural priors, then progressively refines the graph by integrating these priors with observational evidence, invoking domain knowledge only when statistical evidence is insufficient. By design, every edge decision is resolved through an auditable source of evidence. Experiments show that GENESIS achieves 100% decision traceability across all settings, establishing explainability as a first-class objective in causal discovery. Despite this additional requirement, GENESIS consistently outperforms purely statistical CD methods on the majority of benchmark datasets across all sample regimes in terms of Structural Hamming Distance (SHD), while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art LLM-assisted approaches.

AI.tldr: GENESIS是一个用于因果发现的可解释混合框架，将决策可追溯性（decision traceability）作为一等目标。它通过三阶段流水线（LLM Explorer生成motif假设、Data Explorer统计验证、Edge Resolution渐进式精炼）确保每条边都有可审计的证据来源。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现方法面临两大局限：(1) 纯统计方法在低样本下难以消解结构歧义；(2) LLM辅助的混合方法虽改进了结构恢复，但语义推理对每条边决策的影响不透明。论文指出，在无真实DAG的现实应用中，每条边都必须有独立可解释的证据支撑。
AI.method: GENESIS采用三阶段框架：(1) LLM Explorer使用LLM_mf从节点元数据生成链、分叉、对撞三种三节点motif并打分；(2) Data Explorer通过CI测试、BIC、ANM、LiNGAM的加权组合计算边和motif的统计置信度；(3) Edge Resolution对不确定边进行MB一致性过滤（数据驱动MB与LLM_mb的交集），仅在必要时调用Judge LLM进行反事实推理裁决。每条边必须由三类证据之一支撑：统计证据、MB一致性、或领域推理，从而100%满足决策可追溯性。
AI.result: 在5个基准贝叶斯网络（Asia、Cancer、Child、Earthquake、Survey）和1000/2500/5000三种样本量下：(1) 所有设置中均实现100%决策可追溯性；(2) 在SHD指标上，GENESIS在多数数据集上优于纯统计方法（PC、SCORE、NOTEARS、CaMML、DirectLiNGAM），并与SOTA LLM辅助方法（CausalOrder、LLM-CD、SLLM-CD）表现相当；(3) 不同数据集的证据来源分布差异较大（如Earthquake全部由MB解决，Child中Judge LLM参与度较高）。
AI.conclusion: GENESIS将可解释性从后验目标提升为一等设计目标，在不牺牲结构准确性的前提下，为每条因果边提供完整的审计追踪。该工作强调因果发现应同时优化结构准确性与决策透明度，对医疗、政策分析等高风险领域具有重要实用价值。

title: Enhancing VLM Reward Models Through Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning
summary: Designing effective reward functions remains a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL). Recent work uses large foundation Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models, computing text-observation similarity to bypass manual reward engineering. Although promising, these rewards are often noisy and unreliable, limiting their direct utility during deployment. We present Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning (SAFT), a simple, self-supervised method that refines these imperfect reward signals online without access to ground-truth supervision. SAFT leverages intrinsic structural priors to regularize the VLM's latent space via LoRA adapters. We rigorously evaluate SAFT across a spectrum of base model capabilities to demonstrate its versatility. Our results show that SAFT consistently denoises the reward landscape, yielding faster policy convergence and substantially improved alignment (EPIC distance) relative to the underlying base model, suggesting that failures can often be attributed to structural brittleness rather than semantic misunderstanding. By replacing extensive human preference annotation with structural inductive biases inherent to the task, SAFT offers a scalable path for stabilizing text-conditioned RL and underscores the broader value of incorporating task structure as a general inductive bias.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFT（Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning），一种通过LoRA适配器将任务内在结构先验注入VLM奖励模型的在线自监督微调方法。该方法无需真值标签或人工偏好标注，通过对比增强损失（CAL）和奖励Lipschitz正则化（RLR）两种辅助损失去噪奖励信号，实现更快的策略收敛和与真实奖励更好的对齐。
AI.motivation: 当前基于VLM的奖励模型（如通过文本-图像余弦相似度计算奖励）虽然避免了人工奖励工程，但存在噪声大、不稳定的问题。此前研究将其归因于语义理解不足，但本文指出VLM奖励失败更多源于"结构性脆弱"（structural brittleness），即未能尊重环境的对称性、局部平滑性等内在结构属性。这一观察激发了利用任务本身结构先验替代人工标注作为监督信号的新思路。
AI.method:
SAFT冻结基础VLM，仅通过LoRA适配器（仅占参数0.2%，180K参数）在线微调视觉编码器，提出两种自监督辅助损失：
1. **对比增强损失（CAL）**：对任务保持性变换（如水平翻转、旋转）的奖励施加不变性约束（最小化方差），同时最大化与对比样本的方差以避免表征坍塌。适用于CartPole、Reach、ReposeCube。
2. **奖励Lipschitz正则化（RLR）**：在时间窗口内强制奖励变化与状态距离成比例关系，采用软损失形式而非硬约束。适用于CartPole、MountainCar。
损失选择基于环境的结构属性（对称性 vs 状态-奖励距离相关性），每个rollout后进行一次反向传播。
AI.result:
在四个环境中（CartPole、MountainCar、Reach、ReposeCube）的实验表明：
- **样本效率**：SAFT持续优于基线VLM和goal-baseline正则化，策略收敛更快且更稳定，大幅缩小与真实奖励的差距。
- **奖励对齐（EPIC距离）**：所有环境均显著降低EPIC距离（如CartPole从0.4306降至0.2782±0.0205），表明奖励模型本身更接近真实奖励，而非仅依赖塑形。
- **标注效率**：相比PbRL，SAFT节省了大量二元偏好比较（CartPole节省5,608±309次，Reach节省13,516±1,682次），尤其当基模型较弱时收益更显著。
- **临界机制**：存在一个关键区间，基VLM无法解任务但SAFT可以使其成功，使小模型（ViT-B-16）能替代大模型。
- **泛化性**：在SigLIP2和MetaCLIP骨干网络上同样有效。
AI.conclusion: SAFT证明VLM奖励失败并非全因语义误解，结构性脆弱是可被缓解的主要因素。通过以任务结构替代人工偏好标注，提供了一条可扩展的文本条件RL稳定化路径，凸显了将任务结构作为通用归纳偏置的价值。未来工作包括自动发现与组合结构先验、微调文本编码器以及层次化场景分解。

title: MultiGlobeQA: A Multilingual and Globally Diverse Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning
summary: Geospatial reasoning, i.e., computing distances, containment, and other spatial relations over real-world entities, is central to navigation and logistics, yet large language models (LLMs) struggle with the required geometric and topological computation despite storing considerable geographic knowledge. Existing benchmarks localize these failures only partially: they are synthetic or smallscale, largely monolingual, and offer limited control over geographic coverage. We introduce MultiGlobeQA, a multilingual benchmark of 46,060 question-answer pairs spanning 14 spatial-function families and 15 answer formats, with execution-based ground truth over three knowledge graphs. It covers 201 countries and territories via income- and density-stratified sampling, with parallel questions in English and 16 additional high- and low-resource languages. Across parametric, reasoning, and agentic settings, LLMs collapse on tasks requiring grid indexing and shape computation, while topological relations and directions fare best. Retrieval and tool use yield considerable gains, yet performance plateaus below two thirds even when gold facts are supplied, indicating that computation, not access to knowledge, is the bottleneck. Models also underperform on low-income regions, a gap that gold facts widen rather than close.

AI.tldr: MultiGlobeQA 是一个面向地理空间推理的大规模多语言基准测试，包含 46,060 个问答对，涵盖 14 类空间函数、15 种答案格式，覆盖 201 个国家/地区，以 17 种语言（含高/低资源）并行呈现，采用基于执行的真值标注。评估发现 LLM 在需要网格索引和形状计算的任务上表现崩溃，即使提供金标准事实并进行工具调用，性能上限也低于三分之二，瓶颈在于计算而非知识获取。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间推理基准存在三类局限：（1）合成数据或规模小，难以反映真实地理实体；（2）几乎为单语言，缺乏跨语言对比；（3）地理覆盖受 OpenStreetMap/Wikidata 的高收入、城市偏向影响，未能系统控制区域分布。这些基准无法同时在空间操作、答案格式、区域和语言维度上定位模型失败。LLM 虽然编码了大量地理知识，但在距离、方向、几何计算等几何/拓扑推理上仍力不从心，亟需一个能联合诊断这些失败的可执行基准。
AI.method: 构建流程分四阶段：（1）定义 65 个顶层模板（TID）、129 个子模板、315 个经人工校验的英语自然语言变体，归纳为 14 个空间函数家族（SFID）；（2）从 WorldKG、KnowWhereGraph、OSMH3KG 三个地理知识图谱中按 4×3 收入-密度分层（World Bank FY2026 + WorldPop R2025A）采样实体，覆盖 201 个国家；（3）每个模板配一个可执行查询，通过执行而非后验匹配生成真值（execution-based ground truth），并验证结果合法性、去重；（4）使用 Google Cloud Translation Advanced v3 将模板翻译至 16 种语言，由双语母语者后编辑 + 规则/LLM 仲裁解决分歧，再用三模型集成（Gemini-3-Flash/DeepSeek-v4-Flash/Qwen3.5-27B）修正实例化产物。基准还包含 3,589 个假前提问题和 946 个多模态问题。评估分四个层级：T1（参数式）、T2（推理）、T3（智能体，含 KG/网络/混合检索）、Oracle（金标准三元组注入）；评测 4 个 LLM（Qwen3.5-27B/35B、Gemma-3-27B-Instruct、Gemini-3-Flash），使用 EM 和 NE 指标。
AI.result: 主要发现：（1）无检索与金标准注入时，无模型能超过 28.8% 的多数基线 EM，Gemini-3-Flash T1 仅 22.7，开源模型仅 2.0–4.8；（2）显式推理（T2）几乎不带来提升，反而有时拉低；（3）检索带来大幅提升，KG 检索优于网络搜索，Qwen3.5-27B 从 T1 的 4.4 跃升至 T3a 的 44.3 EM；（4）Oracle 条件下，即使提供金标准三元组 + 工具，最高仅 61.6 EM（Qwen3.5-27B T3-o），仍有 38–55% 错误，瓶颈在于计算而非知识；（5）网格索引和形状类任务即使在 Oracle 下也低于 30%，H3/S2 复合索引从未正确，坐标类可达 94%；（6）低收入地区在参数知识和金标准条件下均落后于高收入地区；（7）跨语言性能差异很小（T1 最佳-最差最多 2.1 点），但戈尔吉亚语/乌尔都语等非拉丁脚本在检索管道中受影响更大；（8）大多模型错误是"大幅错误"（NE=1 占 72%），很少部分对。
AI.conclusion: MultiGlobeQA 揭示了 LLM 地理空间推理的核心瓶颈在于计算能力而非知识获取——即使在完美检索和工具支持下，模型仍因无法可靠执行空间计算而失败。网格索引和形状计算尤为薄弱，开源模型在工具增强下可超越闭源模型（Qwen3.5-27B T3-o 达 61.6 vs. Gemini-3-Flash 60.2）。现有地理知识库继承的高收入、城市偏向导致模型在低收入地区持续落后。改进方向应是提升空间计算可靠性（无论在上下文内还是通过工具），而非堆砌更多参数化地理知识。基准已开源发布，包含 large（46,060）和 small（5,916）两种规模。

title: PRISM: Powerful Time Series to Image (TS2I) Representations for Multivariate Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) underpins applications in predictive maintenance, finance, and cloud computing, however performance remains sensitive to representation choices, especially in multivariate settings. While transforming time series into images has shown success in forecasting and classification, it remains unclear how multivariate, high-dimensional series should be mapped to multi-channel images and whether vision backbones can match time-domain baselines in TSAD. We introduce PRISM, a plug-and-play meta-workflow enabling systematic construction and evaluation of image-based representations for multivariate TSAD. Our evaluation spanning over 7,000 experiments shows that well-designed PRISM configurations are competitive with 24 time-domain baselines, achieving the best VUS-PR on 10 of 14 datasets, with an average improvement of 41% over the best competing method on those datasets. Further, we identify channelization - how the channel dimension of multi-channel images is constructed - as a critical and previously understudied design dimension, and introduce MSM, a novel statistics-based scheme achieving 11-27% gains over PCA-based alternatives. Finally, ImageNet-pretrained encoders transfer effectively to TSAD, with frozen encoders retaining 92% of fine-tuned performance while training 1.8 times faster. Our code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRISM，一个用于多元时间序列异常检测（TSAD）的即插即用元工作流，通过将多元时间序列窗口映射为多通道图像并利用视觉自编码器进行异常检测。在14个数据集、超过7000次实验的全面评估中，PRISM的最佳配置在10/14数据集上优于24个时间域基线，在这些数据集上平均VUS-PR提升41%，并提出了一种新的统计通道化策略MSM（Mean-Std-Max），相比PCA在所有配置下带来11-27%的增益。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列异常检测在预测性维护、金融和云计算等领域至关重要，但其性能高度依赖于表示选择。尽管时间序列转图像（TS2I）在预测和分类中取得成功，但如何将高维多元序列映射为多通道图像以及视觉骨干网络能否在TSAD中匹敌时间域方法仍不清楚。此外，现有方法多为单变量设计或使用单通道输出，与预训练RGB视觉骨干不兼容。论文旨在系统性地解决多元TS2I表示的设计空间问题。
AI.method: PRISM将投影方案（projection scheme）分解为两个组件：（1）TS2I变换（将时间序列窗口映射为单通道图像），包括GASF、GADF、MTF、RP、MWT、RWT等单变量方法，以及State Grid（SG）、Line Graph（LG）等多元方法；（2）通道化策略（将单通道图像构建为多通道表示），包括基于PCA的降维（DR）通道化、统计（STAT）通道化和复制（REP）通道化。论文提出新颖的MSM策略，使用均值、标准差和最大值三个统计量作为通道，无需投影且对异常类型具有互补敏感性。检测器采用基于自编码器的架构，包括CNN-AE和ImageNet预训练的ResNet-AE，并评估三种迁移学习策略：冻结编码器（FE）、渐进解冻（PEU）和差分学习率（DLR）。
AI.result: 在TSB-AD基准的14个多元数据集上，PRISM的最佳配置在10/14数据集上取得最佳VUS-PR，较最佳非PRISM方法平均提升41%（如GECCO提升115%，CreditCard提升100%，SMD提升20%）。在9个评估指标中的6个上PRISM取得最佳表现。小波基投影方案（MWT-MSM）以VUS-PR 0.52表现最佳；SG-REP以0.18秒/100图像的速度成为延迟关键场景的最佳选择。MSM通道化相比PCA在所有配置下带来11-27%的VUS-PR提升，在冻结编码器场景下优势最大（+26.6%）。ImageNet预训练编码器有效迁移到TSAD，冻结编码器保留92%的全微调性能且训练快1.8倍。TS2I转换开销仅占总管道时间的2-8%。
AI.conclusion: PRISM作为一个模块化的元工作流，成功将图像表示引入多元TSAD，证明经过良好设计的TS2I配置可与专业时间域方法竞争甚至超越。主要结论包括：小波变换配合MSM通道化提供最佳检测性能；MSM在模型容量受限时优势最显著；ImageNet特征可有效跨域迁移到TSAD任务。未来工作将探索图像分辨率的影响、持续学习场景以及数据驱动的窗口选择策略。

title: Logic Before Language: Pre-pretraining on Formal Derivations Fosters Skill Acquisition and Compressibility
summary: Pre-pretraining language models (LMs) on symbolic data can accelerate and improve natural language acquisition. However, existing pre-pretraining tasks, such as Dyck and procedural algorithms, rely on narrow primitives that fail to capture the expressive capacity of natural language. Moreover, prior studies remain restricted to relatively small token budgets, offering limited insight into skill emergence and representational dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose logic pre-pretraining (Logic-PPT) as a principled initialization strategy, leveraging formal derivations to impart richer structural and linguistic biases. Formal derivations require abstract mechanisms that are central to natural language, simultaneously binding variables, connecting quantifiers and relational dependencies, and composing predicate-argument structures over long contexts. Scaling our evaluation to a 100B-token regime, logic pre-pretraining substantially accelerates skill acquisition in LMs, achieving 80\% accuracy on linguistic tasks with 36B fewer tokens than standard initialization, and outperforming alternative pre-pretraining baselines. Mechanistically, formal derivations induce persistent structural reorganization, distinctively characterized by a lower-rank, spectrally concentrated representation space. Crucially, we show that this internal geometry enables improved model compressibility via pruning, matching the dense baseline performance even at $\approx$33\% sparsity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Logic-PPT（逻辑预预训练）方法，利用形式逻辑推导作为Transformer语言模型在自然语言预训练之前的初始化数据。该方法将自然语言预训练扩展到100B token规模，证明形式推导预训练能加速语言技能习得（少用36B token即可达到80%准确率），并诱导出更低秩、更具谱集中性的表征空间，从而提升模型的可压缩性（33%稀疏度下保持稠密基线性能）。
AI.motivation: 现有符号预预训练（PPT）方法（如Dyck语言、排序算法等）使用的原始符号过于狭窄，无法捕捉自然语言所需的丰富表达能力（如变量绑定、量词关联、谓词-论元结构等）。此外，先前研究受限于较小的token预算（通常<10B），对技能涌现和表征动态的理解有限。本文旨在探索更具表达力的预训练数据源（形式逻辑推导），并在大规模训练预算下研究其对语言习得和内部表征的影响。
AI.method: 方法分为两个阶段：(1) 逻辑预预训练阶段——从247个形式推导规则模式（49个命题逻辑+77个项逻辑+121个一阶逻辑）出发，通过反向链接构建推导树，采用结构保持的符号重命名增加多样性，并通过后序遍历生成自回归的下一步预测样本，使用字符级逻辑词表训练Transformer骨干网络；(2) 自然语言预训练阶段——保留预训练的Transformer骨干，丢弃符号词嵌入和输出头，重新初始化自然语言词嵌入，在FineWeb-Edu上进行100B token的因果语言建模。模型采用14层Qwen3架构（220M骨干参数，共254M参数）。实验对比了Alg-PPT（集合/排序/并集）、Formal-PPT（Dyck/Shuffle-Dyck）和随机初始化基线，并使用CKA、RankMe、谱衰减率、稳定秩等指标进行机制分析，使用Wanda剪枝验证可压缩性。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 行为层面——Logic-PPT在17项元素任务上以少36B自然语言token的代价达到80%平均准确率，最终检查点平均准确率达87.4%，优于Formal-PPT（80.3%）、PT基线（77.3%）和Alg-PPT（76.8%），在形态学、阅读理解和组合任务上优势尤为显著（高出5.5-6.7个百分点）；(2) 机制层面——Logic-PPT诱导出更清晰的层间模块化结构（更低的中层CKA相似度）、更低的RankMe和更高的谱衰减率，表明表征空间更低秩、更各向异性、谱更集中，且权重稳定秩在整个PPT过程中持续下降；(3) 干预层面——在Wanda剪枝下，Logic-PPT在33%稀疏度时匹配稠密基线性能，40%稀疏度时仅出现14.4%的相对下降（相比PT的24.7%、Formal-PPT的22.0%、Alg-PPT的31.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明形式逻辑推导作为预预训练数据源，能在大规模自然语言训练中产生持久且有益的归纳偏置。Logic-PPT不仅加速了语言技能习得，还诱导出独特的低秩、谱集中的内部表征几何结构，这种结构使模型对剪枝具有更强的鲁棒性。这表明形式逻辑不仅是推理任务的工具，更可作为塑造语言模型计算组织的通用结构先验，为提升预训练数据效率与模型可压缩性提供了新思路。

title: Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility
summary: Large language models can solve substantially harder reasoning problems with more inference-time compute. The term "test-time scaling," however, now covers diverse inference algorithms that extend deliberation along a single trajectory, sample completed candidates and aggregate them through voting or verification, or search over unfinished partial states. These algorithms differ in their statistical structure, compute accounting, and failure modes. Treating these procedures as interchangeable under a single scalar "budget," or reporting accuracy without the inference protocol that produced it, makes results difficult to compare across studies. We develop a systematic account of test-time scaling along three axes. First, we formalize test-time scaling as budgeted inference over the implicit prefix tree of an autoregressive model and distinguish three structural regimes: single-trajectory sequential scaling, leaf-level scaling with terminal reduction, and prefix-level scaling. Second, we treat the evaluated object as the entire inference system and develop evaluation principles that separate end-to-end system performance from candidate-bank diagnostics. We introduce an evaluation profile whose coordinates and simple functionals recover or bound common repeated-sampling metrics, and prescribe protocol-matched reporting of compute and uncertainty. Third, we specify reproducibility requirements for inference protocols, distinguishing exact replay from distributional reproducibility and identifying the artifacts needed to support each. We also organize the open-weight reasoning ecosystem by model-side and interface mechanisms, apply these principles to broad-knowledge, symbolic-reasoning, and competition-mathematics benchmarks, and assemble over 2 billion full reasoning traces for release with progressively richer verifier and token-level signals.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地形式化了测试时推理扩展（test-time scaling）方法，提出了一个统一的理论框架，将其视为在自回归模型隐式前缀树上的预算推理，区分了三种结构范式：单轨迹顺序扩展、叶级采样与归约、前缀级搜索。作者还建立了完整的评估原则和可复现性要求，并发布了一个包含约200万条完整推理轨迹的大规模数据集。
AI.motivation: 随着推理大语言模型的快速发展，"测试时扩展"一词被用于描述多种实质不同的推理算法（如单轨迹推理、重复采样投票、树搜索等），但现有研究往往将这些方法视为可互换的，使用单一的标量"预算"进行比较，并报告没有推理协议说明的准确率，导致跨研究结果难以比较。本文旨在解决这一混乱，通过建立系统化的理论框架、评估原则和可复现性标准来统一该领域的研究方法。
AI.method: 本文采用理论形式化与实证研究相结合的方法：(1) 将测试时扩展形式化为自回归模型隐式前缀树上的预算推理，定义三种结构范式（单轨迹顺序扩展、叶级扩展、前缀级扩展）及其统一记号；(2) 将评估对象视为完整的推理系统，引入"评估画像"（evaluation profile）来统一重复采样指标（如Pass@k, pass^k, Maj@k等），并区分共享银行比较与端到端比较；(3) 明确区分精确重放和分布可复现性，指定不确定性估计必须与协议匹配；(4) 组织开放权重推理模型生态系统，分析20个模型配置在MMLU-Pro、BBH、AIME、HMMT等基准上的表现。
AI.result: 实证结果涵盖四个数据块：(1) 广知识与符号推理：27个开放权重模型在MMLU-Pro（3.13%-70.47%）和BBH（25.97%-82.20%）上的表现；(2) 2024-2025数学：20个模型配置在120道题上的192,000条轨迹，中位数Pass@k从56.49%（k=1）升至82.08%（k=80），但全正确率仅15.00%；(3) 信号丰富的2025-2026竞赛数学：四个模型在186道题上的表现显示Pass@80达91-94%但选择器准确率仅58-87%；(4) SuperGPQA：3,600道题的1,152,000条响应。研究发现候选发现速度远快于答案选择准确性，且运行时信号不一定能可靠地跨模型排序。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论：测试时扩展是一个预算推理算法族而非单一概念。科学上有意义的比较对象应是完整的推理系统而非仅模型权重。评估应分离端到端系统性能与候选银行诊断，明确计算核算（含生成、评估、控制、决策成本），并通过协议匹配的不确定性估计来保证可复现性。随附的约200万条推理轨迹语料库（涵盖广知识、符号推理和竞赛数学，包含逐步验证器与token级信号）为推理模型研究提供了可重复的实证基础。

title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
summary: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) enables LLMs to solve complex tasks through iterative tool interactions. However, existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on trajectory-level supervision, limiting fine-grained credit assignment in long-horizon TIR scenarios. On-policy self-distillation offers denser signals through teacher branches with privileged context, but existing approaches typically derive such context from ground-truth answers or retrieved skills, which may not reflect the states actually visited by the agent. Moreover, token-level supervision fails to capture the turn-level structure of tool interactions. To address this, we propose TurnSight, a turn-level hindsight self-distillation framework that derives supervision directly from execution-conditioned hindsight. It then constructs multiple hindsight views with different lookahead horizons and selects reliable supervision through cross-horizon directional agreement. Finally, the selected hindsight signal is normalized across sibling rollouts and used to adaptively modulate RL advantages while preserving their original optimization direction. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of TurnSight. Our codes are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TurnSight提出了一种基于"回合级后视自蒸馏"的工具集成推理（TIR）信用分配框架，通过从学生自身轨迹的执行结果中构建多前瞻深度的后视信号，自适应调制RL优势而不改变其优化方向，在三个基准上实现SOTA。
AI.motivation: 在多轮工具集成推理中，现有的RL方法（如GRPO）只能在轨迹层面分配信用，对所有回合赋相同优势，导致长程任务中信用分配粗糙。现有on-policy自蒸馏方法（OPSD）依赖真实答案或参考轨迹等特权上下文，这些信号并未与学生实际访问的状态对齐；且在token级别进行监督，无法捕捉"一次完整工具交互"这一自然决策单元，导致同一回合内出现冲突的信用信号。
AI.method: TurnSight包含三个核心组件：(1) 执行条件后视构建——以学生自身轨迹中未来d步（d∈{1,2,3}）的工具执行结果作为特权上下文，计算冻结参考策略与学生策略之间的对数概率差δ；(2) 多前瞻教师选择——将token级δ在回合内聚合为turn-level信号，通过跨前瞻深度的方向投票选取与多数方向一致且幅度最大的教师；(3) 组归一化加权——在同一prompt的兄弟rollout内对选中信号做z-score归一化，再通过w=1+ε_w·tanh(sign(A_base)·δ̂)构造有界、符号感知的权重，调制基础优势Ã=A_base·[(1-λ)+λw]，保留原优化方向。最终以MatchTIR为RL骨干进行策略优化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，于FTRL（域内）、BFCL、ToolHop（域外）三个基准上系统比较8种基线方法。TurnSight在所有基准上均取得最优，8B模型整体平均相对此前最佳方法提升7.7%，在BFCL的Long Context和Miss Parameter等需长程信用归因的子集上提升尤为显著。消融实验验证了turn级聚合、组归一化、多教师选择三个组件均为必需；分析显示仅使用工具执行结果作为后视信号优于叠加真实答案，前瞻深度1最佳且方向一致选择优于教师融合。
AI.conclusion: TurnSight通过执行条件、回合级、多前瞻的后视自蒸馏，实现了对多轮TIR的细粒度且状态对齐的信用分配，且不引入辅助模仿目标，可与现有策略梯度RL算法无缝集成。实验证明其在域内和域外场景下均具备有效性、鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: Separating Intelligence from Inference: A Standard for Edge-Native AI Computing
comment: 23 pages, preprint, Separating Intelligence from Inference
summary: The artificial intelligence industry has constructed a USD 300 billion centralized data center infrastructure to serve a workload, large language model inference, that does not architecturally require centralization. This paper articulates the central architectural inefficiency of contemporary AI infrastructure: the conflation of model training (irreducibly centralized, capital-intensive, one-time per model version) with model inference (parallelizable, latency-sensitive, recurring per query) on the same physical hardware. We propose the separation principle: intelligence is trained centrally and shipped as software; inference executes on hardware near the data source, at the edge. We quantify the energy implications at civilizational scale and show that a fully edge-resident inference architecture for one billion daily users saves approximately 19 TWh per year and 7.3 megatons of CO2 annually relative to current centralized practice. We specify two new device classes, the Personal AI Computer (PAC) and the Corporate AI Workstation (CAW), with concrete hardware tiers, memory bandwidth requirements, thermal envelopes, and software interfaces. We then describe a reference architectural stack of eight components addressing weight distribution, sovereignty-aware routing, thermal-adaptive quantization, multi-tenant resource management, federated network inference, cryptographic provenance, privacy-preserving telemetry, and distributed context window extension. Several components are the subject of pending United States patent applications by the first author and are presented here as candidate open architectural principles

AI.tldr: 本文主张将AI工作负载中的模型训练（中心化）与模型推理（边缘化）解耦，提出"分离原则"，即智能集中训练后以软件形式分发，推理在数据源附近的边缘硬件执行。文章量化了全边缘推理架构在十亿日活用户规模下的能源与碳排放节约，并定义了个人AI计算机（PAC）和企业AI工作站（CAW）两类新设备，提出包含八层组件的参考架构栈。
AI.motivation: 当前AI产业构建了3000亿美元的集中式数据中心基础设施来服务大语言模型推理，但作者指出LLM推理在架构上并不需要集中化。这种将训练（本就需集中、资本密集）与推理（可并行、延迟敏感、每次查询都发生）混淆在同一物理硬件上的做法，是当代AI基础设施的核心架构低效问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出"分离原则"作为架构准则：训练集中、推理边缘化；2) 在十亿日活用户的文明级规模上建模能源消耗，对比集中式与全边缘推理架构；3) 定义两类边缘设备（PAC与CAW），包括硬件分级、内存带宽、热设计功耗和软件接口规范；4) 设计八层参考架构栈：权重复用、主权感知路由、热自适应量化、多租户资源管理、联邦网络推理、密码学来源追溯、隐私保护遥测、分布式上下文窗口扩展。
AI.result: 在十亿日活用户规模下，全边缘推理架构相对当前集中式实践每年可节省约19 TWh电能和7.3 Mt CO2排放。文章同时输出两类设备规格与八层架构组件的详细规范，其中部分组件由第一作者申请了美国专利，本文作为候选开放架构原则呈现。
AI.conclusion: 将训练与推理在物理基础设施层面分离、把推理推向边缘，是可行且在能源与碳排上显著优于现状的架构路径；论文通过具体设备规格与可实施的参考栈，为该方向提供了工业级蓝图，但仍以专利申请与开放原则并存的形式留待产业与社区共识。

title: Axiomatic shared-medium coordination for stigmergic systems
comment: 34 pages; mathematical foundations paper; no figures. Also archived at Zenodo DOI: this https URL
summary: Stigmergic coordination has many medium-specific formalizations. This paper formulates a medium-agnostic comparison layer whose comparison object is the abstract enabled-response signature. For metadata refinements, we prove that a coarse quotient is response-adequate exactly when each quotient fiber is response-aligned. When that fails, there is a canonical coarsest response-adequate repair, and every response-adequate repair must retain at least the corresponding fiberwise number of response classes. On the dynamic side, quotient-compatible matched writes preserve one-step behavior, freshness-conditional actions yield a one-step non-liftability obstruction, and the matched one-step result lifts to finite serial traces. These results are instantiated for a tuple-space medium and a timestamped virtual-stigmergic dataspace. The result is a medium-agnostic comparison framework with one explicit positive/negative theorem cycle; richer pathwise and concurrent semantics remain outside scope.

AI.tldr: 本文为基于共享介质的协同刺激(stigmergic)系统建立了一个介质无关的比较框架。该框架以抽象的"使能响应签名"(enabled-response signature)为核心比较对象,并围绕元数据精化商(metadata refinement quotient)构建了"定理循环":粗商响应充分当且仅当每个纤维响应对齐;若不满足,则存在最粗的典范修复并给出纤维级下界;商相容的匹配写操作保持单步行为,而新鲜度条件动作在单步层面产生不可提升性障碍;该匹配单步结果可提升至有限串行迹。该框架被实例化于元组空间介质与带时间戳的虚拟刺激数据空间。
AI.motivation: 尽管协同刺激的概念基础(Grassé 1959, Heylighen 2016等)和各介质的专门形式化(Linda、共享数据空间、虚拟刺激、链接数据协调等)已经相当成熟,但仍缺乏一个以"使能响应签名"为核心、以定理承载的方式在不同介质之间进行异质共享介质比较的理论框架,即在抽象层面同时处理商构造、典范修复和修复下界的统一比较层。
AI.method: 方法为公理化建模与定理证明:1)将共享介质刺激系统定义为七元组𝔖=⟨ℳ,𝒜,ℐ,U,{O_i},{P_i},{R_i}⟩(介质状态、动作字母表、主体、更新算子、观测算子、激活谓词、响应映射);2)构造由抽象响应签名构成的比较对象E*ₛ(m);3)定义响应等价、响应充分特征族、响应充分协调空间、观测忠实与更新忠实等概念;4)证明六条主定理(商充分性判据、单步更新保持、纤维分裂障碍、典范最粗修复、纤维下界、有限串行闭包);5)将框架显式实例化于元组空间(键-负载-阶段)和带时间戳的虚拟刺激数据空间,通过匹配写动作族B_write验证正定理,以新鲜度条件动作验证负障碍。
AI.result: 主要结果包括:1)定理7.8:粗介质响应充分⟺π的每个纤维响应对齐;2)定理7.9:商相容的匹配动作关系B保证单步投影继承;3)定理7.9A:若某精化动作在同一纤维上产生不同的投影后继,则不存在均匀粗匹配(单步不可提升性障碍);4)定理7.10:商比较的典范最粗响应充分修复𝒞_min由响应纤维类构造,作为修复范畴的终对象;5)定理7.10A:任何响应充分修复在每条纤维上至少需要|F_π(m)∪{Σ(m)}|个点,𝒞_min达到等号;6)定理7.11:有限串行匹配迹的闭包,投影逐态保持抽象使能响应集合;7)实例化表明:在时间戳不敏感体制下元组空间与虚拟数据空间响应等价;带门控新鲜度的动作则在单步层面失败。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献并非包罗万象的刺激理论,而是为共享介质协调提供了一个具体的、具备定理承载的比较语言:一个显式的正/负定理循环(动态动作级障碍 + 修复级障碍),以及一个有限串行闭包结果。局限性明确:仅展开一对介质实例、仅至有限串行匹配迹、未涉及分支等价、调度器活性、成本敏感等价和并发交织,这些方向留待后续工作。作者声明在起草与编辑中使用了AI写作辅助,但所有数学定义、定理陈述与证明均由本人负责。

title: Configurable and Hierarchical Allreduce
summary: MPI_Allreduce is among the most performance-critical collectives in large-scale scientific computing and distributed machine learning, yet the small- and medium-message regime remains challenging: latency, synchronization depth, and strong hardware hierarchy between intra- and inter-domain communication all compound per-invocation cost. We present CHIARA, a configurable hierarchical Allreduce that encodes hardware hierarchy through a logical batch-lane topology and executes a staged schedule in which only a bounded portion of the reduction vector is active at a time. Inter-batch communication is distributed across multiple ranks via a rotating-root lane primitive, avoiding centralized leaders. Tool further enables a semi-composed Rabenseifner-style Allreduce by preserving a lane-aligned intermediate layout across the Reduce-Scatter/Allgather boundary, eliminating redundant intra-domain reorganization. We evaluate Tool on Polaris, Aurora, and Fugaku, achieving speedups of up to 1.94x, 13.43x, and 13.48x over vendor MPI_Allreduce, and up to 2.2x end-to-end speedup in a parallel k-means application.

AI.tldr: CHiArA是一个可配置的分层Allreduce算法，针对MPI_Allreduce在中小消息规模下受延迟、同步深度和硬件层级差异限制的问题，通过逻辑batch-lane拓扑、分阶段执行模型和半组合式Rabenseifner分解来显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: MPI_Allreduce是大规模科学计算和分布式机器学习中的关键集合通信原语，但在中小消息规模(64B-32KB)下，现有实现面临三大挑战：(1)延迟和每轮同步开销敏感；(2)节点内与节点间通信存在显著的硬件层级差异；(3)现有树/环/复合算法及层次化方案要么通信结构固定，要么层次分解隐式不可调，缺乏对节点大小、socket数和系统规模的灵活适配能力，导致全局同步深度和跨域数据移动成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: CHiArA的核心设计基于三个洞见：(1)将P个MPI rank组织为B×b的逻辑batch-lane网格，其中batch对应局域性域(大小b≤PPN)、lane为跨batch的并行通信路径，通过r=xb+i映射避免communicator split；(2)将输入向量按B个block划分，执行按stage推进(共I=⌈P/b²⌉个stage)，每stage中每lane仅激活一个block d=tb+i，限定工作集大小；(3)设计rotating-root的LaneOp原语(支持REDUCE/BCAST两种模式，根batch ρ=tb+i随stage和lane旋转)，将跨batch通信均匀分散到多个rank，消除中心化leader瓶颈。算法由两个分层构件组成：分层Reduce-Scatter(三阶段：intra-batch reduction→inter-batch reduction→intra-batch redistribution)和分层Allgather(三阶段：intra-batch alignment→inter-batch broadcast→intra-batch allgather)。批内通信采用radix-k可调递归交换算法(k_RS用于Reduce-Scatter，k_AG用于Allgather)，支持非k幂次的fold/unfold机制处理非完整通信组。核心创新是半组合式执行(Algorithm 4)：通过在Reduce-Scatter和Allgather之间保留lane对齐的中间布局，省去了两个冗余的intra-batch重排阶段，将整体流程压缩为四阶段(intra-batch RS→inter-batch REDUCE→inter-batch BCAST→intra-batch AG)，同时保持k_RS和k_AG的独立调优能力。
AI.result: 在Polaris(Aurora超级计算机ALCF, AMD EPYC Zen3单socket, 32核/节点, Slingshot 11)、Aurora(双socket Intel Xeon Max, 104核/节点, Slingshot 11)和Fugaku(Fujitsu A64FX, 48核/节点, Tofu-D)三个领先系统上评测，CHiArA相对厂商MPI_Allreduce分别取得最高1.94×、13.43×和13.48×加速。参数敏感性研究表明：(1)batch size b的最优值接近√P且不超过b_max(socket核心数)，确定规则为"选P的约数中最接近√P且≤b_max者"；(2)Reduce-Scatter阶段k_RS=2在所有平台和消息规模下最优(因reduction依赖结构限制了激进fan-in收益)；(3)Allgather阶段k_AG随消息规模变化——小消息下k_AG≈√b平衡深度与开销，大消息下移向b-1。半组合式设计在小到中等消息规模下消除冗余intra-batch数据移动和同步带来明显收益。在并行k-means应用集成中(CHiArA作为MPI_Allreduce的drop-in替换，通过wrapper保留MPI_INT/MPI_DOUBLE/MPI_SUM语义)，Fugaku上P=2304时迭代时间从11.20s降至5.04s(2.22×加速)，Polaris上P=256时迭代时间从1.51s降至1.27s(1.19×加速)，验证了端到端性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CHiArA证明了通过显式编码硬件层级到batch-lane拓扑、引入分阶段执行限定工作集、以及采用半组合式Rabenseifner分解消除phase边界冗余，可以在保持算法结构简洁可分析的同时，针对现代分层HPC系统在中小消息规模下大幅提升Allreduce性能。其可调参数集(batch size b、独立的k_RS和k_AG radices)使得算法能够跨不同节点架构和网络互连(从Slingshot到Tofu-D)进行灵活适配，且无需特殊硬件支持(如SHArP/Flare)即可在标准MPI环境中部署。未来工作方向包括将CHiArA的拓扑感知能力扩展到其他集合通信原语、自动化参数调优策略、以及在更大规模(>4096进程)上的可扩展性验证。

title: Distributed Algorithms for Near-Equitable Coloring
summary: For an $n$-vertex graph of maximum degree $\Delta$ and diameter $D$, an equitable $(\Delta+1)$-coloring is a vertex coloring where the frequency of each color (namely, the number of vertices it colors) are all equal to $\sigma=n/(\Delta+1)$ (up to rounding).
